sentences.en: Leo was a quiet student who loved machines.
sentences.zh: 莱奥是个热爱机器的安静学生。

sentences.en: He was born fourteen years ago in a small town.
sentences.zh: 十四年前，他出生在一个小镇上。

sentences.en: He hoped to be an engineer one day.
sentences.zh: 他希望有一天能成为一名工程师。

sentences.en: At his age, most kids dreamed of games, yet he dreamed of inventions.
sentences.zh: 在他这个年纪，大多数孩子梦想着游戏，而他梦想着发明。

sentences.en: He always carried a notebook full of ideas.
sentences.zh: 他总是随身带着一本写满想法的笔记本。

sentences.en: His brother Max was a tall, loud boy.
sentences.zh: 他的哥哥马克斯是个高个子、大嗓门的男孩。

sentences.en: The two of them shared a room with one bed by the window.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩合住一间屋子，窗边放着一张床。

sentences.en: Max loved to kick a ball in the yard.
sentences.zh: 马克斯喜欢在院子里踢球。

sentences.en: Leo preferred to read a book at night.
sentences.zh: 莱奥则更喜欢在晚上读书。

sentences.en: Their lives were simple, but this year everything changed.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活很简单，但今年一切都变了。

sentences.en: One morning in April, something exciting happened.
sentences.zh: 四月的一个早晨，激动人心的事情发生了。

sentences.en: Leo's class held a science competition.
sentences.zh: 莱奥的班级举办了一场科学比赛。

sentences.en: The prize was a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 奖品是个大惊喜。

sentences.en: The winner would travel to a great museum in America.
sentences.zh: 获胜者可以去美国参观一座著名的博物馆。

sentences.en: The teacher set a hard exam to choose the winner.
sentences.zh: 老师出了一场很难的考试来选出获胜者。

sentences.en: Leo did research every evening in the town library.
sentences.zh: 莱奥每天晚上都在镇图书馆里做研究。

sentences.en: He read a science article every single day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都读一篇科学文章。

sentences.en: He also used the internet to watch repair videos.
sentences.zh: 他还利用互联网观看修理视频。

sentences.en: His answer sheet was almost perfect.
sentences.zh: 他的答卷几乎完美无缺。

sentences.en: He won first place, so the school let Max join the trip too.
sentences.zh: 他获得了第一名，于是学校也让马克斯一同前往。

sentences.en: The journey began in August.
sentences.zh: 旅程在八月开始了。

sentences.en: Their mother told them to take care of their health on the road.
sentences.zh: 妈妈叮嘱他们在路上要照顾好自己的健康。

sentences.en: It was the first flight of their lives.
sentences.zh: 这是他们人生中第一次坐飞机。

sentences.en: High above the clouds, Leo watched the sky turn gold.
sentences.zh: 在云层高处，莱奥看着天空变成金色。

sentences.en: The air in the cabin felt cool.
sentences.zh: 机舱里的空气很凉爽。

sentences.en: Far below, the ocean shone like glass.
sentences.zh: 在遥远的下方，海洋像玻璃一样闪闪发光。

sentences.en: After many hours, they landed in a large American city.
sentences.zh: 许多个小时之后，他们降落在一座美国大城市。

sentences.en: Tall buildings stood along every street.
sentences.zh: 高楼沿着每条街道矗立着。

sentences.en: Leo had never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 莱奥从未见过这样的景象。

sentences.en: Max just kept saying, 'Look over there!'
sentences.zh: 马克斯一直不停地说：“快看那边！”

sentences.en: The next morning, they walked to the museum.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们步行去博物馆。

sentences.en: On the way, they passed a busy bank on the corner.
sentences.zh: 路上，他们经过街角一家繁忙的银行。

sentences.en: The museum itself was a beautiful white palace of glass.
sentences.zh: 博物馆本身就像一座美丽的白色玻璃宫殿。

sentences.en: Inside, the halls were full of art and history.
sentences.zh: 馆内的大厅里满是艺术与历史。

sentences.en: One area showed old planes hanging from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 一个区域展示着悬挂在天花板上的老式飞机。

sentences.en: Another room told stories of the army in past wars.
sentences.zh: 另一个展厅讲述着军队在过去战争中的故事。

sentences.en: Old maps showed a famous attack from the sea.
sentences.zh: 古老的地图展示了一次著名的海上进攻。

sentences.en: There was even a British flag from two hundred years before.
sentences.zh: 那里甚至有一面两百年前的英国国旗。

sentences.en: A wall of photos showed wild animals from Australia.
sentences.zh: 一整面照片墙展示着来自澳大利亚的野生动物。

sentences.en: Leo felt he was walking across the whole world.
sentences.zh: 莱奥觉得自己仿佛正在走遍整个世界。

sentences.en: Every culture had its own corner.
sentences.zh: 每种文化都有属于自己的角落。

sentences.en: Each tradition was explained with pictures and simple words.
sentences.zh: 每一项传统都配有图片和简单的文字说明。

sentences.en: In the technology hall, the boys met Bill.
sentences.zh: 在科技馆里，兄弟俩遇见了比尔。

sentences.en: Bill was not a person.
sentences.zh: 比尔并不是人。

sentences.en: He was a robot guide with a gentle voice.
sentences.zh: 他是一个声音温和的机器人导览员。

sentences.en: His body was blue, with warm brown lights for eyes.
sentences.zh: 他的身体是蓝色的，眼睛是温暖的棕色灯光。

sentences.en: A digital screen on his chest showed a smiling face.
sentences.zh: 他胸前的数字屏幕上显示着一张笑脸。

sentences.en: 'Welcome, friends,' he said brightly.
sentences.zh: “欢迎你们，朋友们。”他愉快地说。

sentences.en: 'Ask me about the machines here.'
sentences.zh: “关于这里的机器，尽管问我。”

sentences.en: Leo could hardly believe his eyes.
sentences.zh: 莱奥简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: 'This is amazing,' he whispered.
sentences.zh: “这太神奇了。”他小声说。

sentences.en: Bill led them around the hall, explaining every wonder.
sentences.zh: 比尔带着他们在馆里四处参观，讲解每一件奇妙的展品。

sentences.en: Then, near closing time, there was an accident.
sentences.zh: 然而，临近闭馆时，发生了一场事故。

sentences.en: A workman dropped a heavy box from a ladder.
sentences.zh: 一名工人从梯子上失手掉落了一个沉重的箱子。

sentences.en: It struck Bill, knocking him against the wall.
sentences.zh: 箱子砸中了比尔，把他撞到了墙上。

sentences.en: The fall seemed to break something inside him.
sentences.zh: 这一撞似乎弄坏了他体内的某个部件。

sentences.en: His bright eyes turned black.
sentences.zh: 他明亮的眼睛变成了一片漆黑。

sentences.en: His voice faded away into silence.
sentences.zh: 他的声音渐渐消失，陷入沉默。

sentences.en: A crowd gathered quickly.
sentences.zh: 人群很快围了过来。

sentences.en: Somewhere, a baby began to cry.
sentences.zh: 不知哪里，一个婴儿哭了起来。

sentences.en: The manager rushed over, pale with worry.
sentences.zh: 馆长急忙赶来，脸色因担忧而发白。

sentences.en: 'This is very bad,' she said. 'Our engineer has gone home.'
sentences.zh: “这太糟糕了，”她说，“我们的工程师已经回家了。”

sentences.en: Leo's heart told him he had to act.
sentences.zh: 莱奥的内心告诉他，必须采取行动。

sentences.en: 'Please allow me to look at him,' he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “请允许我看看他。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: The manager turned to the crowd first.
sentences.zh: 馆长先转向了人群。

sentences.en: 'Can anyone here repair machines?' she called.
sentences.zh: “这里有谁会修机器吗？”她大声问。

sentences.en: No one gave any reply.
sentences.zh: 没有任何人回答。

sentences.en: 'I fix old radios at home,' Leo said. 'Of course, I cannot promise success.'
sentences.zh: “我在家修过旧收音机，”莱奥说，“当然，我不能保证一定成功。”

sentences.en: The manager studied his calm face.
sentences.zh: 馆长打量着他镇定的脸。

sentences.en: 'I will trust you, because we have no other choice,' she said.
sentences.zh: “我相信你，因为我们别无选择。”她说。

sentences.en: Then she nodded and stepped back.
sentences.zh: 然后她点点头，退到了一旁。

sentences.en: Leo opened the small panel on Bill's side.
sentences.zh: 莱奥打开了比尔身侧的小面板。

sentences.en: Behind it, he found the power base.
sentences.zh: 面板后面，他找到了电源基座。

sentences.en: One thin wire had come loose.
sentences.zh: 一根细细的电线松脱了。

sentences.en: His hands shook a bit as he worked.
sentences.zh: 干活时，他的手微微发抖。

sentences.en: Max stood close, quiet for once.
sentences.zh: 马克斯站在旁边，难得地安静下来。

sentences.en: 'You are not alone,' Max said. 'I am right here.'
sentences.zh: “你不是一个人，”马克斯说，“我就在这儿。”

sentences.en: Leo took a breath and connected the wire again.
sentences.zh: 莱奥深吸一口气，重新接好了电线。

sentences.en: Although his heart beat fast, his fingers stayed steady.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的心跳得很快，他的手指却保持稳定。

sentences.en: For a long moment, nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 好长一会儿，什么反应也没有。

sentences.en: Then a tiny light blinked on the board inside.
sentences.zh: 接着，里面电路板上的一个小灯闪了起来。

sentences.en: Bill's eyes glowed once more.
sentences.zh: 比尔的眼睛再次亮了起来。

sentences.en: 'Systems running,' he announced. 'Ready for action!'
sentences.zh: “系统运行中，”他宣布，“准备行动！”

sentences.en: The crowd clapped with joy.
sentences.zh: 人群高兴地鼓起掌来。

sentences.en: The manager smiled at both boys.
sentences.zh: 馆长朝兄弟俩微笑。

sentences.en: 'You were able to do what no adult here could,' she said.
sentences.zh: “你做到了这里所有大人都做不到的事。”她说。

sentences.en: 'Listen, he sounds even better than this morning.'
sentences.zh: “听，他的声音甚至比今天早上还要好。”

sentences.en: 'You two have my full attention now — tell me your names.'
sentences.zh: “现在你们俩引起了我全部的注意——告诉我你们的名字吧。”

sentences.en: 'I think this is the beginning of a great career,' she laughed.
sentences.zh: “我想这是一段伟大事业的开端。”她笑着说。

sentences.en: 'One day you may build machines like Bill yourself.'
sentences.zh: “将来有一天，你也许能亲手制造像比尔这样的机器。”

sentences.en: 'He wants to become an engineer,' Max said proudly.
sentences.zh: “他想成为一名工程师。”马克斯骄傲地说。

sentences.en: The story did not end there.
sentences.zh: 故事并没有就此结束。

sentences.en: A local newspaper printed the whole tale the next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天，当地报纸刊登了整个故事。

sentences.en: On their last day, the boys wanted to buy gifts.
sentences.zh: 在最后一天，兄弟俩想买些礼物。

sentences.en: Leo chose a small model of Bill from the shop.
sentences.zh: 莱奥在商店里挑了一个比尔的小模型。

sentences.en: They had already packed when Bill rolled over to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 当比尔滑过来道别时，他们已经收拾好了行李。

sentences.en: 'Among all my visitors, you two are my favorites,' he said.
sentences.zh: “在我所有的访客当中，你们俩是我最喜欢的。”他说。

sentences.en: 'Next time, bring your parents to meet me.'
sentences.zh: “下次，把你们的父母也带来见见我吧。”

sentences.en: On the flight home, Max turned to his little brother.
sentences.zh: 在回家的航班上，马克斯转向弟弟。

sentences.en: 'Will you really make machines like Bill one day?'
sentences.zh: “你真的会在将来造出像比尔那样的机器吗？”

sentences.en: Leo smiled at the clouds outside. 'Yes. Now I know I can.'
sentences.zh: 莱奥望着窗外的云朵笑了：“会的。现在我知道我能做到。”

articles.title: The Card from Thirty Years Ago

sentences.en: Li Ming arrived in England on an early autumn morning.
sentences.zh: 李明在一个初秋的早晨到达了英国。

sentences.en: He had traveled from China to study at a small college.
sentences.zh: 他从中国远道而来，到一所小学院读书。

sentences.en: His English was good, though he still made small mistakes.
sentences.zh: 他的英语不错，虽然仍会犯些小错误。

sentences.en: His school was far from London, the busy capital.
sentences.zh: 他的学校离繁忙的首都伦敦很远。

sentences.en: It stood in a small city in the east.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在东部的一座小城市里。

sentences.en: For a Chinese student, life in this new country was strange at first.
sentences.zh: 对一个中国学生来说，在这个新国家的生活起初很陌生。

sentences.en: The food was different, and the weather was often cold.
sentences.zh: 食物不一样，天气也常常很冷。

sentences.en: Still, he believed this experience would help him grow.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他相信这段经历会帮助他成长。

sentences.en: Every morning he walked to class along the river.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他沿着河边步行去上课。

sentences.en: This walk became a daily habit that he truly enjoyed.
sentences.zh: 这段散步成了他真心喜欢的日常习惯。

sentences.en: One day he noticed an old man sitting near the water.
sentences.zh: 一天，他注意到一位老人坐在水边。

sentences.en: The man wore a long dark coat and a gray hat.
sentences.zh: 那人穿着深色长外套，戴着一顶灰帽子。

sentences.en: A small brown dog watched Li Ming with bright eyes.
sentences.zh: 一只棕色小狗用明亮的眼睛望着李明。

sentences.en: Li Ming smiled and said hello, and the old man nodded.
sentences.zh: 李明微笑着打招呼，老人点了点头。

sentences.en: After that, they greeted each other whenever they met.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他们每次相遇都会互相问候。

sentences.en: Slowly, a warm feeling grew between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，两人之间生出一种温暖的情谊。

sentences.en: The old man's name was Mr. Hall, a retired theater director.
sentences.zh: 老人名叫霍尔先生，是一位退休的剧院导演。

sentences.en: He invited Li Ming to a reading club at the local church.
sentences.zh: 他邀请李明参加当地教堂里的一个读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: The building was more than a century old, with heavy wooden doors.
sentences.zh: 那座建筑有一百多年历史，装着厚重的木门。

sentences.en: Inside, people drank tea from little white cups and talked about books.
sentences.zh: 屋里，人们用白色小茶杯喝茶，谈论书籍。

sentences.en: Everyone there welcomed the young student warmly.
sentences.zh: 那里的每个人都热情地欢迎这位年轻学生。

sentences.en: Li Ming felt this was a chance to understand British life.
sentences.zh: 李明觉得这是了解英国生活的一个机会。

sentences.en: He began to attend the meetings twice a week.
sentences.zh: 他开始每周参加两次聚会。

sentences.en: It was easy to talk with these kind people, especially Mr. Hall.
sentences.zh: 和这些善良的人交谈很轻松，尤其是霍尔先生。

sentences.en: One cool evening in December, Mr. Hall looked very sad.
sentences.zh: 十二月一个凉爽的傍晚，霍尔先生看起来非常难过。

sentences.en: He held an old birthday card in his thin hands.
sentences.zh: 他瘦弱的手里拿着一张旧生日贺卡。

sentences.en: Li Ming asked gently what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 李明轻声问他怎么了。

sentences.en: The old man said the card was from his daughter, Anna.
sentences.zh: 老人说这张贺卡是女儿安娜寄来的。

sentences.en: She had left home thirty years before, after a family fight.
sentences.zh: 三十年前，一场家庭争吵之后，她离开了家。

sentences.en: The cause of the fight was her marriage to a man her father hated.
sentences.zh: 争吵的起因是她嫁给了一个父亲讨厌的男人。

sentences.en: Since then, the house had been silent and lonely.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，这个家一直冷清而孤独。

sentences.en: That silence had become the deepest pain of his life.
sentences.zh: 那份沉默成了他一生中最深的痛。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall explained everything slowly, in a low voice.
sentences.zh: 霍尔先生低声地、慢慢地讲出了一切。

sentences.en: In fact, Anna had moved to Germany with her husband.
sentences.zh: 事实上，安娜跟丈夫搬去了德国。

sentences.en: Her husband worked there for the federal government.
sentences.zh: 她丈夫在那里为联邦政府工作。

sentences.en: For a couple of years, she sent letters at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 头几年，她每逢圣诞节都会寄信来。

sentences.en: Her old father was too proud to answer even one of them.
sentences.zh: 她年迈的父亲太骄傲，连一封信都不肯回。

sentences.en: Then the letters stopped, and no one ever heard from her again.
sentences.zh: 后来信断了，再也没有人收到过她的消息。

sentences.en: He was now certain that she believed he no longer cared.
sentences.zh: 如今他确信，女儿以为他早已不再在乎她了。

sentences.en: Worse still, he feared she might think he was dead.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，他担心女儿以为他已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: Li Ming listened quietly and made a big decision.
sentences.zh: 李明静静地听着，做出了一个重大决定。

sentences.en: He would help this old man find his child again.
sentences.zh: 他要帮这位老人重新找到自己的孩子。

sentences.en: It would be difficult, but he wanted to try.
sentences.zh: 这会很难，但他想试一试。

sentences.en: That night, Li Ming knew what he had to do.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，李明知道自己该做什么。

sentences.en: He typed Anna's full name online and checked page after page.
sentences.zh: 他在网上输入安娜的全名，一页一页地查找。

sentences.en: Most results showed strangers with the same common name.
sentences.zh: 大多数结果都是同名同姓的陌生人。

sentences.en: Near the end of the list, one page caught his attention.
sentences.zh: 在列表快到末尾的地方，一个页面引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: A woman named Anna taught European history at a school in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫安娜的女士在柏林一所学校教欧洲历史。

sentences.en: The school website showed her face in a small photo.
sentences.zh: 学校网站上有一张她的小照片，露出她的面容。

sentences.en: Her eyes looked exactly like Mr. Hall's.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛和霍尔先生的一模一样。

sentences.en: Li Ming wrote her a long email that same night.
sentences.zh: 当晚，李明给她写了一封长长的邮件。

sentences.en: He explained the story and added the old man's address and postal code.
sentences.zh: 他说明了事情的经过，并附上了老人的地址和邮编。

sentences.en: He never expected a fast answer, but a reply arrived the next morning.
sentences.zh: 他没指望很快得到回音，但第二天早上回复就来了。

sentences.en: Anna wrote that she had cried while reading his message.
sentences.zh: 安娜写道，她读他的信息时哭了。

sentences.en: For years she had wanted to come home, yet fear stopped her.
sentences.zh: 多年来她一直想回家，却被恐惧拦住了。

sentences.en: Now, at last, there was a clear road back.
sentences.zh: 现在，回家的路终于清晰了。

sentences.en: Li Ming ran to Mr. Hall's house with the wonderful news.
sentences.zh: 李明带着这个好消息跑到霍尔先生家。

sentences.en: The old man read the email twice, his hands shaking.
sentences.zh: 老人把邮件读了两遍，双手不停颤抖。

sentences.en: 'Can this really be true?' he whispered.
sentences.zh: “这真的是真的吗？”他低声说。

sentences.en: 'It certainly is,' Li Ming answered with a wide smile.
sentences.zh: “千真万确。”李明笑着回答。

sentences.en: Anna wanted to call her father that very evening.
sentences.zh: 安娜想当天晚上就给父亲打电话。

sentences.en: When the phone rang, the old man could hardly breathe.
sentences.zh: 电话铃响时，老人几乎不能呼吸。

sentences.en: Then he heard his daughter's voice for the first time in thirty years.
sentences.zh: 然后，三十年来他第一次听到了女儿的声音。

sentences.en: They continued talking until late, laughing and crying together.
sentences.zh: 他们一直聊到深夜，又哭又笑。

sentences.en: Anna decided to fly to England in February.
sentences.zh: 安娜决定二月飞来英国。

sentences.en: She chose a date near her father's birthday.
sentences.zh: 她选了一个临近父亲生日的日子。

sentences.en: The trip across Europe would cost a lot, yet she never worried about the money.
sentences.zh: 横跨欧洲的旅程花费不小，但她一点也不心疼钱。

sentences.en: Nothing else mattered to her now.
sentences.zh: 现在，别的事对她都不重要了。

sentences.en: She booked a double room at a small hotel in town.
sentences.zh: 她在镇上一家小旅馆订了一个双人房间。

sentences.en: Her son, a quiet boy of eight, would travel with her.
sentences.zh: 她八岁的儿子，一个安静的小男孩，会和她同行。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall counted the days like a young child before a holiday.
sentences.zh: 霍尔先生像放假前的小孩子一样数着日子。

sentences.en: For example, he cleaned his whole house three times in one week.
sentences.zh: 比如说，他一周之内把整个房子打扫了三遍。

sentences.en: The great morning arrived, cold but bright.
sentences.zh: 那个重要的早晨到了，天气寒冷却晴朗。

sentences.en: During the night, snow had covered the streets like a white blanket.
sentences.zh: 夜里，雪像白毯子一样盖住了街道。

sentences.en: Li Ming borrowed a friend's car for the trip.
sentences.zh: 李明为这趟行程借了朋友的车。

sentences.en: They crossed the river and drove down the long airport road.
sentences.zh: 他们过了河，沿着长长的机场公路一路开去。

sentences.en: Neither of them spoke much, because words were not enough.
sentences.zh: 两人都没怎么说话，因为言语已不足以表达心情。

sentences.en: At the gate, the old man's eyes never left the door.
sentences.zh: 在出口处，老人的目光一刻也没离开那扇门。

sentences.en: By noon, Anna walked out, and the years seemed to fall away.
sentences.zh: 临近中午，安娜走了出来，多年的光阴仿佛一下子消失了。

sentences.en: They held each other and cried without any shame.
sentences.zh: 他们紧紧相拥，毫不掩饰地哭了。

sentences.en: That evening, the whole family ate dinner at the old house.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一家人在老宅里共进晚餐。

sentences.en: Anna's son spoke little English, but everyone helped him along.
sentences.zh: 安娜的儿子英语说得不多，但大家都帮着他。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall told funny stories about Anna as a little girl.
sentences.zh: 霍尔先生讲了安娜小时候的趣事。

sentences.en: 'You have not changed at all,' he joked, 'except your hair.'
sentences.zh: “你一点都没变，”他打趣道，“除了头发。”

sentences.en: Anna talked about her work and her son's education.
sentences.zh: 安娜谈起自己的工作和儿子的教育。

sentences.en: She said her husband had died two years before, after a long illness.
sentences.zh: 她说丈夫两年前因久病去世了。

sentences.en: His death had taught her that pride carries a heavy price.
sentences.zh: 他的死让她明白，骄傲的代价十分沉重。

sentences.en: 'Life is short,' she said softly, 'so hold your dear ones close.'
sentences.zh: “人生苦短，”她轻声说，“所以要把亲人紧紧留在身边。”

sentences.en: A few mornings later, it was time for check-out at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 几天后的早晨，到了旅馆退房的时间。

sentences.en: But Anna had made a new deal with her father.
sentences.zh: 但安娜已经和父亲达成了新的约定。

sentences.en: She would either move back home or visit often.
sentences.zh: 她要么搬回家，要么经常回来探望。

sentences.en: To celebrate, they cut a small cake with the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝，他们和邻居们一起切了一个小蛋糕。

sentences.en: The happy event brought the whole reading club together.
sentences.zh: 这件喜事把整个读书俱乐部的人都聚到了一起。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall stood up and said he was the happiest man on earth.
sentences.zh: 霍尔先生站起来说，自己是世界上最幸福的人。

sentences.en: Li Ming watched the smiling faces and learned a simple truth.
sentences.zh: 李明看着一张张笑脸，明白了一个朴素的道理。

sentences.en: One small act of kindness makes a real difference in this world.
sentences.zh: 一个小小的善举，就能给这个世界带来真正的改变。

sentences.en: The story begins one cold morning in January, on a small island far from the big cities.
sentences.zh: 故事开始于一月的一个寒冷早晨，在一座远离大城市的小岛上。

sentences.en: The island was green and quiet, and an old white house stood near the sea.
sentences.zh: 岛上绿意盎然、十分安静，一座白色的老房子立在海边。

sentences.en: A boy named Ravi lived in that house with his family.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫拉维的男孩和家人住在那座房子里。

sentences.en: He was twelve years old, with short black hair and bright, curious eyes.
sentences.zh: 他十二岁，留着黑色短发，眼睛明亮而好奇。

sentences.en: More than anything else, he loved football.
sentences.zh: 他最热爱的东西，就是足球。

sentences.en: Every afternoon, he ran to the dusty field behind the school and practiced until dark.
sentences.zh: 每天下午，他都跑到学校后面尘土飞扬的球场，一直练到天黑。

sentences.en: His best friend was a girl named Mei.
sentences.zh: 他最好的朋友是一个叫小梅的女孩。

sentences.en: Her feet were quick, and she could stop almost any ball.
sentences.zh: 她脚步飞快，几乎能拦下任何一个球。

sentences.en: "Hi, Ravi!" she would call. "Hey, pass it to me!"
sentences.zh: “嗨，拉维！”她总是喊道，“喂，把球传给我！”

sentences.en: For the two of them, every game was pure fun.
sentences.zh: 对他们两个来说，每一场比赛都充满了乐趣。

sentences.en: One afternoon, Mei scored the first goal in less than a minute.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，小梅不到一分钟就打进了第一个球。

sentences.en: Then Ravi slipped on the wet grass, and it looked so funny that they both laughed for a long time.
sentences.zh: 接着拉维在湿草地上滑了一跤，样子实在太滑稽，两人笑了好久。

sentences.en: They did not have much money, but on that little pitch they were truly happy.
sentences.zh: 他们并不富裕，但在那块小小的场地上，他们真的很快乐。

sentences.en: One evening, the two children watched a film about an international football star.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，两个孩子看了一部关于国际足球明星的电影。

sentences.en: The star came from a poor town in India, and his early life was very much like theirs.
sentences.zh: 那位明星来自印度的一个贫穷小镇，他早年的生活和他们非常相似。

sentences.en: At the end of the movie, the player lifted a gold cup and held it up under the lights.
sentences.zh: 电影结尾，那位球员举起金色的奖杯，在灯光下高高托起。

sentences.en: Something like a small fire started to burn in Ravi's heart.
sentences.zh: 拉维的心里仿佛燃起了一团小小的火焰。

sentences.en: He promised himself that his future would be on a stage like that.
sentences.zh: 他暗暗向自己承诺，未来一定要站上那样的舞台。

sentences.en: "I will never forget this night," he whispered.
sentences.zh: “我永远不会忘记今晚。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: The following week, exciting information arrived at the school.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一周，一条令人兴奋的消息传到了学校。

sentences.en: The government was starting a youth cup, and every team had to fill in a form before March.
sentences.zh: 政府要举办一届青少年杯赛，每支球队必须在三月前填好一张表格。

sentences.en: Each team could include players from no more than four villages.
sentences.zh: 每支球队的队员最多只能来自四个村子。

sentences.en: The final would be shown on national TV, so hopes on the island were very high.
sentences.zh: 决赛将在国家电视台播出，所以岛上的人们期望很高。

sentences.en: Mei had an idea: they could build a group with kids from the fishing village across the bay.
sentences.zh: 小梅有了一个主意：他们可以和海湾对面渔村的孩子组成一支队伍。

sentences.en: That village was five kilometers away, almost an hour on foot.
sentences.zh: 那个村子在五公里之外，走路差不多要一个小时。

sentences.en: "How will we get there every day?" Ravi asked.
sentences.zh: “我们每天怎么过去呢？”拉维问。

sentences.en: "My uncle's boat is free in the afternoon, and he is glad to give us a ride," Mei answered.
sentences.zh: “我叔叔的船下午没事，他很乐意载我们一程。”小梅回答。

sentences.en: Training was hard, but the children slowly learned to focus.
sentences.zh: 训练很辛苦，但孩子们慢慢学会了专注。

sentences.en: On hot days, they dropped small pieces of ice into their water bottles.
sentences.zh: 天热的时候，他们往水壶里放几小块冰。

sentences.en: Mei's mother cooked simple food for everyone, and it always tasted good.
sentences.zh: 小梅的妈妈给大家做简单的饭菜，味道总是很好。

sentences.en: Their coach was a retired general who loved history and told long stories about the island's past.
sentences.zh: 他们的教练是一位退役的将军，他热爱历史，常常讲起小岛过去的漫长故事。

sentences.en: The children followed him like little soldiers and listened to every word.
sentences.zh: 孩子们像小士兵一样跟着他，认真听他说的每一句话。

sentences.en: He taught them when to hit the ball with power and how to signal with one hand.
sentences.zh: 他教他们什么时候该大力击球，以及如何用一只手打手势。

sentences.en: In the first half of each practice they made many mistakes, but the old man said that was fine.
sentences.zh: 每次训练的前半段他们总会犯很多错，但老人说这没关系。

sentences.en: Week after week, their growth was clear, and their confidence continued to increase.
sentences.zh: 一周又一周，他们的成长有目共睹，信心也不断增强。

sentences.en: However, in early February something terrible happened.
sentences.zh: 然而，二月初发生了一件可怕的事。

sentences.en: Ravi's father fell from a fishing boat during a storm and was taken to the hospital in the next town.
sentences.zh: 拉维的父亲在风暴中从渔船上摔了下来，被送进了邻镇的医院。

sentences.en: Ravi's mother sat by her husband's bed all night and tried not to cry.
sentences.zh: 拉维的母亲整夜守在丈夫的床边，努力不让自己哭出来。

sentences.en: Ravi stayed home for days, and he even began to hate the sight of a football.
sentences.zh: 拉维在家待了好几天，甚至开始讨厌看到足球。

sentences.en: "I guess big dreams are not for people like us," he said to the empty wall.
sentences.zh: “我猜，大梦想不属于我们这样的人。”他对着空空的墙壁说。

sentences.en: When Mei heard about this, she refused to lose hope.
sentences.zh: 小梅听说这件事后，拒绝放弃希望。

sentences.en: She walked to his door and stood in front of it until he opened it.
sentences.zh: 她走到他家门口，站在门前，直到他把门打开。

sentences.en: "Your father is getting better," she said, "but the fight inside you must not stop."
sentences.zh: “你爸爸正在好转，”她说，“但你心里的那场战斗不能停下来。”

sentences.en: Ravi lifted his head slowly and looked at her.
sentences.zh: 拉维慢慢抬起头，看着她。

sentences.en: "If you play, the whole village will help your family while your father rests," Mei promised.
sentences.zh: “如果你去踢球，你爸爸休养期间，全村人都会帮你们家。”小梅保证道。

sentences.en: The next morning, Ravi began to find his old interest in the game again.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，拉维开始重新找回对比赛的热情。

sentences.en: The fishermen found some strong wood on the beach and built new goal posts for the team.
sentences.zh: 渔民们在海滩上找到一些结实的木头，为球队做了新的球门柱。

sentences.en: "Football is a human game," the coach told them, "and even great players fall before they rise."
sentences.zh: “足球是属于人的运动，”教练告诉他们，“再伟大的球员，也是先跌倒再站起来的。”

sentences.en: "What is important is standing up one more time."
sentences.zh: “重要的是，再多站起来一次。”

sentences.en: The team had a new spirit now, and it showed in its every pass.
sentences.zh: 球队现在有了新的精气神，每一次传球都能看得出来。

sentences.en: The little island itself seemed to wake up, because everyone talked about the young players.
sentences.zh: 小岛本身仿佛也苏醒了，因为每个人都在谈论这群年轻的球员。

sentences.en: One morning, a foreign visitor stepped off the ferry — a French journalist with a big camera.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，一位外国访客走下渡轮——一位背着大相机的法国记者。

sentences.en: "Your story is interesting," he told the surprised children.
sentences.zh: “你们的故事很有意思。”他对惊讶的孩子们说。

sentences.en: He wanted to make a short movie about the island team and share it with the world.
sentences.zh: 他想拍一部关于小岛球队的短片，把它分享给全世界。

sentences.en: "If you go further in this cup, millions of people will watch you," he said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “如果你们在这届杯赛中走得更远，会有几百万人看到你们。”他微笑着说。

sentences.en: After that, huge crowds came to watch even their simple practice matches.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，哪怕是普通的训练赛，也有大批人群前来观看。

sentences.en: Ravi's father, now much stronger, watched from a chair by the side of the pitch.
sentences.zh: 拉维的父亲身体好多了，坐在场边的椅子上看他们训练。

sentences.en: At last, the day of the big match arrived, and the team traveled to the capital.
sentences.zh: 终于，大赛的日子到了，球队出发前往首都。

sentences.en: They had waited for this moment for months, and now they walked into a real stadium.
sentences.zh: 为了这一刻他们等了好几个月，如今终于走进了真正的体育场。

sentences.en: The stands were full of people waving flags and singing songs.
sentences.zh: 看台上坐满了挥舞旗帜、放声歌唱的观众。

sentences.en: "We have worked for this day — now we are finally here," the coach said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我们为这一天努力了很久——现在我们终于站在这里了。”教练轻声说。

sentences.en: The other team was fast and strong, and the score stayed at zero for a long time.
sentences.zh: 对手又快又强，比分很长时间都是零比零。

sentences.en: Then, in the last minute, Mei sent a perfect pass across the grass.
sentences.zh: 然后，在最后一分钟，小梅送出了一记贴着草皮的完美传球。

sentences.en: Ravi met the ball and kicked it toward the corner of the net.
sentences.zh: 拉维迎上皮球，一脚踢向球网的死角。

sentences.en: The keeper jumped, but the ball flew past his fingers and the whole stadium exploded.
sentences.zh: 守门员飞身扑救，但皮球从他指尖飞过，整个体育场瞬间沸腾了。

sentences.en: That night, the children carried the shining cup back to the ferry.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，孩子们捧着闪闪发光的奖杯回到了渡轮上。

sentences.en: The French journalist filmed everything, from the tears to the laughter.
sentences.zh: 那位法国记者把一切都拍了下来，从泪水到笑声。

sentences.en: Back on the island, Ravi's father hugged him without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 回到岛上，拉维的父亲一句话也没说，紧紧抱住了他。

sentences.en: Years later, people still tell this story to every new child who picks up a ball.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，人们仍会把这个故事讲给每一个刚拿起足球的孩子听。

sentences.en: They say that a dream, like a small island, may look tiny on a map.
sentences.zh: 他们说，梦想就像一座小岛，在地图上也许显得很小。

sentences.en: But if you stand on it and look out at the sea, it is bigger than the whole world.
sentences.zh: 但当你站在上面眺望大海时，它比整个世界还要辽阔。

sentences.en: My name is Lin Hua.
sentences.zh: 我叫林华。

sentences.en: I grew up in a quiet town in the north of China.
sentences.zh: 我在中国北方的一个安静小镇长大。

sentences.en: Last year, I finished school and wanted something different.
sentences.zh: 去年，我完成了学业，想要一些不同的东西。

sentences.en: In June, a job offer arrived from an English company.
sentences.zh: 六月，一份来自英国公司的工作邀请寄到了。

sentences.en: It was a chance to live in London, far across the world.
sentences.zh: 那是一个住在伦敦的机会，远在世界的另一端。

sentences.en: I said yes almost before I finished reading the letter.
sentences.zh: 我几乎还没读完信就答应了。

sentences.en: My mother, however, was worried about the plan.
sentences.zh: 然而，我的母亲对这个计划很担心。

sentences.en: She had never traveled far from our small home herself.
sentences.zh: 她自己从未离开过我们的小家去远方。

sentences.en: Mom cried when she watched the bags being packed.
sentences.zh: 我收拾行李时，妈妈哭了。

sentences.en: I love you, she said, but the world outside is big.
sentences.zh: 她说：我爱你，但外面的世界很大。

sentences.en: She is a kind woman with a soft and gentle voice.
sentences.zh: 她是个善良的女人，声音温柔。

sentences.en: English is not an easy language for her generation.
sentences.zh: 对她那一代人来说，英语不是一门容易的语言。

sentences.en: You must learn it well, she said again and again.
sentences.zh: 她一遍又一遍地说：你必须把它学好。

sentences.en: In July, the plane ticket finally arrived in the post.
sentences.zh: 七月，机票终于寄到了。

sentences.en: It was very hard to leave her at the airport gate.
sentences.zh: 在机场登机口与她分别非常艰难。

sentences.en: But some doors only open when other doors close behind you.
sentences.zh: 但有些门，只有在别的门关上之后才会打开。

sentences.en: The plane landed early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 飞机在清晨降落。

sentences.en: Soft light fell over the large city below the clouds.
sentences.zh: 柔和的光洒在云层下这座巨大的城市上。

sentences.en: From above, it looked like a gray sea of roofs.
sentences.zh: 从上面看，它像一片灰色的屋顶之海。

sentences.en: Nearly nine million people call this place home.
sentences.zh: 将近九百万人把这里当作家。

sentences.en: Everything around felt modern, quick, and loud.
sentences.zh: 周围的一切都显得现代、快速而喧闹。

sentences.en: Even the river ran between man-made walls of old stone.
sentences.zh: 就连河流也在人造的古老石墙之间流淌。

sentences.en: I took a deep breath and pulled the heavy suitcase forward.
sentences.zh: 我深吸一口气，拉着沉重的行李箱向前走。

sentences.en: A new chapter was opening for me.
sentences.zh: 一个新的篇章正在为我展开。

sentences.en: The work was at a small music company.
sentences.zh: 工作是在一家小型音乐公司。

sentences.en: Its main office sat near the river, in an old building.
sentences.zh: 它的主办公室坐落在河边一栋旧楼里。

sentences.en: On the first day, there was a long meeting about plans.
sentences.zh: 第一天，有一场关于计划的长会议。

sentences.en: Every member of the team gave a warm welcome.
sentences.zh: 团队的每位成员都热情相迎。

sentences.en: The boss wanted an online fan network for the singers.
sentences.zh: 老板想为歌手们建一个线上粉丝网络。

sentences.en: That night, ideas filled a whole list on paper.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一整张纸上写满了想法清单。

sentences.en: I sent a message to the whole team about it.
sentences.zh: 我就此给整个团队发了一条消息。

sentences.en: The boss replied with a short note: nice work.
sentences.zh: 老板回了一张简短的便条：干得漂亮。

sentences.en: After work, the city offered many small surprises.
sentences.zh: 下班后，这座城市带来许多小惊喜。

sentences.en: One Friday, a workmate invited me to a night-club.
sentences.zh: 一个周五，一位同事邀请我去一家夜店。

sentences.en: A band was playing in the middle of the room.
sentences.zh: 一支乐队正在房间中央演奏。

sentences.en: People stood in a slow line to get closer to the stage.
sentences.zh: 人们排着缓慢的队伍，想离舞台更近。

sentences.en: I closed both eyes and listened to every warm sound.
sentences.zh: 我闭上双眼，聆听每一个温暖的声音。

sentences.en: The singer was an old man with silver hair.
sentences.zh: 主唱是一位银发老人。

sentences.en: The band called itself The Paper King.
sentences.zh: 这支乐队自称“纸国王”。

sentences.en: At the end, they asked if anyone wanted to join them.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们问有没有人想加入他们。

sentences.en: For one moment, the whole room went quiet inside my head.
sentences.zh: 有那么一瞬间，整个房间在我脑海里安静了下来。

sentences.en: Then two nervous feet began to move toward the stage.
sentences.zh: 然后，两只紧张的脚开始向舞台移动。

sentences.en: Maybe this was a crazy choice for a quiet girl.
sentences.zh: 对一个安静的女孩来说，这也许是个疯狂的选择。

sentences.en: I might fall, or I might forget every word.
sentences.zh: 我可能会摔倒，也可能忘掉所有歌词。

sentences.en: Never mind the fear, I whispered to the empty air.
sentences.zh: 我对着空气轻声说：别管害怕不害怕。

sentences.en: I sang an old folk song from home, half in Chinese.
sentences.zh: 我唱了一首家乡的老民谣，一半用中文。

sentences.en: The sound that came out surprised even myself.
sentences.zh: 唱出来的声音连我自己都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: When it ended, the room grew warm with claps and smiles.
sentences.zh: 歌声结束时，掌声和微笑让整个房间温暖起来。

sentences.en: The silver-haired singer came over to meet me after the show.
sentences.zh: 演出结束后，那位银发歌手过来见我。

sentences.en: There is a small league of bands in this city, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：这座城市里有一个小型乐队联盟。

sentences.en: The final match takes place every year in November.
sentences.zh: 决赛每年十一月举行。

sentences.en: Would you sing with us next month, he asked gently.
sentences.zh: 他温和地问：下个月你愿意和我们一起唱吗？

sentences.en: A hundred thoughts raced through this beating heart.
sentences.zh: 无数念头在我怦怦直跳的心里飞过。

sentences.en: I thought about work, rest, and the quiet flat.
sentences.zh: 我想到了工作、休息，还有那间安静的公寓。

sentences.en: Then I heard a small brave voice say yes.
sentences.zh: 然后我听见一个小小的、勇敢的声音说：好。

sentences.en: Life sometimes gives the strangest and sweetest gifts.
sentences.zh: 生活有时会送来最奇怪也最甜美的礼物。

sentences.en: We practiced twice a week in a cold back room.
sentences.zh: 我们每周在一间冰冷的后屋排练两次。

sentences.en: It took a lot of energy, but every hour felt alive.
sentences.zh: 这耗费了很多精力，但每个小时都让人觉得鲜活。

sentences.en: The money in the bank, however, was running low.
sentences.zh: 然而，银行里的钱越来越少。

sentences.en: Rent took much of the pay before each week even started.
sentences.zh: 每周还没开始，房租就拿走了工资的大部分。

sentences.en: I ate little and walked everywhere instead of taking the bus.
sentences.zh: 我吃得很少，到哪儿都走路，不坐公交车。

sentences.en: Strangely, none of that seemed to matter at all.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，这些似乎都不要紧。

sentences.en: Singing had become a means of feeling close to home.
sentences.zh: 唱歌成了一种让我感到贴近家乡的方式。

sentences.en: All I needed was a warm room and one good song.
sentences.zh: 我需要的只是一间温暖的屋子和一首好歌。

sentences.en: Then, late one evening, bad news arrived from China.
sentences.zh: 然而，一个深夜，坏消息从中国传来。

sentences.en: She had fallen ill and was resting in a hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 她病倒了，正躺在医院的病床上休息。

sentences.en: For two days, there was no clear word from the doctors.
sentences.zh: 整整两天，医生那边没有明确的消息。

sentences.en: I could do nothing useful from so far away.
sentences.zh: 隔着千山万水，我什么忙也帮不上。

sentences.en: I may have to fly back, I told the band sadly.
sentences.zh: 我难过地告诉乐队：我可能得飞回去。

sentences.en: The thought of an empty stage made everyone quiet.
sentences.zh: 一想到空空的舞台，大家都沉默了。

sentences.en: I was ready to miss the biggest show of the year.
sentences.zh: 我已准备好错过这一年最重要的演出。

sentences.en: That whole week, worry killed hours of sleep.
sentences.zh: 那一整周，担忧夺走了我大量的睡眠。

sentences.en: A few days later, the phone rang at dawn.
sentences.zh: 几天后，电话在黎明时分响起。

sentences.en: It was Mom, sounding weak but happy and alive.
sentences.zh: 是妈妈，声音虚弱，却快乐而有生气。

sentences.en: I am fine now, she said, so keep your dream going.
sentences.zh: 她说：我现在没事了，所以继续追你的梦吧。

sentences.en: At least promise one thing, she added softly.
sentences.zh: 她轻声补充：至少答应我一件事。

sentences.en: Let the world hear that voice of yours.
sentences.zh: 让世界听见你的声音。

sentences.en: I just cried and nodded at the phone screen.
sentences.zh: 我只是对着手机屏幕哭着点头。

sentences.en: Sometimes courage is a gift passed from one heart to another.
sentences.zh: 有时，勇气是从一颗心传给另一颗心的礼物。

sentences.en: Hers was now mine to carry onto the stage.
sentences.zh: 如今，她的勇气由我带上舞台。

sentences.en: The big evening arrived with the first cold winds of winter.
sentences.zh: 那个重要的夜晚随着初冬第一阵寒风到来。

sentences.en: It was not a normal show for any of us.
sentences.zh: 对我们任何人来说，这都不是一场普通的演出。

sentences.en: The hall was full, and a national radio station was there too.
sentences.zh: 大厅座无虚席，一家国家电台也来到了现场。

sentences.en: The old singer asked his youngest friend to lead the final song.
sentences.zh: 老歌手请他最年轻的朋友来领唱最后一首歌。

sentences.en: Under the lamps, singing felt as natural as breathing.
sentences.zh: 灯光下，歌唱如呼吸般自然。

sentences.en: A friend filmed the whole thing, like a small movie.
sentences.zh: 一位朋友把整场演出拍了下来，像一部小电影。

sentences.en: Back in China, Mom watched every second on her phone.
sentences.zh: 在中国，妈妈在手机上看了每一秒。

sentences.en: The judges gave our band the highest mark of the evening.
sentences.zh: 评委给了我们乐队全晚最高分。

sentences.en: We came second overall, yet I felt I had lost nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 我们总成绩第二，但我觉得自己什么也没有失去。

sentences.en: Winning, I understood, was never the key point.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，获胜从来都不是关键。

sentences.en: Singing is now a living part of each ordinary day.
sentences.zh: 如今，唱歌是每个平凡日子里鲜活的一部分。

sentences.en: There is, after all, no law against dreaming big.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，没有哪条法律禁止人拥有远大的梦想。

sentences.en: Most evenings, I still practice softly by the window.
sentences.zh: 大多数傍晚，我仍在窗边轻声练习。

sentences.en: Mom plans to visit in March to hear us play.
sentences.zh: 妈妈计划三月来看我们演出。

sentences.en: By then, every old fear will have left this heart.
sentences.zh: 到那时，所有旧日的恐惧都将离开这颗心。

sentences.en: That brave old singer became a model for the rest of my days.
sentences.zh: 那位勇敢的老歌手，成了我余生的榜样。

sentences.en: It was a cool morning in October, and the small town of Riverside was waking up.
sentences.zh: 那是十月一个凉爽的早晨，河畔小镇正在慢慢苏醒。

sentences.en: The town sat beside a quiet river in the north of the country.
sentences.zh: 小镇坐落在国家北部一条安静的河边。

sentences.en: Its population was small, but the people there were warm and friendly.
sentences.zh: 这里人口不多，但人们热情友好。

sentences.en: Anna taught science at the local school.
sentences.zh: 安娜在当地学校教科学。

sentences.en: She also ran a small radio show every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 每周六早上，她还主持一档小型电台节目。

sentences.en: Her show was popular with both old and young listeners.
sentences.zh: 她的节目在老少听众中都很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Listeners liked her honest voice and her simple, kind words.
sentences.zh: 听众们喜欢她真诚的声音和朴实温暖的话语。

sentences.en: One Saturday, a strange letter arrived at the station.
sentences.zh: 一个周六，一封奇怪的信寄到了电台。

sentences.en: Anna opened it and read it slowly.
sentences.zh: 安娜打开信，慢慢地读了起来。

sentences.en: The letter came from the mayor's office.
sentences.zh: 信来自市长办公室。

sentences.en: It said the beloved park by the water would soon be sold.
sentences.zh: 信上说，水边那座深受喜爱的公园很快就要被出售了。

sentences.en: A big oil company wanted to buy the land.
sentences.zh: 一家大石油公司想买下这块地。

sentences.en: The price they offered was very high.
sentences.zh: 他们出的价格非常高。

sentences.en: Anna felt a sharp pain in her heart when she finished reading.
sentences.zh: 读完信，安娜心里一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: It was a personal part of her childhood.
sentences.zh: 那座公园是她童年里一段很私人的记忆。

sentences.en: She remembered playing there as a little girl.
sentences.zh: 她记得小时候常在那里玩耍。

sentences.en: Her father had taught her to ride a bike on its round path.
sentences.zh: 父亲曾在那条环形小路上教她骑自行车。

sentences.en: Now those trees might be cut down for money.
sentences.zh: 如今那些树也许会为了钱而被砍掉。

sentences.en: "Oh, this cannot happen," she said to herself.
sentences.zh: “哦，这绝不能发生。”她对自己说。

sentences.en: She decided to do everything she could to save it.
sentences.zh: 她决定尽一切努力拯救它。

sentences.en: But she could not solve this problem alone; she needed other people to help.
sentences.zh: 但她无法独自解决这个问题，她需要其他人的帮助。

sentences.en: So she made a plan that same evening.
sentences.zh: 于是当天晚上，她就制定了一个计划。

sentences.en: Her first call was to Boris, a Russian musician who lived nearby.
sentences.zh: 她第一个打给了鲍里斯，一位住在附近的俄罗斯音乐家。

sentences.en: Boris was a warm person with a big white beard.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯是个热心人，留着一把白色的大胡子。

sentences.en: He often played rock music in the square on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 他常在周日于广场上演奏摇滚乐。

sentences.en: "Please help me," Anna said to him on the phone.
sentences.zh: “请帮帮我。”安娜在电话里对他说。

sentences.en: Boris agreed at once.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯立刻答应了。

sentences.en: "We should hold a big public performance," he suggested.
sentences.zh: “我们应该办一场盛大的公开演出。”他提议道。

sentences.en: "Music can bring everyone out of their homes."
sentences.zh: “音乐能把大家从家里吸引出来。”

sentences.en: For the first time that day, Anna really felt hope.
sentences.zh: 那天，安娜第一次真正感到了希望。

sentences.en: The next morning, she shared the news with her listeners.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，她把这个消息告诉了听众。

sentences.en: "Our green home is in danger," she told them.
sentences.zh: “我们的绿色家园正处于危险之中。”她告诉大家。

sentences.en: "This Saturday we will hold a party there to show that we care."
sentences.zh: “这个周六我们将在那里举办一场聚会，表明我们在乎它。”

sentences.en: "Everyone is welcome, rich or poor."
sentences.zh: “无论贫富，人人都欢迎。”

sentences.en: She also wrote a long report for the local paper.
sentences.zh: 她还为当地报纸写了一篇长篇报道。

sentences.en: It filled a whole page with facts about the land's history.
sentences.zh: 整整一版都是关于这块土地历史的事实。

sentences.en: She put posters along every road in town.
sentences.zh: 她在镇上每条路边都贴了海报。

sentences.en: Soon everyone was talking about Saturday.
sentences.zh: 很快，所有人都在谈论周六的事。

sentences.en: On Friday, an old man named Mr. Lee came to see Anna.
sentences.zh: 周五，一位名叫李先生的老人来见安娜。

sentences.en: He had worked at the town's post office for forty years.
sentences.zh: 他曾在镇上的邮局工作了四十年。

sentences.en: "There is a special piece of history you should know," he told her.
sentences.zh: “有一段特殊的历史你应该知道。”他告诉她。

sentences.en: "Long ago, a rich lady gave that land to the town as a present."
sentences.zh: “很久以前，一位富有的女士把那块地作为礼物送给了小镇。”

sentences.en: "She wrote that it must always belong to everyone."
sentences.zh: “她写明这块地必须永远属于所有人。”

sentences.en: "Somewhere there should still be a record of her gift."
sentences.zh: “某个地方应该还保存着她赠予的记录。”

sentences.en: Anna's eyes grew wide with hope.
sentences.zh: 安娜的眼睛因希望而睁大了。

sentences.en: If they found that document, the sale could be stopped.
sentences.zh: 如果找到那份文件，出售就能被阻止。

sentences.en: The search was hard, and time was short.
sentences.zh: 寻找并不容易，而且时间紧迫。

sentences.en: Anna and Boris looked through dusty boxes in the town hall.
sentences.zh: 安娜和鲍里斯在镇政厅里翻找落满灰尘的箱子。

sentences.en: They worked in a cold room for many hours.
sentences.zh: 他们在一间冰冷的房间里干了好几个小时。

sentences.en: It seemed like a race against the clock.
sentences.zh: 这就像一场与时间的赛跑。

sentences.en: Every minute mattered, and every second felt heavy.
sentences.zh: 每一分钟都很重要，每一秒都显得沉重。

sentences.en: "Perhaps we will never find it," Boris sighed.
sentences.zh: “也许我们永远也找不到它了。”鲍里斯叹道。

sentences.en: "There is no reason to give up yet," Anna answered.
sentences.zh: “现在还没有放弃的理由。”安娜回答。

sentences.en: "It is still possible, so keep looking."
sentences.zh: “仍然有可能，继续找吧。”

sentences.en: Late that night, Anna picked up a thin red folder.
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，安娜拿起一个薄薄的红色文件夹。

sentences.en: Her hands shook as she turned it over.
sentences.zh: 她把它翻过来时，双手在发抖。

sentences.en: Inside lay a yellowed sheet with a number stamped at the top.
sentences.zh: 里面是一张泛黄的纸，顶端盖着一个编号。

sentences.en: It was the real gift document from the past.
sentences.zh: 这正是那份来自过去的真正的赠予文件。

sentences.en: The point was clear: the land could never be sold.
sentences.zh: 要点很清楚：这块地永远不能出售。

sentences.en: "We found it!" Boris shouted with joy.
sentences.zh: “我们找到了！”鲍里斯高兴地喊道。

sentences.en: They made a copy right away to keep it safe.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻复印了一份，以确保它的安全。

sentences.en: Then they went home to rest before the big day.
sentences.zh: 然后他们回家休息，迎接重要的一天。

sentences.en: Saturday came with a bright autumn sun.
sentences.zh: 周六到了，秋日的阳光明媚。

sentences.en: It was the most beautiful season of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是一年中最美的季节。

sentences.en: Hundreds of families gathered outside in the fresh air.
sentences.zh: 数百户人家聚集在户外的新鲜空气中。

sentences.en: Boris and his band stood ready on a small stage.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯和他的乐队在小舞台上准备就绪。

sentences.en: The mayor asked the police to keep order in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 市长请警察维持人群的秩序。

sentences.en: But there was no trouble, only laughter and song.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何骚乱，只有欢笑和歌声。

sentences.en: The town had not felt such peace and joy in years.
sentences.zh: 小镇多年来从未感受过这样的平和与欢乐。

sentences.en: Even reporters from the national press arrived to watch.
sentences.zh: 甚至连全国性媒体的记者也赶来观看。

sentences.en: In the middle of the music, the mayor stepped onto the stage.
sentences.zh: 演出进行到一半时，市长走上了舞台。

sentences.en: Anna walked up and handed him the old document.
sentences.zh: 安娜走上前，把那份旧文件递给了他。

sentences.en: He studied it carefully, and his face slowly changed.
sentences.zh: 他仔细查看，脸色慢慢变了。

sentences.en: "I have a question for you," Anna said into the microphone.
sentences.zh: “我有一个问题要问您。”安娜对着麦克风说。

sentences.en: "Will you pay attention to the will of this town?"
sentences.zh: “您会重视这个小镇的意愿吗？”

sentences.en: The crowd moved closer to hear his answer.
sentences.zh: 人群向前涌去，想听他的回答。

sentences.en: "The result is clear," the mayor said at last.
sentences.zh: “结果很清楚。”市长最后说道。

sentences.en: "The park will stay, and the deal is off."
sentences.zh: “公园将保留下来，这笔交易取消了。”

sentences.en: A great cheer went up along the water.
sentences.zh: 欢呼声沿着河岸响起。

sentences.en: The company's lawyers had to return to the city with empty hands.
sentences.zh: 公司的律师们只好空手返回城市。

sentences.en: Anna's own heart felt light for the first time in weeks.
sentences.zh: 几周以来，安娜自己的心第一次感到轻松。

sentences.en: This place would belong to the children of the future.
sentences.zh: 这个地方将属于未来的孩子们。

sentences.en: It would probably become even more loved than before.
sentences.zh: 它可能会比以前更受人喜爱。

sentences.en: A recent survey showed that nearly everyone supported the decision.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项调查显示，几乎所有人都支持这个决定。

sentences.en: The newspaper printed a warm review of the whole event.
sentences.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇对整个活动的热情评论。

sentences.en: One writer called it "a rather special day for a small town."
sentences.zh: 一位作者称之为“小镇上相当特别的一天”。

sentences.en: Weeks later, life felt normal again, but something had changed.
sentences.zh: 几周后，生活恢复了平常，但有些东西已经不同了。

sentences.en: The town believed in its power to act together.
sentences.zh: 小镇相信了团结行动的力量。

sentences.en: Anna kept teaching and kept her weekend show.
sentences.zh: 安娜继续教书，也继续主持她的周末节目。

sentences.en: Boris gives a free concert under the trees every month.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯每个月都在树下举办一场免费音乐会。

sentences.en: Sometimes they walk by the water and dream of visiting the sea.
sentences.zh: 有时他们沿河散步，梦想着去看大海。

sentences.en: The green land provides a quiet home for birds and dreams alike.
sentences.zh: 这片绿地为鸟儿和梦想提供了一个安静的家。

sentences.en: Its potential to bring the town together was pretty clear to all.
sentences.zh: 它凝聚小镇的潜力，如今大家都看得非常清楚。

sentences.en: And that, quite simply, is how one small voice can pass hope to many.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，这就是一个微小的声音如何把希望传递给众人的故事。

articles.title: The Runner from the Small Town

sentences.en: Mia lived in a small town far from the big cities.
sentences.zh: 米娅住在一个远离大城市的小镇上。

sentences.en: A quiet river ran along the south side of it.
sentences.zh: 一条安静的小河沿着小镇的南侧流过。

sentences.en: When September came, a new school term began.
sentences.zh: 九月到了，新学期开始了。

sentences.en: On the first day, a teacher put a sign on a table near the school gate.
sentences.zh: 开学第一天，一位老师在校门口的桌子上放了一块告示牌。

sentences.en: It said the running club would start its training that week.
sentences.zh: 上面写着跑步社团本周开始训练。

sentences.en: Mia stopped in front of it and read the sign twice.
sentences.zh: 米娅在牌子前停下脚步，把告示看了两遍。

sentences.en: She had loved running since she was a little girl.
sentences.zh: 她从小就热爱跑步。

sentences.en: She began running when she was only seven years old.
sentences.zh: 她七岁时就开始跑步了。

sentences.en: That afternoon, she went home and talked with her family.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，她回到家和家人谈了谈。

sentences.en: Her father worked in a store on the main street.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲在大街上的一家商店里工作。

sentences.en: Her brother Leo loved music and sang the same song every morning.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟利奥喜欢音乐，每天早晨都唱着同一首歌。

sentences.en: Her father often joked that his son would keep the shop one day.
sentences.zh: 父亲常开玩笑说，将来这家店会交给儿子打理。

sentences.en: 'I want to join the running club,' Mia told them at dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭时，米娅告诉他们：“我想加入跑步社团。”

sentences.en: Her father was quiet for a moment, and then he smiled.
sentences.zh: 父亲沉默了一会儿，然后笑了。

sentences.en: 'Running is a fine thing,' he said, 'but you must not forget your study.'
sentences.zh: 他说：“跑步是件好事，但你不能耽误学习。”

sentences.en: 'I shall do both, I promise,' Mia answered.
sentences.zh: 米娅回答：“我保证两样都做好。”

sentences.en: The next day, she took an early bus from the station near her house.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她从家附近的车站坐上了早班公交车。

sentences.en: The club met at the old track behind the school.
sentences.zh: 社团在学校后面的旧跑道上集合。

sentences.en: Six other students were already warming up together.
sentences.zh: 另外六名学生已经在一起做热身了。

sentences.en: The coach was a tall old man with a strong voice.
sentences.zh: 教练是位高个子的老人，嗓音洪亮有力。

sentences.en: 'Call me Coach Ray, not sir,' he said with a laugh.
sentences.zh: 他笑着说：“叫我雷教练就行，别叫先生。”

sentences.en: 'On this track, we speak the truth about our effort.'
sentences.zh: “在这条跑道上，我们对自己的努力说实话。”

sentences.en: He asked each runner to complete a short test.
sentences.zh: 他让每个队员完成一次简短的测试。

sentences.en: Mia ran three laps as fast as she could.
sentences.zh: 米娅用最快的速度跑了三圈。

sentences.en: Her time was not bad, but it was not great — it was just so-so.
sentences.zh: 她的成绩不算差，但也不出色——只能说一般般。

sentences.en: 'You have natural speed,' the coach said, 'but speed alone is not enough.'
sentences.zh: 教练说：“你有天生的速度，但光有速度是不够的。”

sentences.en: So Mia began to train every day after class.
sentences.zh: 于是，米娅开始每天放学后训练。

sentences.en: The work was harder than anything she had done before.
sentences.zh: 这些训练比她以前做过的任何事都难。

sentences.en: Some days she wanted to quit, but she kept going.
sentences.zh: 有些日子她真想放弃，但还是坚持了下来。

sentences.en: Step by step, her legs grew stronger and her breath grew calm.
sentences.zh: 一步一步地，她的双腿越来越有力，呼吸也越来越平稳。

sentences.en: She learned to keep her back straight and to save energy on the turns.
sentences.zh: 她学会了保持背部挺直，并在弯道上节省体力。

sentences.en: At night she went to sleep early, tired but happy.
sentences.zh: 晚上她早早入睡，虽然疲惫却很快乐。

sentences.en: Several weeks passed, and the warm days of late summer slowly faded.
sentences.zh: 几个星期过去了，夏末温暖的日子渐渐远去。

sentences.en: This new life felt right to her.
sentences.zh: 这种新生活让她觉得很对味。

sentences.en: One day, Coach Ray asked the team to stand around him.
sentences.zh: 一天，雷教练让队员们站到他周围。

sentences.en: 'The city race is in ten days, and runners from across the state will come,' he announced.
sentences.zh: 他宣布：“市里的比赛还有十天，全州各地的选手都会来。”

sentences.en: 'Our school can send only a single runner this year.'
sentences.zh: “今年我们学校只能派出一名选手。”

sentences.en: 'The one with the best total score in practice will go.'
sentences.zh: “训练中总成绩最好的人将代表学校出赛。”

sentences.en: Everyone looked at Mia and at a tall boy named Dan.
sentences.zh: 大家都把目光投向米娅和一个叫丹的高个子男孩。

sentences.en: Dan had won a city medal before, and he was the star of the team.
sentences.zh: 丹以前拿过市级奖牌，是队里的明星。

sentences.en: 'May the best runner win,' Dan said, and they shook hands.
sentences.zh: 丹说：“愿最强者获胜。”两人握了握手。

sentences.en: Three days before the final practice, something went wrong.
sentences.zh: 最后一次选拔训练前三天，出了意外。

sentences.en: Mia slipped on a wet rock by the river and twisted her ankle.
sentences.zh: 米娅在河边一块湿石头上滑倒，扭伤了脚踝。

sentences.en: The pain was serious, and she could hardly walk home.
sentences.zh: 伤得很严重，她几乎走不回家。

sentences.en: That night she lay awake, full of dark thoughts.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上她躺在床上睡不着，满脑子都是灰暗的念头。

sentences.en: 'Maybe I should just stop trying,' she whispered.
sentences.zh: 她轻声说：“也许我该放弃努力了。”

sentences.en: 'Someone like Dan deserves the place more than I do.'
sentences.zh: “像丹那样的人比我更配得上那个名额。”

sentences.en: The next morning, her brother Leo came into her room.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，弟弟利奥走进她的房间。

sentences.en: 'I heard you talking to yourself last night,' he said quietly.
sentences.zh: 他小声说：“我昨晚听见你在自言自语。”

sentences.en: 'You once read me a story about a runner who fell and got up again.'
sentences.zh: “你以前给我读过一个故事，讲一个跑步的人摔倒了又爬起来。”

sentences.en: 'Was that story true, or did you make it up?'
sentences.zh: “那个故事是真的，还是你编出来的？”

sentences.en: Mia laughed for the first time in days and said it was all real.
sentences.zh: 米娅几天来第一次笑了，说那都是真的。

sentences.en: Then her father sent a text from the shop: 'Rest now, run tomorrow.'
sentences.zh: 接着父亲从店里发来短信：“先休息，明天再跑。”

sentences.en: 'Thank you,' she wrote back, and she felt warm inside.
sentences.zh: 她回了句“谢谢”，心里暖暖的。

sentences.en: Mia stayed off her feet for two days and cared for her ankle.
sentences.zh: 米娅休息了两天，好好照顾自己的脚踝。

sentences.en: She was sure the pain would pass if she was patient.
sentences.zh: 她确信只要有耐心，疼痛就会过去。

sentences.en: On the day of the final practice, the sky was clear and bright.
sentences.zh: 最后选拔那天，天空晴朗明亮。

sentences.en: Though the ankle still hurt a little, her heart felt calm.
sentences.zh: 虽然脚踝还有点疼，她的心却很平静。

sentences.en: 'Today I will show them what I can do,' she said to herself.
sentences.zh: 她对自己说：“今天我要让他们看看我的实力。”

sentences.en: The runners set off, and Dan took the lead at once.
sentences.zh: 选手们出发了，丹立刻冲到了最前面。

sentences.en: Mia followed close behind him through the first two laps.
sentences.zh: 前两圈，米娅紧紧跟在他身后。

sentences.en: In the third lap, she found open space on the inside and passed him.
sentences.zh: 第三圈时，她在内道找到空当，超了过去。

sentences.en: Her final result was two seconds better than Dan's best.
sentences.zh: 她的最终成绩比丹的最好成绩快了两秒。

sentences.en: And so it was Mia who traveled to the city race.
sentences.zh: 就这样，去参加市级比赛的人是米娅。

sentences.en: The stadium was super big, larger than any place she had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 体育场特别大，比她见过的任何地方都大。

sentences.en: Runners of every size stood at the line, tall and short alike.
sentences.zh: 各种身材的选手站在起跑线上，有高有矮。

sentences.en: Mia's heart beat fast, but she was excited, too.
sentences.zh: 米娅心跳得很快，但她也很兴奋。

sentences.en: When the gun sounded, she moved forward like water.
sentences.zh: 发令枪一响，她像流水一样冲了出去。

sentences.en: She did not win first place, but she finished in the top three.
sentences.zh: 她没有拿到第一，但跑进了前三名。

sentences.en: For a runner from such a quiet little town, it was a real success.
sentences.zh: 对一个来自这样安静小镇的选手来说，这是真正的成功。

sentences.en: 'I am sorry I ever doubted you,' Dan said when she came home.
sentences.zh: 她回来时，丹说：“对不起，我曾经怀疑过你。”

sentences.en: That evening, the town held a warm party on the main street.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，小镇在大街上举办了一场热闹的庆祝会。

sentences.en: People from every corner of local society came to share the joy.
sentences.zh: 镇上各行各业的人都赶来分享这份喜悦。

sentences.en: Even Mr. Chen, who ran the small trade office, gave a special speech.
sentences.zh: 连经营小贸易所的陈先生也发表了一段特别的讲话。

sentences.en: 'These young people show us the future,' he said, raising his cup.
sentences.zh: 他举起杯子说：“这些年轻人让我们看到了未来。”

sentences.en: 'They worked hard and believed in themselves.'
sentences.zh: “他们努力拼搏，并且相信自己。”

sentences.en: 'Tonight we celebrate, and soon we will cheer for them again.'
sentences.zh: “今晚我们庆祝，不久之后我们还会再次为他们喝彩。”

sentences.en: Later, Mia and Leo walked home under the quiet stars.
sentences.zh: 后来，米娅和利奥在静静的星空下走路回家。

sentences.en: 'Will you still run when you are old?' Leo asked.
sentences.zh: 利奥问：“你老了以后还会跑步吗？”

sentences.en: 'I think I will run all my life,' Mia said.
sentences.zh: 米娅说：“我想我会跑一辈子。”

sentences.en: 'There is always another race, and always another chance.'
sentences.zh: “永远会有下一场比赛，也永远会有下一次机会。”

sentences.en: 'And those who keep going will always find their way.'
sentences.zh: “坚持向前的人，总能找到属于自己的路。”

sentences.en: The moon rose over the river, and the little town went to sleep in peace.
sentences.zh: 月亮升上河面，小镇在安宁中入睡了。

sentences.en: Mei was a young woman from a small town.
sentences.zh: 梅是一个来自小镇的年轻女子。

sentences.en: Her aunt, whose little shop sold fruit, had raised her.
sentences.zh: 抚养她长大的姨妈开着一家卖水果的小店。

sentences.en: Every morning Mei would help in the shop before school.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，梅都会在上学前到店里帮忙。

sentences.en: She often gave an apple to the children who passed by.
sentences.zh: 她常常把苹果送给路过的孩子们。

sentences.en: But deep in her heart, she had a big dream.
sentences.zh: 但在她内心深处，藏着一个大大的梦想。

sentences.en: She wanted to become an artist.
sentences.zh: 她想成为一名画家。

sentences.en: She dreamed of painting the whole world.
sentences.zh: 她梦想画出整个世界。

sentences.en: Her walls were covered with drawings of every animal she had seen.
sentences.zh: 她的墙上贴满了她见过的各种动物的画。

sentences.en: One day, a special letter arrived at the shop.
sentences.zh: 一天，一封特别的信寄到了店里。

sentences.en: It came from a university far away in the west.
sentences.zh: 信来自遥远西方的一所大学。

sentences.en: The school offered her a place to study western art.
sentences.zh: 那所学校邀请她去学习西方艺术。

sentences.en: Her aunt read it slowly and said nothing.
sentences.zh: 姨妈慢慢地读完信，一言不发。

sentences.en: Then her face turned white.
sentences.zh: 接着她的脸变得煞白。

sentences.en: 'You cannot go,' she said in a low voice.
sentences.zh: “你不能去，”她低声说。

sentences.en: 'We cannot afford such a school.'
sentences.zh: “我们负担不起这样的学校。”

sentences.en: Mei tried to explain why this chance mattered so much.
sentences.zh: 梅试着解释为什么这个机会如此重要。

sentences.en: 'It is my one way to a better life,' she said.
sentences.zh: “这是我通向更好生活的唯一道路，”她说。

sentences.en: But her aunt did not agree.
sentences.zh: 但姨妈不同意。

sentences.en: 'It is wrong to leave family behind,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “丢下家人是不对的，”她回答。

sentences.en: That night, the two of them did not speak another word.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她们俩再没说一句话。

sentences.en: A week later, Mei packed her bags in silence.
sentences.zh: 一周后，梅默默地收拾好行李。

sentences.en: She did not know whether she was making the right choice.
sentences.zh: 她不知道自己的选择是否正确。

sentences.en: Yet she felt she had to try.
sentences.zh: 然而她觉得自己必须试一试。

sentences.en: At the airport, she sat alone and had to wait for hours.
sentences.zh: 在机场，她独自坐着，等了好几个小时。

sentences.en: She watched a huge aircraft rise slowly into the clouds.
sentences.zh: 她看着一架巨大的飞机缓缓升入云端。

sentences.en: The airline worker checked the weight of her bag and smiled.
sentences.zh: 航空公司的工作人员称了她行李的重量，笑了笑。

sentences.en: Mei looked back one last time, but no one had come.
sentences.zh: 梅最后回头看了一眼，但没有人来送她。

sentences.en: She stood up when her flight was called.
sentences.zh: 叫到她的航班时，她站起身来。

sentences.en: Soon she was flying high above the sea, far away from home.
sentences.zh: 很快，她就飞过大海，远离了家乡。

sentences.en: When she arrived, everything felt new and strange.
sentences.zh: 她到达时，一切都显得陌生而新鲜。

sentences.en: She could not understand people if they spoke fast.
sentences.zh: 别人说话太快时，她听不懂。

sentences.en: She used a small dictionary every single day.
sentences.zh: 她每天都要用一本小词典。

sentences.en: Slowly, she learned each new type of phrase.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，她学会了各种新句式。

sentences.en: Her English improved, and soon she could speak quite well.
sentences.zh: 她的英语进步了，很快就能说得很不错。

sentences.en: She chose the class which taught oil painting.
sentences.zh: 她选了教油画的那门课。

sentences.en: She attended every lesson, even the early ones.
sentences.zh: 每节课她都去上，连早课也不落下。

sentences.en: Usually she studied until midnight.
sentences.zh: 她通常学习到半夜。

sentences.en: Some nights she fell asleep at her desk, a brush still in her hand.
sentences.zh: 有些夜晚，她趴在书桌上睡着了，手里还握着画笔。

sentences.en: Life abroad was harder than she had imagined.
sentences.zh: 国外的生活比她想象的更艰难。

sentences.en: Still, she believed the pain was worth it.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她相信这些辛苦是值得的。

sentences.en: To pay her rent, Mei worked as an assistant to a painter.
sentences.zh: 为了付房租，梅给一位画家当助手。

sentences.en: He was a well-known artist in the city.
sentences.zh: 他是城里一位知名的艺术家。

sentences.en: His works hung in famous halls around the world.
sentences.zh: 他的作品挂在世界各地著名的展厅里。

sentences.en: Mei cleaned brushes and carried water for him every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 每天下午，梅都为他清洗画笔、打水。

sentences.en: Sometimes he let her use his finest brushes.
sentences.zh: 有时他让她用自己最好的画笔。

sentences.en: 'You have real ability,' he told her one day.
sentences.zh: “你很有天赋，”有一天他对她说。

sentences.en: 'But an artist must find her own voice,' he added.
sentences.zh: “但艺术家必须找到自己的声音，”他补充道。

sentences.en: 'Paint what is true to yourself.'
sentences.zh: “画那些对你自己而言真实的东西。”

sentences.en: Mei thought about his advice for a long time.
sentences.zh: 梅把他的建议思考了很久。

sentences.en: In her second year, Mei felt very lonely.
sentences.zh: 第二年，梅感到非常孤独。

sentences.en: She often walked by the river at night.
sentences.zh: 夜里她常常在河边散步。

sentences.en: She missed the small kitchen and her aunt's warm cooking.
sentences.zh: 她想念那间小厨房和姨妈热腾腾的饭菜。

sentences.en: She wondered where her life was going.
sentences.zh: 她不知道自己的人生将走向何方。

sentences.en: Was her dream still alive, or had it quietly died?
sentences.zh: 她的梦想还活着吗，还是已经悄悄死去？

sentences.en: She was afraid that she had also been wrong.
sentences.zh: 她害怕自己当初也做错了。

sentences.en: One evening she found an old photo under her books.
sentences.zh: 一天傍晚，她在书堆下发现一张旧照片。

sentences.en: In it, a little girl sat upon strong shoulders like a small angel.
sentences.zh: 照片里，一个小女孩坐在结实的肩膀上，像个小天使。

sentences.en: Tears fell, and an idea slowly began to grow in her mind.
sentences.zh: 泪水落下，一个想法慢慢在她心中生长。

sentences.en: That month, there was a video contest for young film makers.
sentences.zh: 那个月，有一个面向年轻电影人的视频比赛。

sentences.en: The winner would travel to film wild places in Africa.
sentences.zh: 获胜者可以去非洲拍摄野外风光。

sentences.en: Mei decided to make a film about the woman who raised her.
sentences.zh: 梅决定拍一部关于抚养她长大的那位女性的影片。

sentences.en: She began to write the story of the little shop.
sentences.zh: 她开始写那家小店的故事。

sentences.en: She drew tired arms, rough hands, and kind old eyes.
sentences.zh: 她画下疲惫的手臂、粗糙的双手和慈祥的眼睛。

sentences.en: Every picture carried love, like an arrow straight to the heart.
sentences.zh: 每一幅画都饱含爱意，像一支直射人心的箭。

sentences.en: Whatever free time she had, she gave to the project.
sentences.zh: 只要有空闲时间，她都投入到这个项目中。

sentences.en: While she worked on it, she forgot her loneliness.
sentences.zh: 做这件事的时候，她忘记了孤独。

sentences.en: Her teacher said the film would attract many hearts.
sentences.zh: 老师说这部影片会打动许多人。

sentences.en: For the first time in months, Mei felt active and happy again.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，梅第一次重新感到充满活力和快乐。

sentences.en: On the night of the contest, the hall was completely full.
sentences.zh: 比赛当晚，大厅里座无虚席。

sentences.en: Students from many Arab and Asian countries sat together.
sentences.zh: 来自许多阿拉伯和亚洲国家的学生坐在一起。

sentences.en: Films from Asia and Europe played one by one.
sentences.zh: 来自亚洲和欧洲的影片一部接一部地放映。

sentences.en: When Mei's film began, the room grew quiet.
sentences.zh: 梅的影片开始时，整个房间安静了下来。

sentences.en: People saw an old shop and a life of quiet work.
sentences.zh: 人们看到一家老店，和一段默默劳作的人生。

sentences.en: Yes, it was simple, but it was honest.
sentences.zh: 是的，它很朴素，但很真诚。

sentences.en: Mei did not win first prize.
sentences.zh: 梅没有赢得一等奖。

sentences.en: Instead, she received a special gift: a free ticket to anywhere.
sentences.zh: 然而，她得到了一份特别的礼物：一张飞往任何地方的免费机票。

sentences.en: Mei knew at once where she wished to go.
sentences.zh: 梅立刻知道自己想去哪里。

sentences.en: She did not choose Africa or any famous city.
sentences.zh: 她没有选择非洲，也没有选任何名城。

sentences.en: She flew home to visit her aunt.
sentences.zh: 她飞回家乡去看望姨妈。

sentences.en: During the whole flight, she practiced her apology.
sentences.zh: 整个航程中，她都在练习自己的道歉。

sentences.en: 'I never said sorry for those angry things,' she thought.
sentences.zh: “我从没为那些气话道过歉，”她想。

sentences.en: Her heart beat fast as the plane touched the ground.
sentences.zh: 飞机落地时，她的心跳得飞快。

sentences.en: At the gate stood a small figure with gray hair.
sentences.zh: 出口处站着一个头发花白的瘦小身影。

sentences.en: Her aunt had come to the airport to meet her.
sentences.zh: 姨妈来机场接她了。

sentences.en: 'I want to apologize,' Mei said, holding her tight.
sentences.zh: “我想向你道歉，”梅紧紧抱着她说。

sentences.en: 'I left without thinking about your feelings.'
sentences.zh: “我走的时候没有考虑你的感受。”

sentences.en: 'No, I must accept part of the blame,' the old lady said softly.
sentences.zh: “不，我也该承担一部分责任，”老人轻声说。

sentences.en: 'I was afraid to lose you, so I held on too hard.'
sentences.zh: “我害怕失去你，所以抓得太紧了。”

sentences.en: That evening, they cooked dinner together like in the old days.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她们像从前一样一起做晚饭。

sentences.en: Mei showed the video on her phone.
sentences.zh: 梅在手机上放了那段视频。

sentences.en: 'Making it was my favorite activity at school,' she laughed.
sentences.zh: “拍这个是我在学校最喜欢的活动，”她笑着说。

sentences.en: Her aunt watched it three times, smiling and crying alike.
sentences.zh: 姨妈看了三遍，边笑边哭。

sentences.en: The neighbor's wife came over to see it too.
sentences.zh: 邻居家的妻子也过来看。

sentences.en: 'There is no war between love and dreams,' her aunt said.
sentences.zh: “爱与梦想之间并没有战争，”姨妈说。

sentences.en: 'A family can hold both, if both sides understand.'
sentences.zh: “只要双方都能理解，一个家可以同时容下这两样。”

sentences.en: Mei promised to call home every week from then on.
sentences.zh: 梅保证从那以后每周都给家里打电话。

sentences.en: 'And next time, I will take you to see my show,' she said.
sentences.zh: “下次我要带你去看我的画展，”她说。

sentences.en: Now she had a clear advantage in life: a dream and a home.
sentences.zh: 如今她拥有了人生中最珍贵的优势：一个梦想，和一个家。

sentences.en: Jack was a thirteen-year-old Australian boy with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 杰克是个十三岁的澳大利亚男孩，脸上总挂着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: Last autumn, he crossed the sea to live with his Aunt Rose.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，他漂洋过海去和罗丝姑妈一起生活。

sentences.en: She lived in a small town in Canada, near a wide river.
sentences.zh: 她住在加拿大一个小镇上，旁边有一条宽阔的河。

sentences.en: A slow bus carried him from the airport to her quiet street.
sentences.zh: 一辆慢悠悠的公共汽车把他从机场载到了她所在的安静街道。

sentences.en: Outside the window, one soft white cloud hung in the grey sky.
sentences.zh: 窗外，一朵柔软的白云挂在灰色的天空中。

sentences.en: When he arrived, Rose hugged him warmly at the front door.
sentences.zh: 他到达时，罗丝在门口热情地拥抱了他。

sentences.en: 'Welcome home, dear,' she said, taking his heavy winter coat.
sentences.zh: “欢迎回家，亲爱的。”她一边说，一边接过他厚重的冬季大衣。

sentences.en: His new bedroom was small, but it felt warm and safe.
sentences.zh: 他的新卧室不大，却让人感到温暖而安心。

sentences.en: A round clock ticked softly on the wall above the desk.
sentences.zh: 书桌上方的墙上，一只圆形的钟轻轻地滴答作响。

sentences.en: The ceiling was painted light blue, like a morning sky.
sentences.zh: 天花板被漆成了淡蓝色，像清晨的天空。

sentences.en: Every day, bright sunshine poured in through the little window.
sentences.zh: 每天，明亮的阳光都会从小窗户里洒进来。

sentences.en: Rose kept a lazy cat named Coal, black as a piece of coal.
sentences.zh: 罗丝养了一只懒洋洋的猫，名叫“煤球”，浑身黑得像一块煤。

sentences.en: In the corner stood a cage with a small yellow bird inside.
sentences.zh: 屋角立着一个笼子，里面养着一只黄色的小鸟。

sentences.en: 'You can borrow my old bike to ride to school,' Rose said.
sentences.zh: “你可以借我的旧自行车骑去上学。”罗丝说。

sentences.en: For the first time in weeks, Jack felt truly at home.
sentences.zh: 几个星期以来，杰克第一次真正有了家的感觉。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose owned a little bakery in the centre of town.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姑妈在镇中心开了一家小面包店。

sentences.en: Every morning she woke Jack early for a simple breakfast.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，她都会早早叫醒杰克吃一顿简单的早餐。

sentences.en: They usually ate warm bread with sweet butter and honey.
sentences.zh: 他们通常吃抹着甜黄油和蜂蜜的热面包。

sentences.en: Sometimes Jack cut a banana into a bowl of cold milk.
sentences.zh: 有时杰克会把一根香蕉切进一碗凉牛奶里。

sentences.en: On lucky days there was a thick piece of cheese as well.
sentences.zh: 运气好的时候，还会有一大块奶酪。

sentences.en: A small bell rang over the shop door whenever a customer entered.
sentences.zh: 每当有顾客进门，店门上的小铃铛就会响起来。

sentences.en: Rose's famous cake was the best-seller of the whole shop.
sentences.zh: 罗丝的招牌蛋糕是全店最畅销的商品。

sentences.en: People in town said it tasted like a sweet dream.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人都说，它的味道就像一场甜美的梦。

sentences.en: School kept Jack very busy from Monday to Friday.
sentences.zh: 从周一到周五，学校的生活让杰克非常忙碌。

sentences.en: His classroom was on the second floor, facing the playground.
sentences.zh: 他的教室在二楼，正对着操场。

sentences.en: In biology, he learned how a bee finds its flowers.
sentences.zh: 在生物课上，他学到了蜜蜂是如何找到花朵的。

sentences.en: Chemistry was harder, but a clever girl named Emma helped him.
sentences.zh: 化学要难一些，不过一个叫艾玛的聪明女孩常常帮他。

sentences.en: She drew a simple chart to explain every difficult lesson.
sentences.zh: 她会画一张简单的图表来讲解每一节难懂的课。

sentences.en: After class, Jack often played basketball with the other boys.
sentences.zh: 放学后，杰克经常和其他男孩一起打篮球。

sentences.en: On sunny weekends, some of them played baseball in the park.
sentences.zh: 在晴朗的周末，他们中有些人会去公园打棒球。

sentences.en: Slowly, this new country began to feel like his own.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，这个陌生的国家开始有了属于他的感觉。

sentences.en: On Saturdays, Jack and Emma liked to explore the town together.
sentences.zh: 每逢周六，杰克和艾玛喜欢一起在镇上四处探索。

sentences.en: They walked across the old stone bridge above the cold river.
sentences.zh: 他们走过横跨冰冷河面的古老石桥。

sentences.en: An old man called Captain Lee kept a small boat there.
sentences.zh: 一位叫李船长的老人在那里停着一条小船。

sentences.en: He always wore a blue cap and told stories of the sea.
sentences.zh: 他总是戴着一顶蓝色的帽子，讲着大海的故事。

sentences.en: Once, he said, he had met a bear near a summer camp.
sentences.zh: 他说，有一次他曾在一个夏令营附近遇到过一头熊。

sentences.en: The two friends would climb the hill to watch the sunset.
sentences.zh: 这两个朋友常常爬上小山去看日落。

sentences.en: In warmer months, people swam at a little beach by the lake.
sentences.zh: 在暖和的月份，人们会在湖边的小沙滩上游泳。

sentences.en: But now the wind grew cold, and winter was coming fast.
sentences.zh: 但如今寒风渐起，冬天正快步逼近。

sentences.en: Then, one grey morning, everything suddenly changed.
sentences.zh: 然而，在一个灰暗的早晨，一切突然改变了。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose felt awful and could hardly stand up.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姑妈感到非常难受，几乎站不起来。

sentences.en: She was breathing badly, so Jack called the doctor at once.
sentences.zh: 她呼吸很困难，于是杰克立刻打电话叫了医生。

sentences.en: At the hospital, the tests showed an early cancer.
sentences.zh: 在医院里，检查结果显示是早期癌症。

sentences.en: The doctors said it was found in time, but she needed weeks of rest.
sentences.zh: 医生说发现得很及时，但她需要休养好几个星期。

sentences.en: That night, Jack lay awake for hours in the dark.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，杰克在黑暗中躺了好几个小时，毫无睡意。

sentences.en: His mind went blank with fear and worry.
sentences.zh: 他的脑子因恐惧和担忧而一片空白。

sentences.en: This town was the place of Rose's birth, and everyone loved her.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇是罗丝出生的地方，这里的每个人都爱她。

sentences.en: The town's Christmas celebration was only three weeks away.
sentences.zh: 小镇的圣诞庆祝活动只剩下三个星期了。

sentences.en: Every year, Rose baked her famous chocolate cake for that night.
sentences.zh: 每年，罗丝都会为那个夜晚烤制她著名的巧克力蛋糕。

sentences.en: A local TV channel even planned to broadcast the party.
sentences.zh: 一家当地电视频道甚至打算直播这场晚会。

sentences.en: 'We must cancel my order this year,' Rose said sadly from her bed.
sentences.zh: “今年我们只能取消订单了。”罗丝躺在床上难过地说。

sentences.en: Jack shook his head slowly and took her hand.
sentences.zh: 杰克缓缓摇了摇头，握住她的手。

sentences.en: 'I beg you, teach me the recipe from your bed,' he said.
sentences.zh: “求求您，就在床上教我这个配方吧。”他说。

sentences.en: It was a huge challenge, but at last Rose agreed.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战，但罗丝最终还是同意了。

sentences.en: Besides, that special evening was also Jack's fourteenth birthday.
sentences.zh: 此外，那个特别的夜晚也正是杰克的十四岁生日。

sentences.en: 'Then we must choose the finest recipe I know,' Rose smiled.
sentences.zh: “那我们就要选我最拿手的配方。”罗丝笑着说。

sentences.en: The first practice in the kitchen was a complete disaster.
sentences.zh: 厨房里的第一次练习是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: Jack forgot the time, and the mixture began to burn.
sentences.zh: 杰克忘了时间，面糊开始烧焦了。

sentences.en: Black smoke rose up and filled the whole kitchen.
sentences.zh: 黑烟升起，弥漫了整个厨房。

sentences.en: Then a bottle of milk fell down with a loud bang.
sentences.zh: 接着，一瓶牛奶“砰”的一声重重摔了下来。

sentences.en: It lay broken in white pieces across the floor.
sentences.zh: 瓶子摔得粉碎，白色的碎片散落一地。

sentences.en: Coal ran away in fear and hid under a chair.
sentences.zh: “煤球”吓得跑开，躲到了一把椅子底下。

sentences.en: The second try stuck fast to the bottom of the pan.
sentences.zh: 第二次尝试又牢牢粘在了烤盘底部。

sentences.en: 'Be careful with the heat,' Rose called from upstairs.
sentences.zh: “小心火候！”罗丝在楼上喊道。

sentences.en: 'And always brush the pan with a little oil first!'
sentences.zh: “还有，记得先在烤盘上刷一点油！”

sentences.en: Jack cleaned up the mess and told his tired brain not to give up.
sentences.zh: 杰克收拾干净残局，告诉自己疲惫的大脑不要放弃。

sentences.en: The next afternoon, Emma came over to help him.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，艾玛过来帮他。

sentences.en: 'Read each step clearly before you start,' she told him.
sentences.zh: “动手之前，先把每一个步骤读清楚。”她对他说。

sentences.en: She was Canadian, always calm and practical about everything.
sentences.zh: 她是加拿大人，做任何事都冷静而务实。

sentences.en: 'Rose learned this recipe in Britain many years ago,' she added.
sentences.zh: “罗丝是很多年前在英国学到这个配方的。”她补充道。

sentences.en: Together they rode to the market with a big empty basket.
sentences.zh: 他们提着一个大空篮子，一起骑车去了集市。

sentences.en: Eggs were cheap that week, only a few cents each.
sentences.zh: 那个星期鸡蛋很便宜，一个只要几美分。

sentences.en: A friendly farmer stood by his cart, selling fresh beef and chicken.
sentences.zh: 一位和善的农夫站在货车旁，卖着新鲜的牛肉和鸡肉。

sentences.en: Behind him, a proud cock walked in a circle around his hens.
sentences.zh: 在他身后，一只神气的公鸡绕着母鸡们转圈踱步。

sentences.en: A tiny yellow chick followed its mother through the straw.
sentences.zh: 一只黄色的小鸡跟着妈妈在稻草间穿行。

sentences.en: For the adults at the party, they also ordered some ginger beer.
sentences.zh: 为了晚会上的大人们，他们还订了一些姜汁啤酒。

sentences.en: Jack paid, said bye to the farmer, and hurried home happily.
sentences.zh: 杰克付了钱，跟农夫道了别，然后开开心心地赶回家。

sentences.en: For a whole week, Jack practised in the kitchen every evening.
sentences.zh: 整整一个星期，杰克每天晚上都在厨房里练习。

sentences.en: Rose sat beside him, giving quiet advice in a soft voice.
sentences.zh: 罗丝坐在他身旁，用轻柔的声音给他指点。

sentences.en: 'Don't open the oven early, or cold air will blow inside,' she warned.
sentences.zh: “别提前开烤箱，不然冷空气会吹进去。”她提醒道。

sentences.en: At last, one evening, an attempt came out golden and perfect.
sentences.zh: 终于，在一个晚上，一次尝试烤出了金黄完美的成品。

sentences.en: Rose tasted it with her eyes closed, like a blind judge.
sentences.zh: 罗丝闭着眼睛品尝，像一位蒙眼的评委。

sentences.en: 'Perfect,' she whispered, and Jack jumped with pure joy.
sentences.zh: “完美。”她轻声说，杰克高兴得跳了起来。

sentences.en: On the big day, Jack took a hot bath early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 大日子那天，杰克一大早就洗了个热水澡。

sentences.en: Then he put on his best clothes for the party.
sentences.zh: 然后他穿上了最好的衣服去参加晚会。

sentences.en: One button was loose, so Rose sewed it back with care.
sentences.zh: 有一颗纽扣松了，罗丝细心地把它缝好。

sentences.en: He wiped his winter boots with a soft piece of cloth.
sentences.zh: 他用一块柔软的布把冬靴擦得干干净净。

sentences.en: Emma arrived early with her camera to record the special night.
sentences.zh: 艾玛带着相机早早赶到，要记录下这个特别的夜晚。

sentences.en: That evening, the whole town came out to celebrate together.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，全镇的人都出来一起庆祝。

sentences.en: Coloured lights hung outside the old cinema in the square.
sentences.zh: 广场上的老电影院外挂满了彩灯。

sentences.en: A school band played happy songs near the tall tree.
sentences.zh: 一支学校乐队在高高的圣诞树旁演奏着欢快的歌曲。

sentences.en: At six o'clock, an old cannon fired with a great boom.
sentences.zh: 六点钟，一门古老的大炮“轰”地一声鸣响。

sentences.en: Children ran everywhere with sweet candy in their pockets.
sentences.zh: 孩子们口袋里装着甜甜的糖果，到处奔跑。

sentences.en: Above them, the winter sky held a billion shining stars.
sentences.zh: 在他们头顶，冬夜的天空缀着亿万颗闪亮的星星。

sentences.en: Then Jack walked out with his masterpiece, and everyone cheered loudly.
sentences.zh: 接着，杰克端着他的杰作走出来，所有人都大声欢呼。

sentences.en: Rose watched from her seat by the fire, smiling through tears.
sentences.zh: 罗丝坐在炉火旁的座位上看着，含着泪微笑。

sentences.en: 'Happy birthday, my dear boy,' she said in a soft voice.
sentences.zh: “生日快乐，我亲爱的孩子。”她轻声说。

sentences.en: It tasted wonderful, and people came back asking for more.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕味道好极了，人们纷纷回来想再要一块。

sentences.en: Jack finally understood that home is not a place on a map.
sentences.zh: 杰克终于明白，家并不是地图上的一个地点。

sentences.en: It is the people who stand with you through the cold.
sentences.zh: 家，是那些在寒冬中与你并肩站在一起的人。

articles.title: The Case of the Missing Coins
articles.topic_en: A Summer Detective Story on the Farm

sentences.en: "Dear diary," Lily wrote on the first night of summer.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的日记，”莉莉在暑假的第一个晚上写道。

sentences.en: She and her cousin Ben had just arrived at Grandpa's farm.
sentences.zh: 她和表哥本刚刚来到爷爷的农场。

sentences.en: Her dad had driven them there in his old green car.
sentences.zh: 她爸爸开着那辆绿色的旧车把他们送了过来。

sentences.en: Grandpa was an elder in the village, and everyone respected him.
sentences.zh: 爷爷是村里的长者，人人都尊敬他。

sentences.en: Every morning he milked the brown cow near the wooden gate.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他都在木门旁给那头棕色的奶牛挤奶。

sentences.en: Tall corn grew in the wide field behind the house.
sentences.zh: 屋后宽阔的田里长着高高的玉米。

sentences.en: Grandma baked a fresh cookie for each child every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每天下午都给每个孩子烤一块新鲜的饼干。

sentences.en: The smell of hot coffee filled the kitchen at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 日出时分，热咖啡的香味弥漫在厨房里。

sentences.en: Life on the farm was slow, quiet, and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 农场的生活缓慢、宁静而舒适。

sentences.en: Lily felt this holiday would be like a sweet dream.
sentences.zh: 莉莉觉得这个假期会像一场甜美的梦。

sentences.en: One rainy afternoon, Grandpa opened a wooden box on his desk.
sentences.zh: 一个下雨的午后，爷爷打开了书桌上的一个木盒子。

sentences.en: "I collect old things from all over the world," he said with a proud smile.
sentences.zh: “我收集来自世界各地的老物件，”他带着自豪的微笑说。

sentences.en: Inside lay a dozen shining coins from many different countries.
sentences.zh: 盒子里躺着十二枚来自不同国家的闪亮硬币。

sentences.en: The most special one came all the way from Egypt.
sentences.zh: 其中最特别的一枚远道来自埃及。

sentences.en: An Egyptian king's face was drawn on its golden side.
sentences.zh: 它金色的一面上刻画着一位埃及国王的脸。

sentences.en: "It is worth more than a thousand dollars," Grandpa said quietly.
sentences.zh: “它值一千多美元，”爷爷轻声说。

sentences.en: Ben's eyes grew wide as he listened with open ears.
sentences.zh: 本竖起耳朵听着，眼睛瞪得大大的。

sentences.en: Grandpa let the children hold the treasure for a short moment.
sentences.zh: 爷爷让孩子们把这件宝贝捧了一小会儿。

sentences.en: Then he locked the box and placed it back in the corner.
sentences.zh: 然后他锁上盒子，把它放回了角落。

sentences.en: That night, Lily wrote a long description of the treasure in her notebook.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，莉莉在笔记本里写下了关于宝贝的长长描述。

sentences.en: On the eighth day of their visit, something terrible happened.
sentences.zh: 他们来农场的第八天，可怕的事情发生了。

sentences.en: The wooden box had disappeared from Grandpa's room.
sentences.zh: 那个木盒子从爷爷的房间里消失了。

sentences.en: Grandpa searched every shelf but found only dust.
sentences.zh: 爷爷翻遍了每个架子，却只找到灰尘。

sentences.en: Grandma began to cry softly in the dining-room.
sentences.zh: 奶奶在餐厅里轻轻地哭了起来。

sentences.en: "Who would dare to steal from an old man?" she asked.
sentences.zh: “谁敢偷一个老人的东西？”她问道。

sentences.en: Grandpa dropped into his chair, deeply hurt.
sentences.zh: 爷爷跌坐进椅子里，内心深受伤害。

sentences.en: Lily decided at once to find out the truth.
sentences.zh: 莉莉立刻决定要查明真相。

sentences.en: "We can be detectives, just like in the movies!" Ben said.
sentences.zh: “我们可以当侦探，就像电影里那样！”本说。

sentences.en: They shook hands and promised to solve the case together.
sentences.zh: 他们握了握手，约定一起破案。

sentences.en: "Our first duty is to look for clues," Lily said seriously.
sentences.zh: “我们的首要职责是寻找线索，”莉莉严肃地说。

sentences.en: The two children examined the room with great care.
sentences.zh: 两个孩子仔仔细细地检查了房间。

sentences.en: Lily soon discovered small marks of dirt on the floor.
sentences.zh: 莉莉很快在地板上发现了小小的泥土印迹。

sentences.en: The marks led in the direction of the back door.
sentences.zh: 印迹朝着后门的方向延伸。

sentences.en: Outside, the ground was dry, so no footprints could be seen.
sentences.zh: 外面的地面很干燥，所以看不到脚印。

sentences.en: A white duck watched them from the edge of the pond.
sentences.zh: 一只白鸭子从池塘边上望着他们。

sentences.en: "Maybe a thief climbed in through the window," Ben guessed.
