sentences.zh: “也许小偷是从窗户爬进来的，”本猜测道。

sentences.en: Lily made a drawing of the farm to mark each clue.
sentences.zh: 莉莉画了一张农场的图，把每条线索都标了出来。

sentences.en: After a short discussion, they agreed to question everyone on the farm.
sentences.zh: 经过一番简短的讨论，他们决定去询问农场里的每一个人。

sentences.en: "The answer may depend on the smallest details," Lily said.
sentences.zh: “答案可能取决于最细小的细节，”莉莉说。

sentences.en: Ben nodded, feeling confident about their careful plan.
sentences.zh: 本点点头，对他们周密的计划充满信心。

sentences.en: Their first conversation was with Uncle Joe, the farm's cook.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一次谈话对象是农场的厨师乔叔叔。

sentences.en: He was washing a dirty dish in the warm kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他正在温暖的厨房里洗一个脏盘子。

sentences.en: "I was busy making dinner all evening," he told them.
sentences.zh: “我整个晚上都在忙着做晚饭，”他告诉他们。

sentences.en: "You can ask any customer at my little farm shop."
sentences.zh: “你们可以去问我农场小店里的任何一位顾客。”

sentences.en: Next they talked to Old Tom, who worked in the crop fields.
sentences.zh: 接着他们去找了在庄稼地里干活的老汤姆。

sentences.en: He liked to drink too much, and last night he had been drunk.
sentences.zh: 他贪杯，昨天晚上喝醉了。

sentences.en: He could not describe anything clearly from that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上的事，他什么都描述不清楚。

sentences.en: "I only remember a strange sound, like a small crash," he said.
sentences.zh: “我只记得一个奇怪的声音，像什么东西轻轻撞碎了，”他说。

sentences.en: The children wrote down every dialogue in their small notebook.
sentences.zh: 孩子们把每一段对话都记在了小笔记本上。

sentences.en: Then they sat under a big tree to discuss the clues.
sentences.zh: 然后他们坐在一棵大树下讨论这些线索。

sentences.en: The next morning, Grandpa drove the children downtown to ask around.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，爷爷开车带孩子们去市中心打听消息。

sentences.en: They started their questions at the busy market crossing.
sentences.zh: 他们从热闹的市场十字路口开始打听。

sentences.en: A large crowd had gathered near the fruit stalls.
sentences.zh: 水果摊附近聚集了一大群人。

sentences.en: A man in a cotton shirt was selling bottles of cold coke.
sentences.zh: 一个穿棉衬衫的男人在卖冰镇可乐。

sentences.en: Lily bought two bottles, one for herself and one for Ben.
sentences.zh: 莉莉买了两瓶，一瓶给自己，一瓶给本。

sentences.en: They asked the seller if he had seen anything strange lately.
sentences.zh: 他们问卖可乐的人最近有没有见过什么奇怪的事。

sentences.en: "A stranger asked me about old foreign money yesterday," he said.
sentences.zh: “昨天有个陌生人向我打听旧外国钱币的事，”他说。

sentences.en: "He had a red face and wore a long grey coat."
sentences.zh: “他红着脸，穿着一件长长的灰外套。”

sentences.en: "That sounds dangerous," Ben whispered to Lily.
sentences.zh: “听起来很危险，”本悄悄对莉莉说。

sentences.en: They thanked the man and hurried home before dark.
sentences.zh: 他们谢过那个人，赶在天黑前回了家。

sentences.en: Back home, Lily turned on Grandpa's old computer in the study.
sentences.zh: 回到家，莉莉打开了爷爷书房里那台旧电脑。

sentences.en: She wanted to download some pictures of famous stolen treasures.
sentences.zh: 她想下载一些著名失窃珍宝的图片。

sentences.en: She also wrote an e-mail to her father in the city.
sentences.zh: 她还给城里的爸爸写了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: In it, she asked him to copy a news report for her.
sentences.zh: 在邮件里，她请爸爸帮她复印一份新闻报道。

sentences.en: While waiting, she looked up a hard word in her dictionary.
sentences.zh: 等待的时候，她在词典里查了一个难词。

sentences.en: Ben counted the days they had left at the farm.
sentences.zh: 本数了数他们在农场剩下的日子。

sentences.en: "We must connect all the clues soon," he said with worry.
sentences.zh: “我们必须尽快把所有线索联系起来，”他担心地说。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Lily remembered the small marks by the back door.
sentences.zh: 突然，莉莉想起了后门旁那些小小的印迹。

sentences.en: "They were not made by shoes," she said slowly.
sentences.zh: “那些印子不是鞋子留下的，”她慢慢地说。

sentences.en: "They looked like the marks of little paws!"
sentences.zh: “它们看起来像是小爪子的印迹！”

sentences.en: The children ran out to the garden with new hope.
sentences.zh: 孩子们怀着新的希望跑到了花园里。

sentences.en: Behind the house, they found fresh holes in the soft ground.
sentences.zh: 在屋后，他们发现松软的地上有新挖的洞。

sentences.en: "Something came here to dig at night," Lily said with excitement.
sentences.zh: “有什么东西夜里来这儿挖过土，”莉莉兴奋地说。

sentences.en: They followed the line of holes toward the tall green plants.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着一排洞走向高高的绿色庄稼。

sentences.en: There, half hidden, lay the wooden box, dragged through the mud.
sentences.zh: 在那里，那个木盒子半掩着，被拖过了泥地。

sentences.en: A young deer jumped away in fright as they came near.
sentences.zh: 他们走近时，一只小鹿受惊跳开了。

sentences.en: But the real thief was Grandpa's dog, Biscuit.
sentences.zh: 但真正的“小偷”是爷爷的狗——“饼干”。

sentences.en: He loved to take shiny things and hide them like bones.
sentences.zh: 它喜欢叼走亮闪闪的东西，像藏骨头一样把它们藏起来。

sentences.en: "So no stranger came to destroy our happy summer!" Ben laughed.
sentences.zh: “原来没有陌生人来毁掉我们快乐的夏天！”本笑着说。

sentences.en: The great discovery made them shout and dance with joy.
sentences.zh: 这个重大发现让他们又叫又跳，高兴得手舞足蹈。

sentences.en: Grandpa opened the box with shaking hands.
sentences.zh: 爷爷用颤抖的双手打开了盒子。

sentences.en: Every treasure was safe, though the box was covered with mud.
sentences.zh: 虽然盒子上沾满了泥，但每件宝贝都安然无恙。

sentences.en: "You two deserve a big reward," he said warmly.
sentences.zh: “你们俩应该得到一份大大的奖励，”他温和地说。

sentences.en: Grandma made a delicious meal to celebrate that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，奶奶做了一顿美味的饭菜来庆祝。

sentences.en: There was roast chicken, hot bread, and a fried egg for everyone.
sentences.zh: 有烤鸡、热面包，每人还有一个煎蛋。

sentences.en: For dessert, they could dip fresh strawberries into soft cream.
sentences.zh: 至于甜点，他们可以把新鲜的草莓蘸上柔滑的奶油。

sentences.en: Lily wore her best dress for the little family party.
sentences.zh: 莉莉为这个小小的家庭聚会穿上了她最好的连衣裙。

sentences.en: Grandpa told an old story about a golden dragon guarding treasure.
sentences.zh: 爷爷讲了一个金龙守护宝藏的古老故事。

sentences.en: "A doctor once told me laughter cures every disease," he joked.
sentences.zh: “一位医生曾告诉我，笑能治百病，”他开玩笑说。

sentences.en: They laughed together until the old clock struck ten.
sentences.zh: 他们一起笑着，直到老钟敲响十点。

sentences.en: When summer ended, Lily returned to her school in the city.
sentences.zh: 夏天结束后，莉莉回到了城里的学校。

sentences.en: Her teacher announced a writing competition for the whole class.
sentences.zh: 老师宣布全班要举行一场写作比赛。

sentences.en: Some students began to complain that writing was too hard.
sentences.zh: 有些学生开始抱怨写作太难了。

sentences.en: But Lily happily wrote a composition about her summer adventure.
sentences.zh: 但莉莉开心地写了一篇关于她夏日冒险的作文。

sentences.en: She had no difficulty, because every detail lived in her heart.
sentences.zh: 她毫不费力，因为每一个细节都留在她的心里。

sentences.en: She told the whole story in a clear and direct way.
sentences.zh: 她用清晰而直接的方式讲述了整个故事。

sentences.en: She checked each sentence to make sure it was correct.
sentences.zh: 她检查了每个句子，确保没有错误。

sentences.en: Her writing skills continued to develop with every page.
sentences.zh: 她的写作水平随着每一页的练习不断提高。

sentences.en: She even added a funny picture of Biscuit in bright colour.
sentences.zh: 她甚至添上了一幅色彩明亮的“饼干”的滑稽画像。

sentences.en: When she finished, she felt a quiet comfort inside.
sentences.zh: 写完的时候，她心里感到一种静静的慰藉。

sentences.en: A week later, the teacher read Lily's story to the class.
sentences.zh: 一周后，老师把莉莉的故事读给全班同学听。

sentences.en: The students demanded to hear it a second time.
sentences.zh: 同学们强烈要求再听一遍。

sentences.en: "Grandpa's heart felt as empty as a desert," she had written.
sentences.zh: “爷爷的心像沙漠一样空荡荡的，”她在文中写道。

sentences.en: "The bad news hit our family like an earthquake," said another line.
sentences.zh: “这个坏消息像地震一样击中了我们全家，”另一句写道。

sentences.en: Lily won first prize, and the class divided a big box of chocolate.
sentences.zh: 莉莉得了一等奖，全班一起分享了一大盒巧克力。

sentences.en: The prize also included two tickets to a music concert.
sentences.zh: 奖品里还有两张音乐会的门票。

sentences.en: Lily gave one ticket to Ben when he came to visit.
sentences.zh: 本来做客时，莉莉把其中一张票送给了他。

sentences.en: With the prize money, she bought a soft doll for her little sister.
sentences.zh: 她用奖金给妹妹买了一个柔软的洋娃娃。

sentences.en: That winter, Lily even learned to dive at the city pool.
sentences.zh: 那年冬天，莉莉还在市游泳馆学会了跳水。

sentences.en: But whenever she closed her eyes, she was back on the farm, where a clever dog had made her a real hero.
sentences.zh: 但每当她闭上眼睛，她就仿佛回到了农场——在那里，一只聪明的狗让她成了真正的英雄。

sentences.en: Mei was a young engineer who had studied for four years in Germany.
sentences.zh: 小梅是一名年轻的工程师，曾在德国学习了四年。

sentences.en: On a cold Friday morning, she took the long flight back to her home town.
sentences.zh: 在一个寒冷的周五早晨，她乘坐长途航班回到了家乡。

sentences.en: Her grandfather kept a small farm at the foot of a green mountain.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父在一座青山脚下经营着一个小农场。

sentences.en: The old man was a farmer, and farming had been his whole life.
sentences.zh: 老人是个农民，务农就是他的一生。

sentences.en: When Mei walked through the wooden gate, he hurried out to meet her.
sentences.zh: 当小梅走进木门时，他急忙出来迎接她。

sentences.en: "My goodness, you are finally home!" he cried, holding her cold hands.
sentences.zh: “天哪，你终于回来了！”他喊道，握住她冰凉的双手。

sentences.en: She was glad to see him, though he looked much thinner than before.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴见到他，尽管他看起来比以前瘦了许多。

sentences.en: Behind him, the winter fields lay quiet and grey under the low sky.
sentences.zh: 在他身后，冬天的田野在低垂的天空下静静地泛着灰色。

sentences.en: That evening, over a simple dinner, Grandfather explained the village's trouble to her.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，吃着简单的晚饭，祖父向她讲述了村里的麻烦。

sentences.en: Heavy rain had fallen for eleven days, and the river was still rising.
sentences.zh: 大雨已经下了十一天，河水还在不断上涨。

sentences.en: The experts on the radio warned that a flood might come within weeks.
sentences.zh: 广播里的专家警告说，洪水可能在几周内到来。

sentences.en: Fear grew in the hearts of everybody who lived near the water.
sentences.zh: 住在河边的每一个人心里都渐渐生出了恐惧。

sentences.en: "The river is our enemy now," Grandfather said, putting down his fork.
sentences.zh: “现在这条河是我们的敌人了。”祖父放下叉子说。

sentences.en: To make things worse, the electricity often stopped without any warning at night.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，夜里常常毫无预兆地停电。

sentences.en: The fridge in his little kitchen was almost empty.
sentences.zh: 他小厨房里的冰箱几乎是空的。

sentences.en: Mei pressed her hand against the cold glass of the window and made a decision.
sentences.zh: 小梅把手贴在冰冷的窗玻璃上，下定了决心。

sentences.en: Early the next morning, Mei went out alone to examine the old river wall.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，小梅独自出门去检查那道古老的河堤。

sentences.en: Its foundation was weak, and thin cracks ran everywhere across the stones.
sentences.zh: 河堤的地基很脆弱，石头上到处都是细小的裂缝。

sentences.en: She measured the exact height of the water with a long wooden stick.
sentences.zh: 她用一根长木棍测量了水位的确切高度。

sentences.en: One small error, she knew, could cost the village everything it had.
sentences.zh: 她知道，一个小小的错误就可能让村子失去一切。

sentences.en: On her way back, she took the narrow path through the pine forest.
sentences.zh: 回来的路上，她走了那条穿过松树林的小径。

sentences.en: A red fox watched her quietly from behind a broken fence.
sentences.zh: 一只红狐狸在破旧的栅栏后面静静地注视着她。

sentences.en: Its thick fur shone like fire in the pale morning light.
sentences.zh: 它厚厚的皮毛在晨光中像火焰一样闪亮。

sentences.en: Even the animals seemed to know that danger was coming, so Mei hurried home to draw her plan.
sentences.zh: 似乎连动物都察觉到危险将至，于是小梅赶回家开始画她的方案图。

sentences.en: That night, about fifty villagers crowded into the small school hall.
sentences.zh: 当晚，大约五十个村民挤进了小小的学校礼堂。

sentences.en: Mei stood at the entrance and welcomed each person with a friendly smile.
sentences.zh: 小梅站在入口处，用友好的微笑迎接每一个人。

sentences.en: She used simple everyday words so that everyone could follow her plan.
sentences.zh: 她用简单的日常用语讲解，好让每个人都能听懂她的计划。

sentences.en: "We must build a stronger wall before the fifth day of next month," she said.
sentences.zh: “我们必须在下个月五号之前建一道更坚固的堤墙。”她说。

sentences.en: "The equipment we need is not expensive if we all share the cost."
sentences.zh: “如果我们大家分摊费用，需要的设备并不贵。”

sentences.en: An old man shook his head and said loudly that the plan would fail.
sentences.zh: 一位老人摇着头，大声说这个计划会失败。

sentences.en: "Excuse me," Mei answered politely, "but doing nothing would be far worse."
sentences.zh: “对不起，”小梅礼貌地回答，“但什么都不做只会更糟。”

sentences.en: She pointed her finger at the map and asked them to trust her.
sentences.zh: 她用手指着地图，请求大家信任她。

sentences.en: Gradually, one by one, the villagers began to nod their heads.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，村民们一个接一个地点了头。

sentences.en: Work began on Monday, and men and women laboured side by side.
sentences.zh: 工程在周一开工，男人和女人并肩劳作。

sentences.en: Mei believed in equality, so every worker received an equal share of pay.
sentences.zh: 小梅信奉平等，所以每个工人都拿到同等的报酬。

sentences.en: A small factory in town lent them trucks and stone as a favour.
sentences.zh: 镇上的一家小工厂出于好意借给他们卡车和石料。

sentences.en: The owner charged no fee, because he had grown up in the village himself.
sentences.zh: 厂主分文不收，因为他自己就是在这个村子里长大的。

sentences.en: All day long, people carried heavy baskets back and forth along the bank.
sentences.zh: 人们整天沿着河岸来来回回地搬运沉重的箩筐。

sentences.en: The children helped too; each afternoon they would feed the workers' goats and chickens.
sentences.zh: 孩子们也来帮忙，每天下午替工人们喂山羊和鸡。

sentences.en: One fat hen followed Mei around all day like a loyal little fan.
sentences.zh: 一只肥母鸡整天跟着小梅，像个忠实的小粉丝。

sentences.en: During the breaks, everyone sat on the grass and shared fruit and cold tea.
sentences.zh: 休息时，大家坐在草地上分享水果和凉茶。

sentences.en: Laughter could be heard along the river from morning until dark.
sentences.zh: 从清晨到天黑，河边都能听到笑声。

sentences.en: But on the fourth day of work, trouble arrived without any warning.
sentences.zh: 然而开工的第四天，麻烦毫无预兆地降临了。

sentences.en: The temperature dropped quickly, and the wet ground began to freeze.
sentences.zh: 气温骤降，潮湿的地面开始结冰。

sentences.en: That same night, Grandfather caught a fever and had to stay in bed.
sentences.zh: 就在当晚，祖父发起了烧，不得不卧床休息。

sentences.en: Mei sat beside him for hours, afraid that he might not get better.
sentences.zh: 小梅在他床边守了好几个小时，担心他好不起来。

sentences.en: "Don't be a fool," he whispered to her with a weak smile.
sentences.zh: “别犯傻了。”他带着虚弱的笑容轻声对她说。

sentences.en: "Go and finish the wall; I am not ready to say good-bye yet."
sentences.zh: “去把堤墙修完吧，我还没打算说再见呢。”

sentences.en: His generous spirit gave her the strength she badly needed.
sentences.zh: 他豁达宽厚的心给了她急需的力量。

sentences.en: She kissed his forehead softly and returned to the river at first light.
sentences.zh: 她轻轻吻了吻他的额头，天一亮就回到了河边。

sentences.en: A few days later, help arrived from far away and surprised the whole village.
sentences.zh: 几天后，远方来的援助让全村人都吃了一惊。

sentences.en: Hans, Mei's German classmate from university, appeared at the site with special tools.
sentences.zh: 小梅大学时的德国同学汉斯带着专用工具出现在工地上。

sentences.en: An English-speaking teacher from the town came along to help them talk.
sentences.zh: 镇上一位会说英语的老师也一同前来，帮助他们交流。

sentences.en: The friendship between Mei and Hans had begun years ago in a lecture room.
sentences.zh: 小梅和汉斯的友谊是多年前在一间教室里开始的。

sentences.en: Hans had also worked on rivers in France, so he understood water well.
sentences.zh: 汉斯还曾在法国治理过河流，所以他非常了解水。

sentences.en: Together they did a careful experiment to test the soil by the bank.
sentences.zh: 他们一起做了一个细致的实验，检测河岸边的土壤。

sentences.en: "This ground is fit for a strong wall," Hans announced with a happy laugh.
sentences.zh: “这块地适合建一道坚固的堤墙。”汉斯开心地笑着宣布。

sentences.en: With his help, they were able to fix the weakest parts before the storm.
sentences.zh: 在他的帮助下，他们赶在风暴之前修好了最薄弱的部分。

sentences.en: On the eve of the great storm, dark clouds covered the whole sky.
sentences.zh: 大风暴来临的前夜，乌云布满了整个天空。

sentences.en: The villagers raised a red flag to warn everyone living near the water.
sentences.zh: 村民们升起一面红旗，提醒住在河边的所有人。

sentences.en: Rain fell all through the night, and the river climbed higher and higher.
sentences.zh: 大雨下了整整一夜，河水越涨越高。

sentences.en: A little water still managed to enter the lowest street of the village.
sentences.zh: 还是有一些水涌进了村里地势最低的那条街。

sentences.en: The families there had to escape quickly to the school building on the hill.
sentences.zh: 那里的几户人家不得不迅速逃到山坡上的学校里。

sentences.en: Muddy water covered the floor of two small houses, but nobody was hurt.
sentences.zh: 泥水淹没了两间小屋的地板，但没有人受伤。

sentences.en: All night, people watched the new wall and held their breath.
sentences.zh: 整个晚上，人们屏住呼吸，注视着那道新堤墙。

sentences.en: The wall stood firm, and by morning the rain had finally stopped.
sentences.zh: 堤墙巍然不动，到早晨雨终于停了。

sentences.en: Not a single life was lost, and the young rice fields were safe.
sentences.zh: 没有一个人丧生，稻田里的秧苗也安然无恙。

sentences.en: One month later, the village held a bright spring festival to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，村里举办了一场热闹的春季庆典来庆祝。

sentences.en: Fifteen children opened the day by singing songs on the school playground.
sentences.zh: 十五个孩子在学校操场上唱歌，为这一天拉开了序幕。

sentences.en: There was also a small exhibition of photos showing the building work.
sentences.zh: 现场还有一个小型展览，展出了修堤过程的照片。

sentences.en: Entry was free, and visitors travelled in from forty villages nearby.
sentences.zh: 入场免费，附近四十个村子的客人都赶来参观。

sentences.en: In the school garden, every flower seemed to open at the same time.
sentences.zh: 学校的花园里，每一朵花仿佛都在同一时刻绽放。

sentences.en: White doves were set free to fly above the cheering crowd.
sentences.zh: 白鸽被放飞，在欢呼的人群上空翱翔。

sentences.en: Long tables were filled with warm bread, boiled eggs, and sweet cakes.
sentences.zh: 长桌上摆满了热面包、煮鸡蛋和甜点心。

sentences.en: There was fresh fish from the river for every single guest.
sentences.zh: 每一位客人都能吃到河里捕来的新鲜鱼。

sentences.en: Grandfather, healthy again, played a funny game of golf on the grass with the children.
sentences.zh: 恢复健康的祖父和孩子们在草地上玩起了滑稽的高尔夫。

sentences.en: As the sun went down, an old storyteller told the children a tale about a white elephant.
sentences.zh: 夕阳西下时，一位老说书人给孩子们讲了一个白象的故事。

sentences.en: At sunset, Mei stood up to express her thanks in a short speech.
sentences.zh: 日落时分，小梅起身发表了简短的讲话，表达谢意。

sentences.en: "This wall will protect our children and the next generation after them," she said.
sentences.zh: “这道堤墙将保护我们的孩子，以及他们之后的下一代。”她说。

sentences.en: "A safe environment does not simply exist; we must build it with our own hands."
sentences.zh: “安全的环境不会凭空存在，我们必须亲手去创造它。”

sentences.en: The villagers gave her a special gift: a small stone taken from the wall.
sentences.zh: 村民们送给她一份特别的礼物：一块取自堤墙的小石头。

sentences.en: Later that year, a schoolgirl wrote an essay about Mei for her writing class.
sentences.zh: 那年晚些时候，一个女学生在写作课上写了一篇关于小梅的作文。

sentences.en: She received the top grade, and her teacher called the piece excellent.
sentences.zh: 她得了最高分，老师称赞这篇文章非常出色。

sentences.en: The story brought Mei a little fame, but she never cared about that.
sentences.zh: 这个故事给小梅带来了些许名气，但她从不在意这些。

sentences.en: Her favourite exercise was still a slow walk along the river wall each morning.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢的锻炼仍然是每天清晨沿着河堤慢慢散步。

sentences.en: She often encouraged young people to study hard and then come back home.
sentences.zh: 她常常鼓励年轻人努力学习，然后回到家乡。

sentences.en: "Stand by your home, and it will stand by you forever," she would tell them.
sentences.zh: “守护你的家乡，它就会永远守护你。”她总是这样告诉他们。

articles.title: The Summer on Grandma's Farm
articles.topic_en: A Country Summer and Growing Up

sentences.en: Lily was a junior student at a big city school.
sentences.zh: 莉莉是城里一所大学校的初中生。

sentences.en: Every evening she typed her homework on an old keyboard until midnight.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上她都在一个旧键盘上打作业，一直到半夜。

sentences.en: Lately she felt so tired that she could hardly smile.
sentences.zh: 最近她累得几乎笑不出来。

sentences.en: Her mother looked at her and said, "You need a real holiday."
sentences.zh: 妈妈看着她说：“你需要一个真正的假期。”

sentences.en: So Lily packed her favorite jacket and took a bus to the countryside.
sentences.zh: 于是莉莉收拾好她最喜欢的夹克，坐上了去乡下的巴士。

sentences.en: Her grandma lived on a small farm behind a green hill.
sentences.zh: 她的奶奶住在一座青山后面的小农场上。

sentences.en: The bus left the noisy highway and turned onto a quiet country road.
sentences.zh: 巴士驶离喧闹的公路，拐上了一条安静的乡间小路。

sentences.en: Through the window, Lily saw a silver lake shining in the afternoon sun.
sentences.zh: 透过车窗，莉莉看见一片银色的湖在午后的阳光下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: "Hello, my dear!" Grandma called from the wooden gate.
sentences.zh: “你好呀，亲爱的！”奶奶在木门边喊道。

sentences.en: She gave Lily a warm hug and a kiss on the cheek.
sentences.zh: 她给了莉莉一个温暖的拥抱，还在她脸颊上亲了一下。

sentences.en: The old lady wore a wide straw hat against the sun.
sentences.zh: 老太太戴着一顶宽宽的草帽遮挡阳光。

sentences.en: Her hair was grey, but her eyes were full of joy.
sentences.zh: 她的头发已经花白，但眼睛里满是喜悦。

sentences.en: Lily sat down on the soft grass and breathed the clean air.
sentences.zh: 莉莉坐在柔软的草地上，呼吸着清新的空气。

sentences.en: A brown horse stood by the fence, watching her with gentle eyes.
sentences.zh: 一匹棕色的马站在栅栏边，用温柔的眼神看着她。

sentences.en: A yellow leaf floated down and landed softly on her lap.
sentences.zh: 一片黄叶飘下来，轻轻落在她的膝头。

sentences.en: "This place is like heaven," Lily said with a deep breath.
sentences.zh: “这地方简直像天堂，”莉莉深吸一口气说。

sentences.en: Grandma laughed and led her into the little farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 奶奶笑了起来，领着她走进了小小的农舍。

sentences.en: The kitchen smelled of fresh bread and fried ham.
sentences.zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和煎火腿的香味。

sentences.en: Grandma made cool apple juice from fruit in her garden.
sentences.zh: 奶奶用自家园子里的水果做了清凉的苹果汁。

sentences.en: She spread sweet strawberry jam on the warm bread.
sentences.zh: 她把甜甜的草莓酱涂在温热的面包上。

sentences.en: "Eating well is the first step to staying healthy," she said.
sentences.zh: “吃得好是保持健康的第一步，”她说。

sentences.en: Lily was so hungry that she ate three pieces at once.
sentences.zh: 莉莉饿极了，一口气吃了三块。

sentences.en: After dinner, they sat under a soft lamp in the hall.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，他们坐在堂屋里柔和的灯光下。

sentences.en: Grandma took out an old guitar and played a country song.
sentences.zh: 奶奶拿出一把旧吉他，弹了一首乡村歌曲。

sentences.en: Lily listened happily until the stars filled the night sky.
sentences.zh: 莉莉开心地听着，直到星星布满夜空。

sentences.en: For the first time in many months, she felt truly relaxed.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，她第一次感到真正的放松。

sentences.en: The next morning, a young guest knocked on the front door.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，一位年轻的客人敲响了前门。

sentences.en: It was Kenji, a friendly boy who had traveled all the way from Japan.
sentences.zh: 他是健二，一个从日本远道而来的友好男孩。

sentences.en: "Let me introduce myself," he said in slow, careful English.
sentences.zh: “让我自我介绍一下，”他用缓慢而认真的英语说。

sentences.en: His grammar was not perfect, but everyone understood him well.
sentences.zh: 他的语法并不完美，但大家都能听懂。

sentences.en: He taught Lily some Japanese words, and she taught him Chinese ones.
sentences.zh: 他教莉莉几个日语单词，莉莉也教他几个中文词。

sentences.en: Then he told a funny joke about his long flight, and they all smiled.
sentences.zh: 接着他讲了一个关于长途飞行的有趣笑话，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: Kenji said his biggest dream was to visit Greece one day.
sentences.zh: 健二说他最大的梦想是有一天去希腊看看。

sentences.en: "Travel gives you knowledge that books cannot," Grandma agreed warmly.
sentences.zh: “旅行能给你书本给不了的知识，”奶奶热情地表示赞同。

sentences.en: She invited Kenji to stay on the farm and help with the harvest.
sentences.zh: 她邀请健二留在农场，帮忙收庄稼。

sentences.en: Life on the farm was busy, and nobody was allowed to be lazy.
sentences.zh: 农场的生活很忙碌，谁也不许偷懒。

sentences.en: Every morning, Grandma gave the two children clear instructions for the day.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，奶奶都会给两个孩子布置清楚的当日任务。

sentences.en: She acted as their guide around the fields and the orchard.
sentences.zh: 她像向导一样带他们熟悉田地和果园。

sentences.en: Lily learned to climb a tall ladder and pick red apples.
sentences.zh: 莉莉学会了爬上高高的梯子摘红苹果。

sentences.en: Kenji learned to cut vegetables with a sharp kitchen knife.
sentences.zh: 健二学会了用锋利的菜刀切蔬菜。

sentences.en: "Be careful, kids, these tools can harm you," Grandma always warned.
sentences.zh: “小心点，孩子们，这些工具会伤到你们的，”奶奶总是这样提醒。

sentences.en: Working outside soon became a happy new habit for Lily.
sentences.zh: 在户外劳动很快成了莉莉快乐的新习惯。

sentences.en: Her skin grew brown, and her legs grew strong from all the walking.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤晒成了棕色，双腿也因为不停走动变得结实起来。

sentences.en: Day by day, her health and her mood began to improve.
sentences.zh: 一天天地，她的身体和心情都开始好转。

sentences.en: One afternoon, the summer heat made everyone slow and sleepy.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，夏日的酷热让每个人都变得又慢又困。

sentences.en: Grandma brought out cold ice-cream from the old fridge.
sentences.zh: 奶奶从旧冰箱里拿出了冰凉的冰淇淋。

sentences.en: While they ate, she began to tell stories about her youth.
sentences.zh: 他们吃冰淇淋的时候，她讲起了自己年轻时的故事。

sentences.en: As a young woman, she had worked in a grand hotel in the city.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，她曾在城里一家豪华酒店工作。

sentences.en: There she once served an Indian musician and even a famous judge.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她曾接待过一位印度音乐家，甚至还有一位著名的法官。

sentences.en: "I still hang their photo on my bedroom wall," she said proudly.
sentences.zh: “我现在还把他们的照片挂在卧室墙上呢，”她自豪地说。

sentences.en: Then she showed them an old letter written in blue ink.
sentences.zh: 然后她拿出一封用蓝墨水写的旧信给他们看。

sentences.en: It was from Lily's grandfather, an honest and gentle man.
sentences.zh: 那是莉莉的爷爷写的，他是一个诚实而温和的人。

sentences.en: Lily could imagine the two of them dancing together many years ago.
sentences.zh: 莉莉可以想象出许多年前他们俩一起跳舞的样子。

sentences.en: "True love is life's finest invention," Grandma said with a soft smile.
sentences.zh: “真爱是生活最美妙的发明，”奶奶带着温柔的微笑说。

sentences.en: That night, rain fell heavily on the farmhouse roof.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，大雨重重地打在农舍的屋顶上。

sentences.en: The wild wind kicked the gate open again and again.
sentences.zh: 狂风一次又一次地把院门踢开。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Grandma fell ill with a very high fever.
sentences.zh: 突然，奶奶病倒了，发起了高烧。

sentences.en: She looked so weak that Lily's hands began to shake.
sentences.zh: 她看起来虚弱极了，莉莉的手都开始发抖。

sentences.en: "This may be a serious illness," Kenji said in a quiet voice.
sentences.zh: “这可能是一场重病，”健二小声说。

sentences.en: The phone line was dead, so calling a doctor seemed impossible.
sentences.zh: 电话线断了，想打电话叫医生似乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: Lily knew she had to act immediately, or it might be too late.
sentences.zh: 莉莉知道自己必须立刻行动，否则可能就太迟了。

sentences.en: She pulled on her leather boots and ran out to the horse.
sentences.zh: 她套上皮靴，跑向那匹马。

sentences.en: Her heart was beating like a heavy drum in her chest.
sentences.zh: 她的心像一面沉重的鼓一样在胸口怦怦作响。

sentences.en: Lily had never ridden alone in the dark before.
sentences.zh: 莉莉以前从未在黑夜里独自骑过马。

sentences.en: But she told herself to be brave for Grandma's sake.
sentences.zh: 但为了奶奶，她告诉自己一定要勇敢。

sentences.en: The horse jumped over a fallen tree on the muddy path.
sentences.zh: 马在泥泞的小路上跃过了一棵倒下的树。

sentences.en: In the storm, the wet fields looked like a wild jungle.
sentences.zh: 在暴风雨中，湿漉漉的田野看起来像一片荒野丛林。

sentences.en: Suddenly the horse stepped into a deep hole in the road.
sentences.zh: 突然，马踩进了路上的一个深坑。

sentences.en: Lily fell off and hurt her knee on a sharp stone.
sentences.zh: 莉莉摔了下来，膝盖磕在一块尖石头上受了伤。

sentences.en: The pain was horrible, but she stood up and climbed back on.
sentences.zh: 疼痛难忍，但她还是站起来重新爬上了马背。

sentences.en: "Just a few hundred meters more," she whispered to the horse.
sentences.zh: “再坚持几百米，”她对马轻声说。

sentences.en: At last she reached the doctor's house at the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 她终于到达了镇边医生的家。

sentences.en: "Please hurry, my grandma is very sick!" she cried at the door.
sentences.zh: “请快一点，我奶奶病得很重！”她在门口大声喊道。

sentences.en: The doctor came at once and gave Grandma the right medicine.
sentences.zh: 医生立刻赶来，给奶奶用了对症的药。

sentences.en: By the time the sun rose, the fever was finally gone.
sentences.zh: 太阳升起的时候，高烧终于退了。

sentences.en: "You saved me, my little hero," Grandma said softly.
sentences.zh: “你救了我，我的小英雄，”奶奶轻声说。

sentences.en: Lily felt deeply grateful that everything had turned out fine.
sentences.zh: 莉莉深深地感激一切都平安无事。

sentences.en: Kenji cooked a big pot of soup so nobody felt hunger that day.
sentences.zh: 健二煮了一大锅汤，那天谁也没有挨饿。

sentences.en: Grandma insisted on getting up to watch the sunrise with them.
sentences.zh: 奶奶坚持要起床和他们一起看日出。

sentences.en: They laid a warm blanket on the hillside and sat close together.
sentences.zh: 他们在山坡上铺了一条温暖的毯子，紧紧地坐在一起。

sentences.en: A few days later, a local journalist heard about Lily's brave night ride.
sentences.zh: 几天后，一位当地记者听说了莉莉深夜勇敢骑马求医的事。

sentences.en: Even old Mr. Wu, whose hearing was weak, learned of her courage.
sentences.zh: 连听力不好的吴老爷爷也知道了她的勇敢事迹。

sentences.en: The newspaper called her a young leader with a lion's heart.
sentences.zh: 报纸称她是一位有着狮子般勇气的小领袖。

sentences.en: Summer ended too soon, and it was time to say good-bye.
sentences.zh: 夏天很快就结束了，到了说再见的时候。

sentences.en: Lily measured the corn and saw it had grown another inch.
sentences.zh: 莉莉量了量玉米，发现它又长高了一英寸。

sentences.en: "I will come back every summer until I graduate," she promised.
sentences.zh: “在我毕业之前，每个夏天我都会回来，”她许诺道。

sentences.en: Grandma joked that by then the farm would be a little kingdom of apples.
sentences.zh: 奶奶开玩笑说，到那时农场就会变成一个小小的苹果王国。

sentences.en: Back at school, Lily hid a small photo of the farm inside her desk.
sentences.zh: 回到学校后，莉莉把一张农场的小照片藏在了课桌里。

sentences.en: Whenever her lessons felt hard, she looked at it and smiled.
sentences.zh: 每当功课让她觉得吃力时，她就看看照片，然后微微一笑。

sentences.en: She studied with new energy, and her grades were indeed much better.
sentences.zh: 她带着新的干劲学习，成绩确实好了很多。

sentences.en: Her teachers said her writing was clear and helpful to other students.
sentences.zh: 老师们说她的作文清晰明了，对其他同学也很有帮助。

sentences.en: Deep in her heart, Lily knew that one country summer had changed her forever.
sentences.zh: 在内心深处，莉莉知道，那个乡村的夏天已经永远地改变了她。

sentences.en: Mei worked as a nurse in a small quiet city.
sentences.zh: 小梅在一座安静的小城里当护士。

sentences.en: Her days were simple, and her life was quite ordinary.
sentences.zh: 她的日子很简单，生活也十分平凡。

sentences.en: On Monday morning, she decided to go and visit her parents.
sentences.zh: 周一早上，她决定回去看望父母。

sentences.en: They lived in a northern town, far away in the northeast.
sentences.zh: 他们住在北方的一个小镇，远在东北地区。

sentences.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival was coming, and she missed home very much.
sentences.zh: 中秋节快到了，她非常想家。

sentences.en: She began to pack her bag with warm clothes and gifts.
sentences.zh: 她开始收拾行李，装上暖和的衣服和礼物。

sentences.en: She also put in a box of sweet mooncakes.
sentences.zh: 她还放进去一盒香甜的月饼。

sentences.en: This would be her first trip home in three long years.
sentences.zh: 这将是她三年来第一次回家。

sentences.en: At the station, Mei checked her passport and her driving license twice.
sentences.zh: 在车站，小梅把护照和驾照检查了两遍。

sentences.en: She was nervous because she often lost small things.
sentences.zh: 她很紧张，因为她经常弄丢小东西。

sentences.en: Her home town was more than five hundred miles away.
sentences.zh: 她的家乡在五百多英里之外。

sentences.en: She opened a paper map to study the long route.
sentences.zh: 她打开一张纸质地图，研究这段漫长的路线。

sentences.en: The train was full of passengers going home for the festival.
sentences.zh: 火车上挤满了回家过节的乘客。

sentences.en: Mei found her seat by the window and sat down.
sentences.zh: 小梅找到靠窗的座位坐了下来。

sentences.en: By mistake, she had first sat in the wrong seat.
sentences.zh: 一开始她还坐错了座位。

sentences.en: A kind lady laughed softly and helped her find the right one.
sentences.zh: 一位和善的女士轻声笑着，帮她找到了正确的位置。

sentences.en: On the train, Mei took a novel out of her bag.
sentences.zh: 在火车上，小梅从包里拿出一本小说。

sentences.en: It was a murder story, full of dark and clever secrets.
sentences.zh: 那是一个谋杀故事，充满了黑暗又巧妙的秘密。

sentences.en: Later she picked up a newspaper lying on the seat.
sentences.zh: 后来她拿起座位上的一份报纸。

sentences.en: The front page mentioned a famous painting that had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 头版提到一幅名画被盗了。

sentences.en: It had been taken from an old palace museum in the capital.
sentences.zh: 它是从首都一座古老的宫殿博物馆里被偷走的。

sentences.en: A travel magazine on her lap showed the same story.
sentences.zh: 她腿上的一本旅行杂志也登了同样的新闻。

sentences.en: Mei noticed a small photo of the thief's gray gloves.
sentences.zh: 小梅注意到一张小照片，上面是小偷的灰色手套。

sentences.en: She felt a strange interest growing in her heart.
sentences.zh: 她心里生出一种奇怪的兴趣。

sentences.en: Soon a young man sat down across from her.
sentences.zh: 不久，一个年轻人在她对面坐了下来。

sentences.en: He said he was a manager at a small art company.
sentences.zh: 他说自己是一家小艺术公司的经理。

sentences.en: He carried a heavy metal box on his knees.
sentences.zh: 他的膝盖上放着一个沉重的金属箱子。

sentences.en: Mei helped him lift it onto the shelf above.
sentences.zh: 小梅帮他把箱子抬到上面的行李架上。

sentences.en: A hard object inside made a soft sound.
sentences.zh: 里面有个硬硬的物件发出轻轻的响声。

sentences.en: He was neither friendly nor rude, just very quiet.
sentences.zh: 他既不热情也不粗鲁，只是非常安静。

sentences.en: In Mei's opinion, the man looked worried about something.
sentences.zh: 在小梅看来，这个人似乎在为什么事担心。

sentences.en: He checked his mobile phone every few minutes.
sentences.zh: 他每隔几分钟就看一次手机。

sentences.en: At noon, Mei walked to the dining car for lunch.
sentences.zh: 中午，小梅走去餐车吃午饭。

sentences.en: The menu was short, but the food smelled wonderful.
sentences.zh: 菜单很简单，但饭菜闻起来很香。

sentences.en: She ordered a hot meal with rice and meat.
sentences.zh: 她点了一份有米饭和肉的热餐。

sentences.en: She also asked for warm milk and a sweet orange.
sentences.zh: 她还要了热牛奶和一个甜橙子。

sentences.en: Behind the counter, a cook shook a big black pan.
sentences.zh: 柜台后面，厨师颠着一口黑色的大平底锅。

sentences.en: The noise of the train mixed with happy voices.
sentences.zh: 火车的响声和欢快的人声混在一起。

sentences.en: The young man, whose name was Tao, sat beside her.
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人名叫阿涛，他坐到了她旁边。

sentences.en: They talked about food and family for a long while.
sentences.zh: 他们聊了很久关于美食和家人的事。

sentences.en: Tao said his parents wanted him to marry soon.
sentences.zh: 阿涛说父母希望他早点结婚。

sentences.en: He had studied mathematics at school but loved art more.
sentences.zh: 他在学校学的是数学，却更热爱艺术。

sentences.en: 'A lifetime is short,' he said, 'so follow your heart.'
sentences.zh: “人的一生很短，”他说，“所以要跟着自己的心走。”

sentences.en: Mei shared a warm memory of her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 小梅分享了一段关于奶奶的温暖回忆。

sentences.en: Her grandmother used to sing old opera songs in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 奶奶以前常在厨房里唱老戏曲。

sentences.en: Once they watched an Olympic race together on TV.
sentences.zh: 有一次她们一起在电视上看奥运会比赛。

sentences.en: Those simple days gave Mei's life its true meaning.
sentences.zh: 那些简单的日子赋予了小梅生活真正的意义。

sentences.en: Yet one part of Tao's story sounded like a lie.
sentences.zh: 然而，阿涛的故事里有一部分听起来像谎言。

sentences.en: Outside the window, nature slowly changed its colors.
sentences.zh: 窗外，大自然慢慢换上了新的颜色。

sentences.en: The train ran through a narrow valley by a lake.
sentences.zh: 火车穿过湖边一条狭窄的山谷。

sentences.en: A thin path climbed between the golden trees.
sentences.zh: 一条细细的小路在金色的树林间向上延伸。

sentences.en: Mei saw a bird's nest resting on a tall branch.
sentences.zh: 小梅看见高高的树枝上有一个鸟巢。

sentences.en: In her magazine, she found photos of a lion and a monkey.
sentences.zh: 她在杂志里看到了狮子和猴子的照片。

sentences.en: The zoo in the photos was nearby, outside the next town.
sentences.zh: 照片里的动物园就在附近，位于下一个小镇的郊外。

sentences.en: She dreamed of one day seeing the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 她梦想有一天能看到太平洋。

sentences.en: Travel always filled her head with big dreams.
sentences.zh: 旅行总能让她的脑海充满远大的梦想。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a loud cry came from the next car.
sentences.zh: 突然，隔壁车厢传来一声响亮的喊叫。

sentences.en: An old woman shouted that her handbag was gone.
sentences.zh: 一位老奶奶大喊她的手提包不见了。

sentences.en: Her ticket and all her money were inside it.
sentences.zh: 她的车票和所有的钱都在包里。

sentences.en: A guard checked the monitor at the end of the car.
sentences.zh: 乘务员查看了车厢尽头的监控屏幕。

sentences.en: The camera showed a quick movement near the door.
sentences.zh: 摄像头拍到了车门附近一个快速的动作。

sentences.en: But nobody could see the person's face clearly.
sentences.zh: 但没有人能看清那个人的脸。

sentences.en: The guard asked questions, but none of the answers helped.
sentences.zh: 乘务员问了许多问题，可没有一个回答有用。

sentences.en: The thief seemed to hide like a mouse in a hole.
sentences.zh: 小偷仿佛老鼠钻进洞里一样藏了起来。

sentences.en: Mei stood up and looked around slowly.
sentences.zh: 小梅站起身，慢慢环顾四周。

sentences.en: She saw that Tao's face had turned pale.
sentences.zh: 她发现阿涛的脸变得苍白。

sentences.en: He bit his lip and touched his neck.
sentences.zh: 他咬着嘴唇，摸了摸脖子。

sentences.en: There was fresh paint under his nails.
sentences.zh: 他的指甲缝里有新鲜的颜料。

sentences.en: In the mirror by the door, Mei watched him quietly.
sentences.zh: 小梅透过门边的镜子悄悄观察他。

sentences.en: He opened his mouth to speak, then stopped.
sentences.zh: 他张开嘴想说什么，又停住了。

sentences.en: The tip of his nose was shining with sweat.
sentences.zh: 他的鼻尖上闪着汗珠。

sentences.en: Was he connected to the missing bag, or to something bigger?
sentences.zh: 他和丢失的包有关，还是和更大的事情有关？

sentences.en: That night, Mei could not fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，小梅怎么也睡不着。

sentences.en: At midnight, she heard soft steps in the passage.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，她听见过道里有轻轻的脚步声。

sentences.en: The moon shone through the window like a silver lamp.
sentences.zh: 月亮透过车窗照进来，像一盏银色的灯。

sentences.en: She saw Tao pulling at the lock on his metal box.
sentences.zh: 她看见阿涛正在拉扯箱子上的锁。

sentences.en: His hands shook, and he could not manage it.
sentences.zh: 他的手在发抖，怎么也打不开。

sentences.en: Mei asked gently, 'Is it really necessary to hide the truth?'
sentences.zh: 小梅温和地问：“真的有必要隐瞒真相吗？”

sentences.en: The night air was mild, and her voice was kind.
sentences.zh: 夜里的空气很温和，她的声音也很亲切。

sentences.en: Like magic, the fear in his eyes melted away.
sentences.zh: 像魔法一样，他眼中的恐惧慢慢消散了。

sentences.en: Tao opened the box and showed her a lovely painting of the sea.
sentences.zh: 阿涛打开箱子，给她看一幅美丽的大海画作。

sentences.en: 'I painted it myself, in secret,' he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “这是我自己偷偷画的。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'I want to mail it to a great art show for our nation.'
sentences.zh: “我想把它寄去参加我们国家的一个大型艺术展。”

sentences.en: 'This is my ninth try, and the other eight went nowhere.'
sentences.zh: “这是我第九次尝试，前八次都毫无结果。”

sentences.en: 'Failing again and again is painful,' he added.
sentences.zh: “一次又一次失败，实在太痛苦了。”他又说。

sentences.en: 'I felt lonely on this long road, so I told you a small story.'
sentences.zh: “在这条漫长的路上我很孤独，所以才向你编了个小故事。”

sentences.en: Mei smiled and said, 'Nine tries show a very strong heart.'
sentences.zh: 小梅笑着说：“九次尝试说明你的内心非常坚强。”

sentences.en: 'This time, I believe you will be lucky.'
sentences.zh: “这一次，我相信你会走运的。”

sentences.en: The next morning, the real thief ran into a parking area at a small station.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，真正的小偷逃进了一个小站的停车场。

sentences.en: He jumped on a motorcycle, but its motor would not start.
sentences.zh: 他跳上一辆摩托车，可发动机怎么也打不着。

sentences.en: The police stopped him by a ticket machine, and he was caught like a fish in a net.
sentences.zh: 警察在售票机旁拦住了他，他就像鱼落进网里一样被抓住了。

sentences.en: Mei felt that her luck had truly changed on this trip.
sentences.zh: 小梅觉得这趟旅程真的改变了她的运气。

sentences.en: Outside it was minus five degrees, but her heart was warm.
sentences.zh: 外面是零下五度，可她的心里暖暖的。

sentences.en: Soft snow clouds moved in from the northwest sky.
sentences.zh: 柔软的雪云从西北方的天空飘了过来。

sentences.en: 'We found the truth ourselves,' Tao said with a bright smile.
sentences.zh: “我们自己找到了真相。”阿涛灿烂地笑着说。

sentences.en: Under the round moon that evening, Mei's parents welcomed the two young people, a happy pair of new friends.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，在圆月之下，小梅的父母迎接了这两个年轻人——一对快乐的新朋友。

sentences.en: Lily lived in a small town in a southern province.
sentences.zh: 莉莉住在南方一个省份的小镇上。

sentences.en: Her family ran a little restaurant beside the old railway station.
sentences.zh: 她家在老火车站旁开着一家小餐馆。

sentences.en: Every morning she cooked rice and cut fresh potato for the lunch guests.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，她为午餐的客人煮米饭、切新鲜土豆。

sentences.en: Her uncle kept a fat pig and a soft grey rabbit behind the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 她叔叔在厨房后面养了一头肥猪和一只灰色的软毛兔子。

sentences.en: It was not for food; it was her pet.
sentences.zh: 那只兔子不是用来吃的，而是她的宠物。

sentences.en: Life there was quiet and pleasant, but Lily wanted something more.
sentences.zh: 那里的生活安静而惬意，但莉莉想要更多。

sentences.en: She dreamed about it while she washed dishes every night.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上洗碗时，她都在憧憬着自己的梦想。

sentences.en: Her grandmother had been a wonderful cook, and people had called her the queen of the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 她的祖母曾是一位了不起的厨师，人们称她为厨房里的女王。

sentences.en: Before she died, she gave Lily an old notebook written with a cheap pen.
sentences.zh: 去世前，祖母把一本用廉价钢笔写成的旧笔记本交给了莉莉。

sentences.en: Inside was her secret recipe for a golden pork pie.
sentences.zh: 里面记着她的秘方——一份金黄的猪肉馅饼。

sentences.en: The magic came from a special black pepper sauce.
sentences.zh: 它的魔力来自一种特制的黑胡椒酱。

sentences.en: On the first page, grandmother had printed a short phrase: 'Cook with love.'
sentences.zh: 在第一页上，祖母工整地写下了一句短语：“用爱做饭。”

sentences.en: Lily read those words every night and made a promise to herself.
sentences.zh: 莉莉每晚都读这句话，并对自己许下了承诺。

sentences.en: One day she would win a national cooking prize with that recipe.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，她要用这份秘方赢得全国烹饪大奖。

sentences.en: Professor Chen, her old physics teacher, often ate at their tables.
sentences.zh: 陈教授是她以前的物理老师，常来店里吃饭。

sentences.en: He played the piano there on Sunday evenings for fun.
sentences.zh: 每逢周日晚上，他会在店里弹钢琴自娱自乐。

sentences.en: One evening he showed Lily a newspaper photo of a cooking contest.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他给莉莉看了报纸上一张烹饪比赛的照片。

sentences.en: 'This TV programme is looking for young cooks,' he said.
sentences.zh: “这个电视节目正在寻找年轻厨师，”他说。

sentences.en: 'The final will be held in a big port city by the sea.'
sentences.zh: “决赛将在海边的一座大港口城市举行。”

sentences.en: Lily paused, and then she felt hope rise in her heart.
sentences.zh: 莉莉愣了一下，随后感到希望在心中升起。

sentences.en: 'You have real talent,' he added, 'so do not let fear prevent you.'
sentences.zh: “你真的有天赋，”他补充道，“别让恐惧阻止你。”

sentences.en: Her parents were patient people, but money was always a problem.
sentences.zh: 她的父母都是有耐心的人，可钱始终是个难题。

sentences.en: They counted every penny that the small business produced.
sentences.zh: 小店挣来的每一分钱，他们都要仔细清点。

sentences.en: Still, her father pulled some notes from his deep pocket.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，父亲还是从深深的口袋里掏出了几张钞票。

sentences.en: 'Take this,' he said with pride, 'and go make some progress.'
sentences.zh: “拿着，”他骄傲地说，“去闯出点名堂来。”

sentences.en: Lily refused at first, but he pushed the money into her hand.
sentences.zh: 莉莉起初拒绝了，但父亲把钱塞进了她手里。

sentences.en: She spent a whole week to prepare for the contest.
sentences.zh: 她花了整整一周时间为比赛做准备。

sentences.en: She would repeat each step until it felt proper and perfect.
sentences.zh: 她把每个步骤反复练习，直到做得恰到好处、完美无缺。

sentences.en: By Friday, the pie tasted almost like grandmother's own.
sentences.zh: 到了周五，馅饼的味道几乎和祖母做的一模一样了。

sentences.en: On Monday she packed her tools in a plastic box and set out.
sentences.zh: 周一，她把工具装进一个塑料盒里，动身出发了。

sentences.en: At the station, cold rain began to fall from a grey sky.
sentences.zh: 在车站，冰冷的雨从灰色的天空落了下来。

sentences.en: Water poured down along the shining rail lines.
sentences.zh: 雨水顺着发亮的铁轨倾泻而下。

sentences.en: Lily found her seat in row seven and sat down.
sentences.zh: 莉莉找到第七排的座位坐了下来。

sentences.en: A safety regulation said each passenger could carry only one bag.
sentences.zh: 一条安全规定说，每位乘客只能携带一件行李。

sentences.en: She held the notebook close to protect it from the wet.
sentences.zh: 她把笔记本紧紧抱在怀里，防止它被雨淋湿。

sentences.en: As the train moved, she closed her eyes and tried to relax.
sentences.zh: 火车开动后，她闭上眼睛，努力让自己放松下来。

sentences.en: Beside her sat an old man with a bright purple scarf.
sentences.zh: 她旁边坐着一位围着鲜艳紫色围巾的老人。

sentences.en: He told her he had worked as a pilot for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，自己当了三十年的飞行员。

sentences.en: 'I have flown a plane over half the planet,' he laughed.
sentences.zh: “我开着飞机飞过了半个地球，”他笑着说。

sentences.en: 'I even crossed Russia in the middle of winter once.'
sentences.zh: “我甚至在隆冬时节飞越过俄罗斯。”

sentences.en: He showed her a photograph of his crew beside a hotel pool.
sentences.zh: 他给她看了一张机组人员在酒店泳池边的合影。

sentences.en: Talking with him was a true pleasure for Lily.
sentences.zh: 和他聊天对莉莉来说是一种真正的乐趣。

sentences.en: They shared an orange and talked about food instead of politics.
sentences.zh: 他们分吃了一个橙子，聊的是美食而不是政治。

sentences.en: 'People regard cooking as simple work, but it is an art,' he said.
sentences.zh: “人们把做饭看作简单的活儿，其实它是一门艺术，”他说。

sentences.en: When the train stopped at a small station, a rough young man rushed in.
sentences.zh: 火车在一个小站停靠时，一个粗野的年轻人冲了进来。

sentences.en: He tried to rob a sleeping woman of her handbag.
sentences.zh: 他企图抢走一位熟睡妇女的手提包。

sentences.en: 'Stop!' Lily shouted, jumping up as quick as a runner.
sentences.zh: “住手！”莉莉喊道，像赛跑运动员一样迅速跳了起来。

sentences.en: The old man raised his voice and blocked the door.
sentences.zh: 老人提高了嗓门，挡住了车门。

sentences.en: The thief dropped the bag and ran off like a frightened rat.
sentences.zh: 小偷丢下包，像一只受惊的老鼠一样逃走了。

sentences.en: The thankful woman gave Lily a pink rose from her basket.
sentences.zh: 那位妇女满怀感激，从篮子里拿出一朵粉红玫瑰送给莉莉。

sentences.en: 'Kindness like yours deserves praise,' she said warmly.
sentences.zh: “你这样的善良值得称赞，”她温暖地说。

sentences.en: The next day, the train finally reached the great city by the sea.
sentences.zh: 第二天，火车终于抵达了那座海滨大城市。

sentences.en: Lily rented a small cheap room near the market.
sentences.zh: 莉莉在市场附近租了一间便宜的小房间。

sentences.en: Outside her window, a shop played loud pop music all evening.
sentences.zh: 窗外的一家商店整晚都在大声播放流行音乐。

sentences.en: That night she felt sad and alone, missing her home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她感到孤单难过，想念着家。

sentences.en: She took a pill for her headache and went to bed early.
sentences.zh: 她吃了一片治头痛的药，早早睡下了。

sentences.en: In the morning, a worker came to repair the broken oven downstairs.
sentences.zh: 早上，一位工人来修理楼下坏了的烤箱。

sentences.en: On the kitchen table lay a pile of fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 厨房的桌子上放着一堆新鲜蔬菜。

sentences.en: Lily practiced one last time and made a simple salad for lunch.
sentences.zh: 莉莉最后练习了一次，还做了一份简单的沙拉当午餐。

sentences.en: The contest hall was huge, and every cook needed a permit to enter.
sentences.zh: 比赛大厅非常大，每位厨师都需要许可证才能进入。

sentences.en: The rules were strict: two hours, one dish, no help.
sentences.zh: 规则很严格：两小时，一道菜，不许他人帮忙。

sentences.en: Each table had a stove, a pan, and one white plate.
sentences.zh: 每张桌子上有一个炉灶、一口平底锅和一只白盘子。

sentences.en: Next to Lily stood a tall cook who was very rude.
sentences.zh: 莉莉旁边站着一位高个子厨师，态度非常无礼。

sentences.en: 'A village girl?' he laughed. 'You should quit now.'
sentences.zh: “一个乡下姑娘？”他笑道，“你现在就该退出。”

sentences.en: Lily made no reply and kept her mind on the food.
sentences.zh: 莉莉没有回答，只是专心做她的菜。

sentences.en: Her hands remained steady while the clock ran on.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去，她的双手依然稳稳当当。

sentences.en: She put on rubber gloves and weighed out one pound of meat.
sentences.zh: 她戴上橡胶手套，称出了一磅肉。

sentences.en: Soon the warm smell of her pie filled the whole hall.
sentences.zh: 很快，她馅饼的温暖香气弥漫了整个大厅。

sentences.en: A judge cut a quarter of the pie and tasted it slowly.
sentences.zh: 一位评委切下四分之一块馅饼，慢慢品尝。

sentences.en: 'This is rich and warm, like a childhood memory,' he said softly.
sentences.zh: “味道浓郁而温暖，就像童年的记忆，”他轻声说。

sentences.en: The whole room waited for the final result.
sentences.zh: 全场的人都在等待最终的结果。

sentences.en: Then Lily's name was called, and she walked up on shaking legs.
sentences.zh: 接着，莉莉的名字被叫到了，她迈着发抖的双腿走上台。

sentences.en: She received a gold cup and a cheque from the judges.
sentences.zh: 她从评委手中接过了金杯和一张支票。

sentences.en: Only then did she realise that her dream had come true.
sentences.zh: 直到这时她才意识到，自己的梦想成真了。

sentences.en: The prize was money plus a chance to study in a famous school.
sentences.zh: 奖品不仅有奖金，还有一个去名校深造的机会。

sentences.en: Even the tall cook said sorry, and Lily regretted nothing about the hard road.
sentences.zh: 连那位高个子厨师也道了歉，而莉莉对这一路的艰辛毫无遗憾。

sentences.en: Reporters asked if she would stay, but she said she preferred her home town.
sentences.zh: 记者们问她是否会留在城里，但她说自己更喜欢家乡。

sentences.en: 'There is plenty of good food to cook there,' she smiled.
sentences.zh: “那里有很多好吃的东西等着我去做呢，”她微笑着说。

sentences.en: When she stepped off the train, her parents were pleased and proud.
sentences.zh: 当她走下火车时，父母既高兴又骄傲。

sentences.en: Her phone would not stop ringing with kind messages from neighbours.
sentences.zh: 她的手机响个不停，全是邻居们发来的祝福。

sentences.en: Professor Chen gave her a ride home along the river path.
sentences.zh: 陈教授开车载着她沿河边小路回了家。

sentences.en: 'One day I will sail across the sea and cook for the world,' Lily said.
sentences.zh: “总有一天，我要扬帆渡海，为全世界做饭，”莉莉说。

sentences.en: That spring, she planted a young fruit tree behind the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那年春天，她在厨房后面种下了一棵小果树。

sentences.en: Under its shade, she began to write new recipes of her own.
sentences.zh: 在树荫下，她开始书写属于自己的新菜谱。

articles.title: The Fallen Satellite
articles.topic_en: A Small Town Adventure: The Fallen Satellite

sentences.en: Mia lived with her older sister in a quiet southern town.
sentences.zh: 米娅和姐姐住在一个安静的南方小镇上。

sentences.en: The town sat by the sea, and life there was slow.
sentences.zh: 小镇坐落在海边，那里的生活节奏很慢。

sentences.en: It was spring, and every morning was bright and sunny.
sentences.zh: 正值春天，每个早晨都明亮而晴朗。

sentences.en: The sun rose early and made the water shine.
sentences.zh: 太阳早早升起，把海水照得闪闪发光。

sentences.en: White sand covered the long shore near their house.
sentences.zh: 洁白的沙子铺满了他们家附近长长的海岸。

sentences.en: Behind the house, their grandfather kept a few sheep on a hill.
sentences.zh: 屋后的小山上，祖父养着几只绵羊。

sentences.en: In the town square, the family owned a small shop.
sentences.zh: 在镇上的广场边，他们家开着一间小商店。

sentences.en: There they would sell bread, salt, and other simple things.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里卖面包、盐和其他简单的日用品。

sentences.en: Bars of soap stood in a neat row on a wooden shelf.
sentences.zh: 一块块肥皂整齐地排在木架子上。

sentences.en: Bags of sugar were kept beside them.
sentences.zh: 一袋袋糖就放在旁边。

sentences.en: One Saturday morning, there was a big sale in town.
sentences.zh: 一个周六的早晨，镇上举行了一场大促销。

sentences.en: People from nearby villages came to do their shopping.
sentences.zh: 附近村子的人们都赶来采购。

sentences.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the warm air.
sentences.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在温暖的空气中。

sentences.en: Mia made a cheese sandwich and helped behind the counter.
sentences.zh: 米娅做了一个奶酪三明治，然后在柜台后帮忙。

sentences.en: An old singer stood outside the door.
sentences.zh: 一位年老的歌手站在门外。

sentences.en: He began to sing a soft song about the sea.
sentences.zh: 他唱起了一首关于大海的轻柔歌曲。

sentences.en: Everyone stopped to listen with a smile.
sentences.zh: 大家都微笑着停下来聆听。

sentences.en: It was a happy day, full of warm sunshine.
sentences.zh: 那是快乐的一天，洒满温暖的阳光。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, a stranger walked into the shop.
sentences.zh: 下午，一个陌生人走进了商店。

sentences.en: He wore a grey suit and a clean white shirt.
sentences.zh: 他穿着灰色西装和干净的白衬衫。

sentences.en: He said he was a scientist from the capital city.
sentences.zh: 他说自己是来自首都的科学家。

sentences.en: "Last night, a small satellite fell from the sky," he explained.
sentences.zh: “昨晚，一颗小卫星从天上掉了下来。”他解释道。

sentences.en: "It landed somewhere near this town, maybe to the southwest."
sentences.zh: “它落在小镇附近的某个地方，也许在西南方向。”

sentences.en: "Or perhaps to the southeast, along the coast."
sentences.zh: “也可能在东南方向，沿着海岸一带。”

sentences.en: He showed them a picture on a small screen.
sentences.zh: 他在一个小屏幕上给他们看了一张图片。

sentences.en: The metal object had a strange round shape.
sentences.zh: 那个金属物体有着奇怪的圆形外观。

sentences.en: "It carries important scientific data," the man said.
sentences.zh: “它携带着重要的科学数据。”那人说。

sentences.en: "I must search for it before the weather changes."
sentences.zh: “我必须在天气变化之前把它找到。”

sentences.en: Mia felt a rush of excitement in her heart.
sentences.zh: 米娅心里涌起一阵兴奋。

sentences.en: News travels fast in a small town.
sentences.zh: 小镇上消息传得很快。

sentences.en: Soon the mayor arrived with his secretary.
sentences.zh: 很快，镇长带着他的秘书来了。

sentences.en: The mayor was a strict man who loved rules.
sentences.zh: 镇长是个严厉的人，最讲究规矩。

sentences.en: He stood on a stone step and gave a short speech.
sentences.zh: 他站在石阶上发表了一段简短的讲话。

sentences.en: "Nobody may touch that machine before I do," he announced.
sentences.zh: “在我之前，谁也不许碰那台机器。”他宣布。

sentences.en: His secretary wrote down every sentence of the order.
sentences.zh: 他的秘书把命令的每一句话都记了下来。

sentences.en: Old Ben raised his hand to suggest searching the hills first.
sentences.zh: 老本举手建议先去山里找。

sentences.en: "What a silly suggestion," the mayor said in a rude voice.
sentences.zh: “多么愚蠢的建议。”镇长粗鲁地说。

sentences.en: "Those hills are full of snakes; we will try the beach."
sentences.zh: “那些山里到处是蛇，我们去海滩找。”

sentences.en: Mia thought he was wrong, but she was too shy to shout.
sentences.zh: 米娅觉得他错了，但她太害羞，不敢喊出来。

sentences.en: The next day was Sunday, and the search began at dawn.
sentences.zh: 第二天是周日，搜寻在黎明时开始了。

sentences.en: A young soldier came from the army base to help.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻的士兵从军营赶来帮忙。

sentences.en: He brought a large supply of food and water.
sentences.zh: 他带来了大量的食物和水。

sentences.en: Mia joined the seventh group, which walked toward the hills.
sentences.zh: 米娅加入了第七小组，朝山里走去。

sentences.en: Her friend Tom was in the sixth group by the river.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友汤姆在河边的第六小组。

sentences.en: They marched all morning through wet, heavy soil.
sentences.zh: 他们整个上午都在潮湿泥泞的土地上行进。

sentences.en: The rough ground was hard on Mia's shoes.
sentences.zh: 崎岖的地面把米娅的鞋子磨得很惨。

sentences.en: A sharp stick cut right through one of them.
sentences.zh: 一根尖锐的树枝把其中一只鞋刺穿了。

sentences.en: Still, nobody found anything all morning.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，整个上午谁也没找到什么。

sentences.en: At noon they stopped to rest and drink hot soup.
sentences.zh: 中午，他们停下来休息，喝了热汤。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, the weather changed without any warning.
sentences.zh: 下午，天气毫无预兆地变了。

sentences.en: A sudden storm rolled in from the sea.
sentences.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨从海上袭来。

sentences.en: The wind was severe, and rain fell in grey sheets.
sentences.zh: 风势凶猛，雨水像灰色的幕布一样倾泻而下。

sentences.en: Lightning seemed to strike the water again and again.
sentences.zh: 闪电似乎一次又一次地劈向海面。

sentences.en: A fishing ship hurried back toward the harbor.
sentences.zh: 一艘渔船匆忙驶回港口。

sentences.en: For a moment, everyone feared it might sink.
sentences.zh: 有那么一刻，大家都担心它会沉没。

sentences.en: "Get inside now!" the soldier called, thinking of their safety.
sentences.zh: “快进屋去！”士兵喊道，一心想着大家的安全。

sentences.en: Mia and Tom ran and shut themselves inside an old barn.
sentences.zh: 米娅和汤姆跑进一个旧谷仓，关上了门。

sentences.en: The rain drummed on the roof like a cold shower.
sentences.zh: 雨点敲打着屋顶，像一场冰冷的淋浴。

sentences.en: They shook the water from their clothes and waited.
sentences.zh: 他们抖掉衣服上的水，静静等待。

sentences.en: Inside the barn, Mia noticed smoke rising in a corner.
sentences.zh: 在谷仓里，米娅注意到角落里升起了烟。

sentences.en: Somebody had arrived there before them.
sentences.zh: 有人比他们先到了那里。

sentences.en: Behind the hay, a man stood by a fire, smoking a pipe.
sentences.zh: 干草堆后面，一个男人站在火边抽着烟斗。

sentences.en: At his feet lay a round metal machine.
sentences.zh: 他脚边放着一台圆形的金属机器。

sentences.en: "It is the satellite!" Tom whispered.
sentences.zh: “是那颗卫星！”汤姆低声说。

sentences.en: Mia's stomach turned cold with fear.
sentences.zh: 米娅吓得胃里一阵发冷。

sentences.en: The man planned to steal it and sell it in the city.
sentences.zh: 那个男人打算把它偷走，拿到城里去卖。

sentences.en: "Keep my secret, or you will be sorry," he warned.
sentences.zh: “替我保密，不然你们会后悔的。”他警告道。

sentences.en: "Don't be stupid," Mia answered, amazed at her own courage.
sentences.zh: “别犯傻了。”米娅回答道，为自己的勇气感到吃惊。

sentences.en: "That machine is not yours to take."
sentences.zh: “那台机器不是你能拿走的。”

sentences.en: The thief jumped up and pushed past them to run.
sentences.zh: 小偷跳起来，推开他们就跑。

sentences.en: But Mia was a fast runner who loved every sport.
sentences.zh: 但米娅是个跑得很快的人，热爱各种运动。

sentences.en: In school races, she always had the best score.
sentences.zh: 在学校的赛跑中，她总是拿到最好的成绩。

sentences.en: She chased the man across a muddy spot by the door.
sentences.zh: 她追着那人跑过门边一片泥泞的地方。

sentences.en: Tom took a separate path to cut him off.
sentences.zh: 汤姆走了另一条路去拦截他。

sentences.en: The thief tried to shoot through the gate like an arrow.
sentences.zh: 小偷试图像箭一样从大门口冲出去。

sentences.en: Instead, he slipped in the mud and fell down hard.
sentences.zh: 结果，他在泥里滑了一跤，重重地摔倒了。

sentences.en: Just then, the soldier and the scientist reached the barn.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，士兵和科学家赶到了谷仓。

sentences.en: The storm had passed, and the thief's plan had failed.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨过去了，小偷的计划也失败了。

sentences.en: By evening, the clouds were gone and the air felt clean.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，云散了，空气清新宜人。

sentences.en: The man from the capital examined his machine with deep satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 那位来自首都的先生满意地仔细检查着他的机器。

sentences.en: "You two did a truly successful job," he told the children.
sentences.zh: “你们俩干得非常出色。”他对孩子们说。

sentences.en: "Few adults could succeed where you did."
sentences.zh: “很多大人都做不到你们做到的事。”

sentences.en: The mayor came too, and this time his words were kind.
sentences.zh: 镇长也来了，这一次他的话很和气。

sentences.en: "I suppose my idea about the beach was wrong," he admitted.
sentences.zh: “我想，我关于海滩的主意是错的。”他承认道。

sentences.en: That night, the town held a party at the restaurant near the water.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，镇上在水边的餐馆举行了聚会。

sentences.en: Mia's family came to serve sweet rice cakes.
sentences.zh: 米娅的家人来给大家端上香甜的米糕。

sentences.en: Old Ben, once a servant in a rich house, told funny stories.
sentences.zh: 曾在富人家当过仆人的老本讲起了有趣的故事。

sentences.en: The old singer sang with great spirit, and everyone joined in.
sentences.zh: 老歌手唱得神采飞扬，大家都跟着唱了起来。

sentences.en: Mia was given the best seat by the fire.
sentences.zh: 米娅被安排在炉火边最好的座位上。

sentences.en: To her surprise, the visitor gave her a rare stamp from the capital.
sentences.zh: 令她惊讶的是，那位来客送给她一枚来自首都的珍贵邮票。

sentences.en: Life slowly returned to normal after that weekend.
sentences.zh: 那个周末过后，生活慢慢恢复了平常。

sentences.en: At school, science became Mia's favorite subject.
sentences.zh: 在学校里，科学成了米娅最喜欢的科目。

sentences.en: She learned to spell long, difficult words about space.
sentences.zh: 她学会了拼写关于太空的又长又难的单词。

sentences.en: She wrote many letters, and her new friend never got sick of her questions.
sentences.zh: 她写了许多信，而她的新朋友从不厌烦她的问题。

sentences.en: In winter, when snow covered the hills, he visited again.
sentences.zh: 冬天，当雪覆盖群山时，他又来拜访了。

sentences.en: He even taught Mia and Tom how to ski on the white slopes.
sentences.zh: 他甚至教米娅和汤姆在白色的山坡上滑雪。

sentences.en: One evening, they all watched the sunset turn the sea orange.
sentences.zh: 一天傍晚，他们一起看着夕阳把大海染成橙色。

sentences.en: Mia smiled, knowing a small town could hold big adventures.
sentences.zh: 米娅微笑着，她知道小镇也能容纳大大的冒险。

sentences.en: Leo and Mia were twelve-year-old twins.
sentences.zh: 利奥和米娅是一对十二岁的双胞胎。

sentences.en: They lived in a quiet village at the bottom of a green valley.
sentences.zh: 他们住在青翠山谷底部的一个安静村庄里。

sentences.en: Fields of golden wheat surrounded their home, and life there was slow and simple.
sentences.zh: 金色的麦田环绕着他们的家，那里的生活缓慢而简单。

sentences.en: Like many teenagers, they dreamed of seeing a big city one day.
sentences.zh: 像许多青少年一样，他们梦想着有一天能见识大城市。

sentences.en: One Tuesday, their uncle called with exciting news.
sentences.zh: 一个星期二，他们的叔叔打来电话，带来了激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: He invited them to spend a weekend with him in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 他邀请他们去东京和他一起度过一个周末。

sentences.en: The children jumped with joy, because such a trip was rare for them.
sentences.zh: 兄妹俩高兴得跳了起来，因为这样的旅行对他们来说非常难得。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, their mother helped them pack their bags.
sentences.zh: 星期三，妈妈帮他们收拾行李。

sentences.en: Leo chose his favorite blue t-shirt, and Mia packed a warm jacket.
sentences.zh: 利奥挑了他最喜欢的蓝色T恤，米娅装上了一件暖和的外套。

sentences.en: Their father checked the weather report on television that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，爸爸在电视上查看了天气预报。

sentences.en: It said Thursday would be sunny, which was perfect for traveling.
sentences.zh: 预报说星期四是晴天，非常适合出行。

sentences.en: Early the next morning, they walked to the station and each bought a ticket.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，他们步行到车站，各买了一张票。

sentences.en: The fast train arrived on time, and they waved goodbye to their parents.
sentences.zh: 快速列车准时到达，他们向父母挥手告别。

sentences.en: Through the window, they watched every tall tree fly past.
sentences.zh: 透过车窗，他们看着一棵棵高大的树飞驰而过。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben met them at the station with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 本叔叔满面笑容地在车站迎接他们。

sentences.en: "Welcome to the city!" he shouted happily.
sentences.zh: “欢迎来到这座城市！”他开心地喊道。

sentences.en: Outside, the traffic was heavy, so they decided not to take a taxi.
sentences.zh: 外面交通拥堵，所以他们决定不坐出租车。

sentences.en: Instead, they went underground and rode the subway like local people.
sentences.zh: 他们转而走到地下，像本地人一样乘坐地铁。

sentences.en: Unlike their quiet home, the city was full of noise and light.
sentences.zh: 与他们安静的家乡不同，这座城市充满了喧闹和灯光。

sentences.en: His apartment was a small unit on the twenty-first floor.
sentences.zh: 他的公寓是二十一楼的一个小单元。

sentences.en: From the window, they could see thousands of lights below.
sentences.zh: 从窗户望出去，他们能看到楼下成千上万的灯火。

sentences.en: That night, he made them hot tea and told a funny tale about his youth.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他给他们泡了热茶，还讲了一个关于他年轻时的有趣故事。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben came to wake them at seven the next morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上七点，本叔叔来叫他们起床。

sentences.en: He had planned a full tour of the city for them.
sentences.zh: 他为他们计划了一整天的城市游览。

sentences.en: Their first stop was a famous tower that stood above everything.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一站是一座高耸入云的著名铁塔。

sentences.en: Hundreds of tourists were already waiting in line there.
sentences.zh: 数百名游客已经在那里排队等候。

sentences.en: "Tourism is big business here," Uncle Ben explained with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “旅游业在这里是大生意，”本叔叔笑着解释道。

sentences.en: At the top, the view seemed as wide as the universe.
sentences.zh: 在塔顶，视野辽阔得仿佛整个宇宙。

sentences.en: Mia said the streets below looked like toy cars on a map.
sentences.zh: 米娅说下面的街道看起来就像地图上的玩具汽车。

sentences.en: Leo took thirty photos in just twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 利奥在短短二十分钟内拍了三十张照片。

sentences.en: After lunch, they visited the city zoo.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，他们参观了城市动物园。

sentences.en: A huge tiger walked slowly behind the glass, moving its long tail.
sentences.zh: 一只巨大的老虎在玻璃后面缓缓走动，甩着长长的尾巴。

sentences.en: Its thick orange fur shone in the sunshine.
sentences.zh: 它厚厚的橙色皮毛在阳光下闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: Every sharp tooth showed when it opened its mouth wide.
sentences.zh: 它张大嘴巴时，每一颗锋利的牙齿都露了出来。

sentences.en: Its rough tongue licked a large piece of meat.
sentences.zh: 它粗糙的舌头舔着一大块肉。

sentences.en: A sign gave a clear warning: do not touch the glass.
sentences.zh: 一块牌子上写着明确的警告：请勿触摸玻璃。

sentences.en: Leo whispered that the animal must weigh a ton.
sentences.zh: 利奥小声说，这只动物肯定有一吨重。

sentences.en: A friendly animal trainer told them stories about its life.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的驯兽师给他们讲了它的生活故事。

sentences.en: In the evening, Uncle Ben had a surprise for them.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，本叔叔给了他们一个惊喜。

sentences.en: He took them to a traditional theatre near the river.
sentences.zh: 他带他们去了河边的一家传统剧院。

sentences.en: The actors wore beautiful costumes and moved like dancers.
sentences.zh: 演员们穿着漂亮的戏服，动作像舞者一样优美。

sentences.en: One actor played an old teacher who spoke wise words.
sentences.zh: 一位演员扮演一位说着智慧话语的老教师。

sentences.en: Mia felt a small tear in her eye during the sad ending.
sentences.zh: 在悲伤的结尾，米娅的眼里泛起了泪光。

sentences.en: Afterwards, they bought sweet cakes that had an amazing taste.
sentences.zh: 之后，他们买了甜甜的蛋糕，味道好极了。

sentences.en: It was the best treat of the whole day.
sentences.zh: 这是一整天里最棒的款待。

sentences.en: On Saturday morning, trouble arrived.
sentences.zh: 星期六早上，麻烦来了。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben could not find his wallet anywhere.
sentences.zh: 本叔叔到处都找不到他的钱包。

sentences.en: He searched every room, even behind the toilet door.
sentences.zh: 他找遍了每个房间，甚至连卫生间门后都看了。

sentences.en: "This is terrible," he said, turning pale.
sentences.zh: “这太糟糕了，”他说着，脸色发白。

sentences.en: All his money and cards were inside it.
sentences.zh: 他所有的钱和卡都在里面。

sentences.en: He felt like the victim of a clever thief.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己像是一个狡猾小偷的受害者。

sentences.en: It seemed so unfair after such a happy day.
sentences.zh: 在这么开心的一天之后发生这种事，实在太不公平了。

sentences.en: Mia suggested they think back over last night's steps.
sentences.zh: 米娅建议他们回想昨晚走过的路。

sentences.en: Leo remembered the ride home after the show.
sentences.zh: 利奥想起了看完演出后回家的那段路程。

sentences.en: He picked up the telephone and called the taxi company.
sentences.zh: 他拿起电话，打给了出租车公司。

sentences.en: The line was busy till almost ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 电话线一直占线，直到快十点。

sentences.en: Waiting felt like a waste of precious time.
sentences.zh: 等待感觉像是在浪费宝贵的时间。

sentences.en: "In the old days, people sent a telegraph for urgent news," he joked nervously.
sentences.zh: “在过去，人们遇到急事会发电报，”他紧张地开玩笑说。

sentences.en: Finally, a kind voice answered and promised to check the car.
sentences.zh: 终于，一个和善的声音接了电话，答应去检查那辆车。

sentences.en: The task now was simply to wait and hope.
sentences.zh: 现在的任务就只是等待和期盼。

sentences.en: To pass the time, Uncle Ben took them to a park nearby.
sentences.zh: 为了打发时间，本叔叔带他们去了附近的公园。

sentences.en: The park had a pool where children could swim for free.
sentences.zh: 公园里有一个孩子们可以免费游泳的池子。

sentences.en: Mia loved swimming, but she had not brought her swimsuit.
sentences.zh: 米娅喜欢游泳，但她没有带泳衣。

sentences.en: Instead, she sat on a swing and pushed herself gently.
sentences.zh: 于是她坐在秋千上，轻轻地荡着。

sentences.en: Leo watched a thin old man doing slow morning exercise.
sentences.zh: 利奥看着一位瘦瘦的老人慢慢地做早操。

sentences.en: The temperature rose quickly, and both children felt hot.
sentences.zh: 气温迅速升高，两个孩子都觉得热了。

sentences.en: Some campers had set up a tent on the grass, which was unusual for a city park.
sentences.zh: 几位露营者在草地上搭了一顶帐篷，这在城市公园里很少见。

sentences.en: Then a sudden rain shower made everyone wet within minutes.
sentences.zh: 接着一场突如其来的阵雨，几分钟内就把所有人都淋湿了。

sentences.en: They ran back through the rain, tired and laughing.
sentences.zh: 他们冒雨往回跑，虽然疲惫却笑个不停。

sentences.en: On the way, a delivery truck had lost a wheel and blocked the narrow street.
sentences.zh: 路上，一辆送货卡车掉了一个轮子，堵住了狭窄的街道。

sentences.en: The driver was trying to fix it with a simple tool.
sentences.zh: 司机正试图用一件简单的工具修理它。

sentences.en: It looked like a tough job for one person.
sentences.zh: 这活儿看起来一个人干太吃力了。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben stopped to help, holding the parts together with strong tape.
sentences.zh: 本叔叔停下来帮忙，用结实的胶带把零件固定在一起。

sentences.en: The driver thanked him twice and shook his hand.
sentences.zh: 司机连声道谢了两次，还和他握了手。

sentences.en: "A kind hand is always useful," Uncle Ben said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “一双援手总是有用的，”本叔叔微笑着说。

sentences.en: Back at the apartment, they heard the phone ringing.
sentences.zh: 回到公寓，他们听到电话铃响了。

sentences.en: An unknown number appeared on the screen.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上显示的是一个陌生号码。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben answered, and his face changed at once.
sentences.zh: 本叔叔接了电话，脸色立刻变了。

sentences.en: The driver had found the lost wallet under the back seat.
sentences.zh: 那位司机在后座下面发现了丢失的钱包。

sentences.en: He promised to bring it over that afternoon, unless the traffic became too bad.
sentences.zh: 他答应下午把钱包送过来，除非路上堵得太厉害。

sentences.en: At three o'clock, a visitor knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 三点钟，一位访客敲响了门。

sentences.en: It was the driver, a young man of about twenty-one with a neat tie.
sentences.zh: 来的正是那位司机，一个大约二十一岁、系着整洁领带的年轻人。

sentences.en: Nothing was missing, not even a single coin.
sentences.zh: 钱包里什么都没少，连一枚硬币都没丢。

sentences.en: Uncle Ben tried to give him a reward, but the young man refused with a shy smile.
sentences.zh: 本叔叔想给他酬谢，但年轻人腼腆地笑着拒绝了。

sentences.en: "This city can feel like a trap of stress, but kind people make it home," Uncle Ben said.
sentences.zh: “这座城市有时像一个压力的陷阱，但善良的人让它变成了家，”本叔叔说。

sentences.en: That evening, the three of them shared a quiet understanding.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们三人心照不宣，彼此默契。

sentences.en: Worry, they agreed, is a useless guest in a happy house.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，忧虑是幸福之家中一位无用的客人。

sentences.en: As a regular taxi user, Ben promised to check his pockets from now on.
sentences.zh: 作为一个经常坐出租车的人，本保证从今以后都会检查口袋。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the twins packed their bags as usual.
sentences.zh: 星期天，双胞胎像往常一样收拾好了行李。

sentences.en: Their legs felt weak from all the walking, but their hearts were full.
sentences.zh: 走了那么多路，他们的腿发软，心里却满满的。

sentences.en: On the ride home, Leo never seemed to tire of watching the lights fade.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，利奥看着灯火渐渐远去，怎么也看不厌。

sentences.en: Thus ended their first great adventure away from home.
sentences.zh: 他们第一次离家的大冒险就这样结束了。

sentences.en: Whenever they remember that weekend, they smile and plan the next visit.
sentences.zh: 每当想起那个周末，他们都会微笑，并计划着下一次的到访。

articles.title: Winter in Grandfather's Village
articles.topic_en: A Winter Trip to the Countryside

sentences.en: Last winter, I traveled to my grandfather's village in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天，我去乡下探望住在村里的爷爷。

sentences.en: I was eighteen years old that year, free for the first time.
sentences.zh: 那一年我十八岁，第一次有了完全属于自己的假期。

sentences.en: I took an airplane first and then a slow country bus.
sentences.zh: 我先坐了飞机，然后换乘一辆慢吞吞的乡村巴士。

sentences.en: The bus conductor was a kind old woman with a loud voice.
sentences.zh: 巴士售票员是一位嗓门很大的和善老太太。

sentences.en: She told me the weather had turned cold and cloudy that week.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我那一周天气转冷，天空阴沉。

sentences.en: The temperature outside had already dropped below zero.
sentences.zh: 外面的气温已经降到了零度以下。

sentences.en: Through the window I watched the white fields pass by.
sentences.zh: 我透过车窗，望着白茫茫的田野一一掠过。

sentences.en: A strong wind pushed against the small bus again and again.
sentences.zh: 强劲的风一次又一次地吹打着这辆小巴士。

sentences.en: Thick fog lay quietly over the river valley.
sentences.zh: 浓雾静静地笼罩着河谷。

sentences.en: On such a foggy day, the driver had to move very slowly.
sentences.zh: 在这样大雾的天气里，司机只能开得很慢。

sentences.en: I did not mind at all, because my heart was full of quiet joy.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不介意，因为我心里满是安静的喜悦。

sentences.en: My grandfather is an old fisherman, almost eighty now.
sentences.zh: 我的爷爷是一位老渔夫，如今快八十岁了。

sentences.en: Yesterday, just before I arrived, he had fallen in his yard.
sentences.zh: 就在我到达的前一天，他在院子里摔了一跤。

sentences.en: The wound on his leg looked deep and painful.
sentences.zh: 他腿上的伤口看起来又深又疼。

sentences.en: My aunt was so worried that she could not sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 我的姑姑担心得夜里睡不着觉。

sentences.en: "Don't worry about me," Grandfather said with a weak smile.
sentences.zh: “别为我担心，”爷爷带着虚弱的微笑说。

sentences.en: But by evening his leg looked even worse than before.
sentences.zh: 可是到了晚上，他的腿看起来比之前更糟了。

sentences.en: He also had a bad cough from the cold air.
sentences.zh: 因为吸了冷空气，他还咳嗽得很厉害。

sentences.en: We found the number of the town hospital in an old directory.
sentences.zh: 我们在一本旧电话簿里找到了镇医院的电话号码。

sentences.en: My aunt began to dial with shaking fingers.
sentences.zh: 姑姑用颤抖的手指开始拨号。

sentences.en: A doctor on the phone promised to see him the next morning.
sentences.zh: 电话里的医生答应第二天早上给他看病。

sentences.en: At the hospital, we took an elevator up to the third floor.
sentences.zh: 在医院里，我们乘电梯上了三楼。

sentences.en: A nurse took an x-ray of Grandfather's injured leg.
sentences.zh: 一位护士给爷爷受伤的腿拍了X光片。

sentences.en: The doctor drew a simple diagram to explain the bone to us.
sentences.zh: 医生画了一张简单的示意图，向我们解释骨头的情况。

sentences.en: "It is not the worst kind of injury," he said kindly.
sentences.zh: “这不是最严重的那种伤，”他和气地说。

sentences.en: "The wounded leg only needs rest and clean bandages."
sentences.zh: “受伤的腿只需要休息和干净的绷带。”

sentences.en: My aunt paid the bill with a cheque at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 姑姑在前台用支票付了账单。

sentences.en: The small hospital was surprisingly well equipped with modern machines.
sentences.zh: 这家小医院的现代化设备出人意料地齐全。

sentences.en: They even sent the report to our village clinic by fax.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至用传真把报告发给了我们村的诊所。

sentences.en: Walking out, we all felt as light as a feather.
sentences.zh: 走出医院时，我们都感觉像羽毛一样轻松。

sentences.en: Grandfather laughed and said, "Anyhow, I am too old to run away."
sentences.zh: 爷爷笑着说：“反正我也老得跑不动了。”

sentences.en: Back home, I did my best to make the house warm and bright.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，我尽力把屋子弄得温暖明亮。

sentences.en: I lit a big fire in the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 我在壁炉里生起了一大炉火。

sentences.en: Grey smoke rose from the chimney into the evening sky.
sentences.zh: 灰色的炊烟从烟囱升起，飘进傍晚的天空。

sentences.en: I closed the heavy curtain to keep out the cold.
sentences.zh: 我拉上厚厚的窗帘，把寒气挡在外面。

sentences.en: Grandfather rested his leg on a soft cushion by the fire.
sentences.zh: 爷爷把腿搁在火边一个柔软的垫子上休息。

sentences.en: I took two cups from the cupboard and made hot cocoa.
sentences.zh: 我从碗柜里拿出两个杯子，冲了热可可。

sentences.en: In an old drawer I found his photos from long ago.
sentences.zh: 在一个旧抽屉里，我找到了他很久以前的照片。

sentences.en: One picture showed him in his youth, standing beside a small boat.
sentences.zh: 有一张照片是他年轻时站在一条小船旁拍的。

sentences.en: "That was my canoe," he said with quiet pride.
sentences.zh: “那是我的独木舟，”他带着淡淡的自豪说。

sentences.en: "In the daytime I fished, and at night I sang to the stars."
sentences.zh: “白天我打鱼，晚上就对着星星唱歌。”

sentences.en: "We all loved boating on that wide, shining river."
sentences.zh: “我们都喜欢在那条宽阔闪亮的河上划船。”

sentences.en: The next morning, I rode an old bicycle into the village center.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我骑着一辆旧自行车去了村中心。

sentences.en: I had to fetch some fresh vegetables for our soup.
sentences.zh: 我得去取一些新鲜蔬菜回来做汤。

sentences.en: At the market I bought a cabbage and a bag of carrots.
sentences.zh: 在集市上，我买了一棵卷心菜和一袋胡萝卜。

sentences.en: On the way back, I passed a small bookshop with a green door.
sentences.zh: 回来的路上，我经过一家绿门的小书店。

sentences.en: It was much smaller than the big bookstore in my city.
sentences.zh: 它比我所在城市的大书店小得多。

sentences.en: The owner, Mr. Wu, was once a busy businessman in Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 店主吴先生曾是上海一位忙碌的商人。

sentences.en: He gave me a paper bookmark as a small welcome gift.
sentences.zh: 他送了我一枚纸书签，作为小小的见面礼。

sentences.en: On his wall hung a bright advertisement for the village winter festival.
sentences.zh: 他的墙上挂着一张村里冬季节日的鲜艳海报。

sentences.en: Its caption read, "Come and share the warmest night of the year!"
sentences.zh: 海报上的标题写着：“来分享一年中最温暖的夜晚吧！”

sentences.en: The idea of the festival began to excite me greatly.
sentences.zh: 这个节日的想法让我兴奋不已。

sentences.en: In the afternoon I visited the old village school on the hill.
sentences.zh: 下午，我去了山坡上那所古老的乡村学校。

sentences.en: My former classmate Hua now teaches the children there.
sentences.zh: 我以前的同学小华如今在那里教孩子们读书。

sentences.en: She was writing on the blackboard when I stepped inside.
sentences.zh: 我走进教室时，她正在黑板上写字。

sentences.en: White chalk dust covered the sleeves of her blue blouse.
sentences.zh: 白色的粉笔灰落满了她蓝色衬衫的袖子。

sentences.en: "Sorry to disturb your class," I said quietly at the door.
sentences.zh: “抱歉打扰你上课，”我在门口轻声说。

sentences.en: She smiled and welcomed me in at once.
sentences.zh: 她笑着立刻请我进去。

sentences.en: After class, we talked about our plans for the festival night.
sentences.zh: 下课后，我们聊起了节日晚会的计划。

sentences.en: "Old Mrs. Chen is deaf, so we must invite her in person," Hua said.
sentences.zh: “陈奶奶耳朵聋了，我们得当面去请她，”小华说。

sentences.en: "Wherever she goes, the children follow her for her stories."
sentences.zh: “无论她走到哪里，孩子们都跟着她听故事。”

sentences.en: "She is the one whom everyone in this village loves most," I agreed.
sentences.zh: “她是全村人最爱的人，”我表示赞同。

sentences.en: That evening by the fire, Grandfather told me about last summer's drought.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，在炉火边，爷爷跟我讲起去年夏天的旱灾。

sentences.en: For two long months, no rain fell on the farmland.
sentences.zh: 整整两个月，农田里没有落下一滴雨。

sentences.en: The river became low, and the wheat turned yellow far too early.
sentences.zh: 河水变浅了，麦子也过早地变黄了。

sentences.en: A few careless people had wasted the little water they had.
sentences.zh: 有几个粗心的人还浪费了他们仅有的一点水。

sentences.en: Others had to walk farther and farther to find clean wells.
sentences.zh: 其他人不得不越走越远去寻找干净的水井。

sentences.en: The farthest well was almost ten kilometers away from the village.
sentences.zh: 最远的一口井离村子差不多有十公里。

sentences.en: "One young worker from the water station helped us for free," he said.
sentences.zh: “水站的一个年轻工人免费帮了我们，”他说。

sentences.en: "He treated our village like his own workplace and his own home."
sentences.zh: “他把我们村当成自己的工作地方，也当成自己的家。”

sentences.en: "We shared everything in those days, like true comrades," Grandfather added.
sentences.zh: “那些日子里我们分享一切，像真正的同志一样，”爷爷补充道。

sentences.en: "That hard time taught the whole village the meaning of brotherhood."
sentences.zh: “那段艰难的日子让全村人懂得了手足情谊的含义。”

sentences.en: I listened in silence, deeply moved by his words.
sentences.zh: 我静静地听着，被他的话深深打动。

sentences.en: On Saturday, the whole village came together to prepare for the festival.
sentences.zh: 星期六，全村人聚在一起为节日做准备。

sentences.en: Everyone helped decorate the old hall with lights and red paper.
sentences.zh: 大家一起用彩灯和红纸装饰旧礼堂。

sentences.en: We hung a red balloon above every door.
sentences.zh: 我们在每扇门上方都挂了一只红气球。

sentences.en: Hua cut colored paper into the shape of a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 小华把彩纸剪成蝴蝶的形状。

sentences.en: I swept the dusty floor with a big broom.
sentences.zh: 我用一把大扫帚把满是灰尘的地板扫干净。

sentences.en: The men built long tables from smooth pieces of wood.
sentences.zh: 男人们用光滑的木板搭起了长桌。

sentences.en: Others tied paper lanterns to tall bamboo poles outside.
sentences.zh: 另一些人把纸灯笼绑在外面高高的竹竿上。

sentences.en: The women began to bake sweet bread for the children.
sentences.zh: 妇女们开始为孩子们烤香甜的面包。

sentences.en: Mr. Wu brought two bottles of his homemade wine.
sentences.zh: 吴先生带来了两瓶自酿的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: We placed a small candle at the center of every table.
sentences.zh: 我们在每张桌子中央都放了一支小蜡烛。

sentences.en: At dusk, the old hall began to glow with soft light.
sentences.zh: 黄昏时分，旧礼堂开始泛起柔和的光。

sentences.en: Outside, the winter sky grew dim as night slowly fell.
sentences.zh: 外面，夜幕慢慢降临，冬日的天空变得昏暗。

sentences.en: Downstairs in the warm hall, happy music started to play.
sentences.zh: 楼下温暖的大厅里，欢快的音乐响了起来。

sentences.en: In one corner, the old men played chess and drank tea.
sentences.zh: 在一个角落里，老人们一边下棋一边喝茶。

sentences.en: Grandfather, with his bandaged leg, became the winner of three games.
sentences.zh: 缠着绷带的爷爷连赢了三盘棋。

sentences.en: Everyone crowded around to congratulate him warmly.
sentences.zh: 大家围过来热情地向他道贺。

sentences.en: "The prize is yours, old captain!" Mr. Wu shouted with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “奖品是你的了，老船长！”吴先生笑着喊道。

sentences.en: Grandfather's delight made him look twenty years younger.
sentences.zh: 爷爷高兴得像是年轻了二十岁。

sentences.en: Later, the children asked me many questions about the city zoo.
sentences.zh: 后来，孩子们问了我许多关于城市动物园的问题。

sentences.en: "Is it true that you rode a camel there?" one boy asked.
sentences.zh: “你真的在那里骑过骆驼吗？”一个男孩问。

sentences.en: Their bright eyes were full of wonder.
sentences.zh: 他们明亮的眼睛里满是好奇与惊叹。

sentences.en: I told them stories until the moon rose high above the hills.
sentences.zh: 我给他们讲故事，直到月亮高高地升上山头。

sentences.en: That evening was the most enjoyable night of my whole life.
sentences.zh: 那个夜晚是我一生中最快乐的一晚。

sentences.en: I felt real envy for their simple and warm way of life.
sentences.zh: 我真心羡慕他们简单而温暖的生活方式。

sentences.en: Such deep joy would truly amaze my busy friends in the city.
sentences.zh: 这样深切的快乐一定会让我城里忙碌的朋友们感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Before I left, fresh snow came and buried the fields in white.
sentences.zh: 在我离开之前，新雪落下，把田野埋进了一片洁白之中。

sentences.en: At the station, Grandfather pressed an envelope into my hand.
sentences.zh: 在车站，爷爷把一个信封塞进我手里。

sentences.en: Inside was an old photo of the two of us fishing together.
sentences.zh: 里面是一张我们俩一起钓鱼的老照片。

sentences.en: "I am very fond of you, child," he said softly.
sentences.zh: “孩子，我很疼爱你，”他轻声说。

sentences.en: "Come back whenever you can, and this house will be waiting."
sentences.zh: “你什么时候能回来就回来，这个家一直等着你。”

sentences.en: I waved from the bus until his figure grew small and disappeared.
sentences.zh: 我在车上不停地挥手，直到他的身影变小、消失。

sentences.en: It was, in every way, a truly wonderful trip.
sentences.zh: 无论从哪个方面看，这都是一次无比美妙的旅行。

articles.title: The Parrot and the Silver Necklace

sentences.en: Lin Mei was fourteen years old, a lively girl with a bright smile.
sentences.zh: 林梅十四岁了，是个笑容灿烂、活泼开朗的女孩。

sentences.en: Every summer she left the noisy city behind.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，她都会离开喧闹的城市。

sentences.en: She travelled to her hometown, a small village on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 她回到自己的家乡——内陆的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: Her grandparents lived there in an old house with a big garden.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父母住在那里一座带大花园的老房子里。

sentences.en: At the station, her mother said, 'Be good, and help Granny with the housework.'
sentences.zh: 在车站，妈妈叮嘱她：“要乖，记得帮奶奶做家务。”

sentences.en: 'Yes, Mommy,' Lin Mei answered, and she waved goodbye from the window.
sentences.zh: “好的，妈妈。”林梅答应着，在车窗边挥手告别。

sentences.en: The village was about ninety kilometres away, and the train ride was slow but enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 村子离城里大约九十公里，火车开得很慢，旅途却很愉快。

sentences.en: Grandpa met her at the station in his old green jeep.
sentences.zh: 爷爷开着他那辆绿色的旧吉普车到车站接她。

sentences.en: He was a retired inventor, and his workshop was full of strange machines.
sentences.zh: 他是一位退休的发明家，工作室里摆满了各种奇怪的机器。

sentences.en: 'Welcome home, my dear granddaughter!' he shouted loudly.
