sentences.zh: “欢迎回家，我亲爱的孙女！”他大声喊道。

sentences.en: Lin Mei laughed and gave him a big hug.
sentences.zh: 林梅笑着给了他一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: On the way home, morning mist still covered the green farmland.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，清晨的薄雾还笼罩着绿油油的农田。

sentences.en: Granny was waiting for them by the gate with a warm smile.
sentences.zh: 奶奶带着温暖的笑容在门口等着他们。

sentences.en: She greeted them warmly, holding a fat white goose in her arms.
sentences.zh: 她热情地跟他们打招呼，怀里还抱着一只肥肥的大白鹅。

sentences.en: 'What a merry morning this is!' she said, and everyone went inside.
sentences.zh: “多么快乐的早晨啊！”她说着，大家一起走进屋里。

sentences.en: On the table there was warm porridge and a plate of sweet pears.
sentences.zh: 桌上摆着热腾腾的粥和一盘香甜的梨。

sentences.en: Life in the village was simple but never boring.
sentences.zh: 村里的生活简单，却从不无聊。

sentences.en: Every morning, Granny fed the hens and collected their brown eggs.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，奶奶喂母鸡，收集它们下的褐色鸡蛋。

sentences.en: In the kitchen, Lin Mei learned how to fry eggs and cook noodles.
sentences.zh: 在厨房里，林梅学会了煎鸡蛋和煮面条。

sentences.en: 'A person should learn to take care of oneself,' Grandpa said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “人应该学会照顾自己。”爷爷笑着说。

sentences.en: Lin Mei swept the floor every day and kept her small room neat.
sentences.zh: 林梅每天扫地，把自己的小房间收拾得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: Her favourite hobby was flying her red kite in the open fields.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢的爱好是在开阔的田野上放红风筝。

sentences.en: Children from the neighbourhood often joined her, and their kind neighbour Mrs. Wang watched from her gate.
sentences.zh: 附近的孩子们常来和她一起玩，善良的邻居王太太就在自家门口看着他们。

sentences.en: Playing outdoors all afternoon made everyone hungry and happy.
sentences.zh: 在户外玩上一下午，大家都又饿又开心。

sentences.en: Grandpa's newest idea was a machine that could water the garden by itself.
sentences.zh: 爷爷最新的点子是一台能自动给花园浇水的机器。

sentences.en: 'To invent something useful, you must be hardworking,' he told her.
sentences.zh: “想发明有用的东西，就必须勤奋。”他告诉她。

sentences.en: He kept his ideas in a thick notebook, and his handwriting was small but clear.
sentences.zh: 他把想法都记在一本厚厚的笔记本里，字迹虽小却很清楚。

sentences.en: He always said a good maker must inspect every part twice.
sentences.zh: 他总说，一个好的工匠必须把每个零件检查两遍。

sentences.en: 'A famous physicist once said that questions matter more than answers,' he added.
sentences.zh: “一位著名的物理学家曾说过，问题比答案更重要。”他补充道。

sentences.en: In the evenings, he helped Lin Mei with her geography and geometry homework.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他辅导林梅做地理和几何作业。

sentences.en: 'Multiply the length by the width, and you get the area,' he would instruct her patiently.
sentences.zh: “长乘以宽，就得到面积。”他总是耐心地指导她。

sentences.en: Lin Mei would nod and write the answers down with her pencil.
sentences.zh: 林梅会点点头，用铅笔把答案写下来。

sentences.en: One morning, a foreigner arrived in the village with a big bag of brushes.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，一位外国人背着一大袋画笔来到了村里。

sentences.en: He was a Frenchman named Mr. Dubois, and he worked as a painter.
sentences.zh: 他是一位名叫杜布瓦先生的法国人，是个画家。

sentences.en: He had come to paint the old stone monument in the village square.
sentences.zh: 他是来画村广场上那座古老石碑的。

sentences.en: Beside it stood a small fountain where children loved to play.
sentences.zh: 石碑旁有一座小喷泉，孩子们最爱在那里玩耍。

sentences.en: At first, some villagers were shy and did not talk to him.
sentences.zh: 起初，有些村民很害羞，不敢跟他说话。

sentences.en: But he was polite and kind-hearted, and soon everyone liked him.
sentences.zh: 但他既有礼貌又心地善良，很快大家都喜欢上了他。

sentences.en: 'France is my homeland,' he said, 'but this village feels like home too.'
sentences.zh: “法国是我的祖国，”他说，“但这个村子也让我有家的感觉。”

sentences.en: On his shoulder sat a colourful parrot that could say hello in three languages.
sentences.zh: 他肩上停着一只五彩的鹦鹉，会用三种语言说“你好”。

sentences.en: Lin Mei often showed Mr. Dubois around the village.
sentences.zh: 林梅常常带杜布瓦先生在村里四处参观。

sentences.en: They visited the school, where the headmaster proudly showed them the new playground.
sentences.zh: 他们参观了学校，校长自豪地带他们看了新操场。

sentences.en: Some students were playing ping-pong under the trees.
sentences.zh: 几个学生正在树下打乒乓球。

sentences.en: In the library, the friendly librarian let Mr. Dubois borrow books about Chinese history.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆，友好的图书管理员让杜布瓦先生借阅有关中国历史的书。

sentences.en: 'I can lend you my dictionary too,' Lin Mei offered.
sentences.zh: “我还可以把我的词典借给你。”林梅主动说。

sentences.en: At the market, they bought a kilo of purple grapes.
sentences.zh: 在集市上，他们买了一公斤紫葡萄。

sentences.en: Mr. Dubois also picked out a big sweet melon.
sentences.zh: 杜布瓦先生还挑了一个又大又甜的瓜。

sentences.en: They also needed to buy two kilograms of mutton for dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们还要买两公斤羊肉当晚餐。

sentences.en: That evening, Mr. Dubois tried a bowl of hot noodles and said it was better than any hamburger.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，杜布瓦先生尝了一碗热面条，说它比任何汉堡都好吃。

sentences.en: Mr. Dubois wrote postcards to his family every week.
sentences.zh: 杜布瓦先生每周都给家人写明信片。

sentences.en: 'How much is the postage to France?' he asked the postman.
sentences.zh: “寄到法国的邮资是多少？”他问邮递员。

sentences.en: 'Please write the postcode clearly,' the postman reminded him with a smile.
sentences.zh: “请把邮政编码写清楚。”邮递员微笑着提醒他。

sentences.en: That weekend, Lin Mei's aunt came to visit with her little niece.
sentences.zh: 那个周末，林梅的姑姑带着她的小侄女来做客。

sentences.en: Granny was happiest when a grandchild sat on each side of her.
sentences.zh: 两边各坐着一个孙辈孩子的时候，奶奶最开心。

sentences.en: 'My grandson lives far away, and I miss him very much,' she said softly.
sentences.zh: “我的孙子住得很远，我非常想他。”她轻声说。

sentences.en: Mrs. Wang, a cheerful housewife, came over with a packet of tea.
sentences.zh: 开朗的家庭主妇王太太带着一包茶叶过来串门。

sentences.en: The two old women mended socks together and searched for a lost needle in the sewing box.
sentences.zh: 两位老人一起缝补袜子，还在针线盒里找一根丢失的针。

sentences.en: One sunny Saturday, the whole family planned a picnic by the river.
sentences.zh: 一个晴朗的星期六，全家人计划去河边野餐。

sentences.en: For the special day, she put on her silver necklace, an old family gift.
sentences.zh: 为了这个特别的日子，奶奶戴上了她的银项链，那是一件传家的老礼物。

sentences.en: She packed bread, boiled peas, and fruit into her big handbag.
sentences.zh: 她把面包、煮豌豆和水果装进了她的大手提包里。

sentences.en: They found a quiet spot only ten metres from the water.
sentences.zh: 他们在离水边只有十米远的地方找到了一块安静的空地。

sentences.en: Small insects buzzed softly in the warm air.
sentences.zh: 小昆虫在温暖的空气中轻轻地嗡嗡叫着。

sentences.en: They laughed at a funny story about a kangaroo and a panda who became friends.
sentences.zh: 大家听了一个袋鼠和熊猫成为朋友的有趣故事，笑个不停。

sentences.en: It was a perfect afternoon, full of songs and laughter.
sentences.zh: 那是一个完美的下午，充满了歌声和笑声。

sentences.en: Then, suddenly, Granny cried out in alarm.
sentences.zh: 可就在这时，奶奶突然惊叫了一声。

sentences.en: 'My necklace! It's gone!' she said, touching her empty neck.
sentences.zh: “我的项链！不见了！”她摸着空空的脖子说。

sentences.en: Everyone searched the grass, but they found only some litter left by other visitors.
sentences.zh: 大家在草地上到处找，却只找到别的游客留下的一些垃圾。

sentences.en: 'What a pity,' said Aunt Hua sadly. 'It was so beautiful.'
sentences.zh: “太可惜了，”华姑姑难过地说，“那条项链那么漂亮。”

sentences.en: 'It was foolish of me to wear it outside,' Granny whispered.
sentences.zh: “我真傻，不该把它戴出来。”奶奶低声说。

sentences.en: Then a boy shouted that he had seen the parrot flying away with something shiny.
sentences.zh: 这时，一个男孩喊道，他看见那只鹦鹉叼着一个亮闪闪的东西飞走了。

sentences.en: A few villagers began to whisper about the foreigner.
sentences.zh: 几个村民开始对这位外国人窃窃私语。

sentences.en: All the noise gave poor Mr. Dubois a terrible headache.
sentences.zh: 这一片吵闹声让可怜的杜布瓦先生头疼得厉害。

sentences.en: 'Pardon me,' he said quietly, 'but I would never take anything from you.'
sentences.zh: “请原谅，”他轻声说，“但我绝不会拿你们的任何东西。”

sentences.en: Just then, a young policeman rode up on his motorbike.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一位年轻的警察骑着摩托车赶了过来。

sentences.en: He asked everyone to stay calm and obey his simple instructions.
sentences.zh: 他让大家保持冷静，听从他简单的指挥。

sentences.en: 'Birds love shiny things,' he explained. 'Let us follow the parrot.'
sentences.zh: “鸟儿喜欢亮闪闪的东西，”他解释道，“我们跟着那只鹦鹉走。”

sentences.en: The bird led them back to a tall tree near the fountain.
sentences.zh: 那只鸟把他们带回到喷泉旁的一棵大树下。

sentences.en: There, in an old nest, lay the silver necklace, safe and bright.
sentences.zh: 就在一个旧鸟巢里，那条银项链安然无恙地躺在那里，闪闪发光。

sentences.en: 'It is hers!' Lin Mei shouted, pointing at her grandmother.
sentences.zh: “那是她的！”林梅指着奶奶大声喊道。

sentences.en: The happy cheers seemed to frighten the parrot, and it circled above their heads.
sentences.zh: 欢呼声似乎吓到了鹦鹉，它在大家头顶上盘旋。

sentences.en: Mr. Dubois said sorry for his naughty bird, but Granny only laughed and thanked him.
sentences.zh: 杜布瓦先生为他淘气的鸟道歉，奶奶却只是笑着向他道谢。

sentences.en: To thank the village, Mr. Dubois painted a big picture of the square.
sentences.zh: 为了感谢村民，杜布瓦先生画了一幅广场的大画。

sentences.en: In the picture, children flew kites, and an old man wore one red glove.
sentences.zh: 画中，孩子们在放风筝，一位老人戴着一只红手套。

sentences.en: The headmaster hung it in the school hall beside a photo of a famous pianist.
sentences.zh: 校长把这幅画挂在学校礼堂里，就在一位著名钢琴家的照片旁边。

sentences.en: He called Mr. Dubois a pioneer of friendship between two homelands.
sentences.zh: 他称杜布瓦先生是连接两个祖国友谊的先驱。

sentences.en: Before Lin Mei went home, Grandpa gave her a wooden pencil-box he had made himself.
sentences.zh: 在林梅回家之前，爷爷送给她一个他亲手做的木铅笔盒。

sentences.en: Inside was a note that said, 'Stay hopeful, and the world will open for you.'
sentences.zh: 盒子里有一张纸条，上面写着：“保持希望，世界就会为你敞开。”

sentences.en: Back in the city, Lin Mei got a short haircut for the new school term.
sentences.zh: 回到城里后，林梅为新学期剪了一个短发。

sentences.en: Nineteen days later, a colourful postcard from the village arrived at her door, and she smiled.
sentences.zh: 十九天后，一张来自村庄的彩色明信片寄到了她家门口，她笑了。

articles.title: A New Home by the Sea
articles.topic_en: A New Life in a Seaside Town

sentences.en: Lin Mei was a sixteen-year-old pupil from a big city.
sentences.zh: 林梅是一个来自大城市的十六岁学生。

sentences.en: One summer, her family moved to a small seaside town.
sentences.zh: 一年夏天，她们全家搬到了一个海边小镇。

sentences.en: They traveled westwards on an old minibus for many hours.
sentences.zh: 他们乘一辆旧小巴向西行驶了好几个小时。

sentences.en: The road was steep, but the scenery outside was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 路很陡，但窗外的风景很美。

sentences.en: A kind villager sat beside them and told them stories about the town.
sentences.zh: 一位善良的村民坐在他们旁边，给他们讲小镇的故事。

sentences.en: It was windy when they arrived, and a white seagull flew over their heads.
sentences.zh: 他们到达时刮着风，一只白色的海鸥从他们头顶飞过。

sentences.en: Lin Mei felt both nervous and excited about her new life.
sentences.zh: 林梅对新生活既紧张又兴奋。

sentences.en: Their new house had two floors, and Lin Mei's room was upstairs.
sentences.zh: 新房子有两层，林梅的房间在楼上。

sentences.en: There was an old sofa in the corner and a warm quilt on her bed.
sentences.zh: 角落里有一张旧沙发，床上铺着一条暖和的被子。

sentences.en: She worked hard to keep her room tidy every day.
sentences.zh: 她每天都努力保持房间整洁。

sentences.en: Each morning, bright sunlight came through her window at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，日出时明亮的阳光会透过窗户照进来。

sentences.en: In the garden, her grandfather taught her to sow vegetable seeds.
sentences.zh: 在花园里，爷爷教她播种蔬菜种子。

sentences.en: They planted tomato plants near the sunny wall.
sentences.zh: 他们在向阳的墙边种了番茄。

sentences.en: A neighbor drove a big tractor past their gate every morning.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居每天早上开着一辆大拖拉机经过他们家门口。

sentences.en: Little by little, Lin Mei began to love the quiet life of the town.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，林梅开始喜欢上小镇安静的生活。

sentences.en: On the first weekday of September, school began.
sentences.zh: 九月的第一个工作日，学校开学了。

sentences.en: Lin Mei packed her schoolbag carefully the night before.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，林梅仔细地收拾好了书包。

sentences.en: She put in every textbook, a ruler, and some pencils.
sentences.zh: 她放进了每一本课本、一把尺子和几支铅笔。

sentences.en: She also brought an eraser and a small sharpener.
sentences.zh: 她还带了一块橡皮和一个小卷笔刀。

sentences.en: She used it to sharpen her pencils until they were pointed.
sentences.zh: 她用它把铅笔削得尖尖的。

sentences.en: At the school gate, the headmistress welcomed all the students warmly.
sentences.zh: 在校门口，女校长热情地欢迎所有学生。

sentences.en: A friendly schoolmate named Xiao Hua showed her around the school.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫小华的友好同学带她参观了学校。

sentences.en: Lin Mei smiled and felt much less afraid.
sentences.zh: 林梅笑了，心里不再那么害怕了。

sentences.en: In English class, Miss Wang taught them how to pronounce new words.
sentences.zh: 在英语课上，王老师教他们怎样读新单词。

sentences.en: Lin Mei's pronunciation was not perfect at first.
sentences.zh: 一开始，林梅的发音并不完美。

sentences.en: "Pardon? Could you say that again?" the teacher often asked kindly.
sentences.zh: “对不起，你能再说一遍吗？”老师常常和蔼地问。

sentences.en: Every Friday there was a dictation and a short quiz.
sentences.zh: 每周五都有一次听写和一个小测验。

sentences.en: Miss Wang liked to translate an English idiom into Chinese for the class.
sentences.zh: 王老师喜欢为全班把一条英语习语翻译成中文。

sentences.en: Sometimes she told a funny riddle to wake everyone up.
sentences.zh: 有时她会讲一个有趣的谜语来让大家提起精神。

sentences.en: Lin Mei was a little forgetful, so she wrote everything down in her notebook.
sentences.zh: 林梅有点健忘，所以她把所有内容都记在笔记本上。

sentences.en: Slowly, her English became better and better.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，她的英语越来越好了。

sentences.en: After class, the students loved to play sports on the playground.
sentences.zh: 课后，学生们喜欢在操场上做运动。

sentences.en: Lin Mei joined the school volleyball team.
sentences.zh: 林梅加入了学校的排球队。

sentences.en: The coach always said that teamwork was more important than one strong player.
sentences.zh: 教练总是说，团队合作比一个强的队员更重要。

sentences.en: In October, the school held a big relay race.
sentences.zh: 十月，学校举行了一场大型接力赛。

sentences.en: Some boys liked to skate, and others rode a skateboard around the yard.
sentences.zh: 有些男孩喜欢滑冰，还有些男孩在院子里玩滑板。

sentences.en: They often cheered noisily when their friends won a game.
sentences.zh: 朋友们赢了比赛时，他们常常大声喧闹地欢呼。

sentences.en: Lin Mei seldom felt lonely now, because she had many friends.
sentences.zh: 林梅现在很少感到孤单，因为她有了许多朋友。

sentences.en: One Saturday, Grandma took Lin Mei to the town market.
sentences.zh: 一个星期六，奶奶带林梅去了镇上的市场。

sentences.en: It was much busier than the supermarket near their house.
sentences.zh: 那里比他们家附近的超市热闹多了。

sentences.en: A saleswoman sold fresh fish by the entrance.
sentences.zh: 入口处有一位女售货员在卖新鲜的鱼。

sentences.en: Next to her, a young salesgirl sold sweet-smelling flowers.
sentences.zh: 在她旁边，一个年轻的女售货员在卖香喷喷的鲜花。

sentences.en: An old salesman ran a small business at the corner.
sentences.zh: 一位老售货员在拐角处经营着一个小生意。

sentences.en: He sold secondhand books that came from a big company in the city.
sentences.zh: 他卖的二手书来自城里的一家大公司。

sentences.en: Grandma asked him to weigh some apples on his old scale.
sentences.zh: 奶奶请他用旧秤称了一些苹果。

sentences.en: "Take whichever books you like," he told Lin Mei with a smile.
sentences.zh: “你喜欢哪本书就拿哪本吧。”他笑着对林梅说。

sentences.en: People stood in a long queue to pay for their things.
sentences.zh: 人们排着长长的队付钱。

sentences.en: Winter was coming, so the family visited the tailor's shop.
sentences.zh: 冬天快到了，全家人去了裁缝店。

sentences.en: The tailor was cutting cloth with a pair of big scissors.
sentences.zh: 裁缝正在用一把大剪刀裁布。

sentences.en: Grandma bought soft wool to make a sweater.
sentences.zh: 奶奶买了柔软的羊毛来织一件毛衣。

sentences.en: Lin Mei chose a warm woolen skirt.
sentences.zh: 林梅挑了一条暖和的羊毛裙。

sentences.en: Grandpa needed new trousers and a thick overcoat.
sentences.zh: 爷爷需要新裤子和一件厚大衣。

sentences.en: Mother picked a pair of long stockings, and Father got some warm socks.
sentences.zh: 妈妈挑了一双长筒袜，爸爸买了几双暖和的短袜。

sentences.en: The tailor gave Father a free necktie as a gift.
sentences.zh: 裁缝送给爸爸一条领带作为礼物。

sentences.en: Everyone left the shop feeling happy.
sentences.zh: 每个人都开开心心地离开了店铺。

sentences.en: In November, the weather turned rainy and cold.
sentences.zh: 到了十一月，天气变得又多雨又寒冷。

sentences.en: One morning, Lin Mei forgot her umbrella at home.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，林梅把雨伞忘在了家里。

sentences.en: Luckily, Xiao Hua shared her raincoat with her.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，小华把雨衣和她一起用。

sentences.en: "Fasten it well, or the wind will blow it open," she said.
sentences.zh: “把它系紧，不然风会把它吹开的。”她说。

sentences.en: That week, Lin Mei ate some sour fruit that was too old.
sentences.zh: 那一周，林梅吃了一些放得太久的酸水果。

sentences.en: She almost wanted to spit it out at once.
sentences.zh: 她差点想立刻把它吐出来。

sentences.en: Soon she got a bad stomachache.
sentences.zh: 不久她就得了严重的胃痛。

sentences.en: Her little brother had a toothache at the same time.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她的弟弟牙疼。

sentences.en: Being sick gave her a great thirst, and she felt thirsty all day.
sentences.zh: 生病让她非常口渴，她一整天都觉得渴。

sentences.en: Grandma took care of them until they were well again.
sentences.zh: 奶奶照顾他们，直到他们康复。

sentences.en: The sickness taught the family an important lesson about health.
sentences.zh: 这场病给全家上了一堂关于健康的重要课。

sentences.en: Grandma bought a new toothbrush for each child.
sentences.zh: 奶奶给每个孩子买了一支新牙刷。

sentences.en: She placed fresh toothpaste beside them.
sentences.zh: 她在牙刷旁边放上了新牙膏。

sentences.en: A clean towel hung in the washroom.
sentences.zh: 盥洗室里挂着一条干净的毛巾。

sentences.en: They threw all the old food into the dustbin.
sentences.zh: 他们把所有不新鲜的食物都扔进了垃圾箱。

sentences.en: Grandpa said rubbish must never be thrown into the river.
sentences.zh: 爷爷说，垃圾绝不能扔进河里。

sentences.en: "If we pollute the water, the fish will die," he explained.
sentences.zh: “如果我们污染了水，鱼就会死。”他解释说。

sentences.en: So the family learned to recycle paper and glass bottles.
sentences.zh: 于是全家学会了回收纸张和玻璃瓶。

sentences.en: In the garden, Lin Mei found a small worm in the soil and knew the earth was healthy.
sentences.zh: 在花园里，林梅在泥土中发现了一条小虫子，知道土壤很健康。

sentences.en: Every evening, Grandma made tea in her old teapot.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，奶奶都用她的旧茶壶泡茶。

sentences.en: Lin Mei stirred honey into it with a little spoon.
sentences.zh: 林梅用一把小勺子把蜂蜜搅进茶里。

sentences.en: In December, something surprising happened at school.
sentences.zh: 十二月，学校里发生了一件令人吃惊的事。

sentences.en: A thief entered the office and stole the headmistress's purse.
sentences.zh: 一个小偷进了办公室，偷走了女校长的钱包。

sentences.en: The news came through the loudspeaker and gave everyone a shock.
sentences.zh: 消息通过扬声器传出，让每个人都大吃一惊。

sentences.en: It did terrify some of the younger children.
sentences.zh: 这确实吓坏了一些年纪小的孩子。

sentences.en: Two boys even started a quarrel about who had seen the man first.
sentences.zh: 两个男孩甚至为谁先看到那个人而争吵起来。

sentences.en: Lin Mei remembered a strange man in dark sunglasses near the gate.
sentences.zh: 林梅想起校门口附近有一个戴着墨镜的陌生男人。

sentences.en: "It is probable that he is still nearby," she told the teachers.
sentences.zh: “他很可能还在附近。”她对老师们说。

sentences.en: The clock on the wall seemed to tick very loudly as they waited.
sentences.zh: 他们等待时，墙上的钟表滴答声似乎格外响。

sentences.en: Soon a policeman arrived and caught the man at the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 很快，一名警察赶到，在公交车站抓住了那个人。

sentences.en: The headmistress was very thankful to Lin Mei for her help.
sentences.zh: 女校长非常感谢林梅的帮助。

sentences.en: To thank her, the school held a party on the sixteenth of December.
sentences.zh: 为了感谢她，学校在十二月十六日举办了一场聚会。

sentences.en: It was the twelfth month of the year, yet the hall felt as warm as spring.
sentences.zh: 虽然已是一年中的第十二个月，礼堂里却温暖如春。

sentences.en: "Congratulations, Lin Mei!" her classmates shouted together.
sentences.zh: “祝贺你，林梅！”同学们齐声喊道。

sentences.en: About seventy people came, including teachers and parents.
sentences.zh: 大约七十个人来参加，包括老师和家长。

sentences.en: Seventeen students performed songs and dances on the stage.
sentences.zh: 十七名学生在台上表演了歌舞。

sentences.en: Xiao Hua played a beautiful piece on her violin.
sentences.zh: 小华用小提琴演奏了一首优美的曲子。

sentences.en: Grandma cooked more than sixty dumplings for the guests.
sentences.zh: 奶奶为客人们包了六十多个饺子。

sentences.en: Though the Mid-Autumn Festival had passed, she also made a sweet mooncake for Lin Mei.
sentences.zh: 虽然中秋节已经过去，她还是为林梅做了一个甜甜的月饼。

sentences.en: Everyone shared a big supper in the school hall.
sentences.zh: 大家在学校礼堂里一起吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

sentences.en: The delicious food seemed to satisfy every hungry guest.
sentences.zh: 美味的食物似乎让每一位饥饿的客人都心满意足。

sentences.en: At the end, thirteen little pupils sang a goodbye song.
sentences.zh: 最后，十三个小学生唱了一首告别歌。

sentences.en: During the winter holiday, a traveler came to stay in the town.
sentences.zh: 寒假期间，一位旅行者来到镇上小住。

sentences.en: He was a westerner from Oceania, and he carried a big camera.
sentences.zh: 他是一位来自大洋洲的西方人，随身带着一台大相机。

sentences.en: He told the children he loved to surf on the ocean waves.
sentences.zh: 他告诉孩子们，他喜欢在海浪上冲浪。

sentences.en: He also visited an ancient tomb on the hill outside the town.
sentences.zh: 他还参观了镇外山上的一座古墓。

sentences.en: "In the old days, people sent a telegram to share big news," he said.
sentences.zh: “在过去，人们发电报来传递重要消息。”他说。

sentences.en: "Now I just drop a postcard into the postbox."
sentences.zh: “现在我只要把明信片投进邮筒就行了。”

sentences.en: He showed them a picture of a spaceship and talked about the stars.
sentences.zh: 他给他们看了一张宇宙飞船的图片，还谈起了星星。

sentences.en: "Believe in yourselves, and chase your dreams," he told the children.
sentences.zh: “相信你们自己，去追逐梦想吧。”他对孩子们说。

sentences.en: Lin Mei looked at her friends and felt sure that the future was theirs.
sentences.zh: 林梅看着她的朋友们，确信未来是属于他们的。

sentences.en: In this small town by the sea, she had truly found a home.
sentences.zh: 在这个海边小镇，她真正找到了自己的家。
